jobs.title: Support to Joint Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance & Awareness Integration
jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

Allied Command Transformation (ACT) is NATO’s leading agent for change: driving, facilitating, and advocating the continuous improvement of Alliance capabilities to maintain and enhance the military relevance and effectiveness of the Alliance. The main objectives of ACT are: providing appropriate support to NATO missions and operations; leading NATO military transformation; and improving relationships, interaction and practical cooperation with partners, nations and international organisations. ACT therefore leads Alliance concept development, capability development, training and lessons-learned initiatives and provides unfettered military support to policy development within NATO.

The program

Capability Development & Management Support (CDMS)

DCOS Capability Development (CAPDEV) acts as the Supreme Allied Commander Transformation's Director for guidance, direction and coordination of the activities and resources of the Capability Development Directorate.

The Requirements Division will execute all tasks and activities needed to support requirements management for NATO capabilities

The Capability Requirements (CR) Branch will develop the Capability Requirements Brief and recommended courses of action to resolve issues through the life cycle management of requirements using matrixed, cross-functional project-specific Requirements Management teams.

The Requirements Forward Branch (Mons) is responsible for conducting requirements development and management representation and engagement-related functions in Europe.

The Capability Division coordinates the development of capabilities from capability planning through acceptance and then disposal with management entities, NATO Headquarters staff and the NATO Governance Structure

The Capability Forward Branch (Mons) coordinates with ACO, NCIA, NSPA, NATO HQ, territorial Host Nations, and NATO Centres of Excellence (COEs) to support the development of capabilities.

Strategic Plans and Policy (SPP) supports Allied Command Transformation in formalizing military advice to shape future military strategy, political guidance, and other policy documents supporting NATO’s strategic objectives.

Role ID: 27-01-A-LC18

Role Duties and Responsibilities

• Provision of support to the development of Joint Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance & Awareness (JISR&A) capability products in accordance with the NATO governance model for the delivery of common funded capabilities across Doctrine, Organization, Training, Material, Leadership, Personnel, Facilities and Interoperability (DOTMLPFI) lines of development in a through life cycle approach, based on the guidance of the Allied Command Transformation JISR&A Capabilities Programme Director/Section Head and JISR&A Integrator/Architect;

• Support the ACT JISR&A Capabilities Programme Director and Project Coordinators in their programme management efforts, including the interaction with JISR&A stakeholders at all levels, from Tactical to Strategic;

• Provision of methodological and analytical expertise in support of the development and implementation of the holistic approach toward JISR&A capability development, especially with regard to multi-source/multi-domain intelligence fusion and integration;

• Support JISR&A -related projects (e.g. JISR Line of Effort; JISR&A -related Beacon Projects) as required by JISR&A Capabilities Programme Director and the JISR&A Integrator/Architect;

• Support the elicitation, capture, development, analysis, evaluation and traceability of higher and lower-level requirements (such as capability targets, operational requirements, system specifications, interoperability requirements, etc.) across all aspects of DOTMLPFI;

• Support the development, analysis and review of JISR&A -related doctrinal corpus (e.g. policies, doctrines, directives concepts of operation/employment, courses of action and alternatives);

• Coordinate DOTMLPFI development and implementation synchronization; support the development of recommended courses of action to resolve issues relating capability development, across the capabilities’ lifecycles.

• Organise and participate to workshops, seminars, conferences and meetings in support of the activities above;

• Collaborate with national and international military and civilian organizations, including centres of excellence and academia, in support of the activities above;

• Administration of JISR&A capabilities development programmes status information in the electronic environment supporting ACT warfare development information sharing and coordination;

• Support the interaction with NATO Agencies in context of the JISR&A -related capabilities development programmes and validation of capabilities;

• Identify lessons and Best Practices and contribute to their learning within the organization;

• Support the ACT JISR&A Capabilities Programme Director and the JISR&A Integrator/Architect and travel to meetings and conferences both within and outside NATO’s boundaries for up to 40 days per year;

• Perform additional tasks as required by JISR&A Capabilities Programme Director and the COTR related to programme management efforts.

Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications

• Master’s degree or similar national academic or Military College qualification in engineering, information systems, aeronautics, operations research, project management, business administration or related disciplines. Can be substituted with Bachelor Degree and 5 years of experience in relevant field.

• Demonstrate 3 years’ experience in the last 10 in briefing senior leaders/decision makers.

• Demonstrate 5 years operational experience, within the last 12 years, intelligence fusion and integration (in particular multi-source/multi-domain) on a Joint or Strategic level staff, and / or military effects Planning Command and Control, either as a military officer or as a civilian.

• Demonstrable experience, minimum of 2 years within the last 10 years, Programme/Project Management experience in the past ten years within a complex and dynamic environment, with a focus on military capability development.

• Demonstrable experience, minimum of 2 years within the last 10 years, working in a multinational organization (e.g. European Defence Agency) or NATO Command Structure (NCS) / NATO Force Structure (NFS) and familiarity with NATO agencies’ role in system development.

Working Location

• Norfolk, VA, United States.

Working Policy

• On-site.

Travel

• Some travel to other NATO sites may be required.

Security Clearance

• Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRABA



Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain.



We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships.



But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.



We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.




THE ROLE



We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses.

You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0-to-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them.

This role reports directly to our VP of Product.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform

 - Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities

 - Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams

 - Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners

 - Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work

 - Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance

 - Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions

 - Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture

 - Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact

 - Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Real agent builder. You have launched customer-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously.

0-to-1 operator. You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists.

AI-native problem solver. You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs.

First-principles thinker. You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Customer-embedded builder. You believe the best products are built shoulder-to-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer-embedded product development models is highly valued.

Technical depth. You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details.

Builder mentality. Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative. You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING



 - 7 – 10 years of experience as a Product Manager

 - Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes

 - Experience building AI-native products or customer-facing agent systems

 - Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams

 - Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas

 - Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles

 - Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience building with modern AI systems

 - Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area

 - A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company




BENEFITS



 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 💰 Competitive Salary

 - 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

 - 🍽️ Dinner Provided via Grubhub & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health




SALARY RANGE DETAILS



The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long-term success and upside of the business.



The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER



Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. jobs.title: Director of Nursing (DON)
jobs.description:
Overview

Otterbein is a vibrant, faith-based, not-for-profit Senior Living Community that offer Independent and Assisted Living, Nursing Care, Memory Care and Rehabilitation in Ohio, Michigan and Indiana.

The Director of Nursing (DON) is responsible and accountable for the quality of nursing care given to all residents on the campus.  This is accomplished by leading the nursing team and collaborating with other departments to ensure health care services are provided in accordance to policies, procedures, and the regulations that govern our community along with the Mission and Values of Otterbein. This position is a key member of the leadership team and reports to the Executive Director.

Responsibilities

• Assures the quality care of residents is provided on a 24 hour basis through training, scheduling, directing, and supervising quality and sufficient staff.

• Oversees all day to day operations of the nursing department in all three levels of care

• Develops and updates appropriate policies and procedures for licensed areas

• Works with the physicians, pharmacists, and other health care professionals and suppliers that are part of the health care team to ensure exceptional care and service is provided

• Works closely with residents, families and responsible parties of the person who resides in our care in all areas of the campus, addressing their concerns, meeting their needs, and exceeding their expectations.

• Assists and leads partners in utilizing appropriate techniques for effective assessment, planning, intervention, and evaluation of residents and their needs.

• Develops and implements strong systems to ensure goals are met and medical, psychosocial, emotional, and spiritual needs of residents are addressed by the team

• Ensures the area and its equipment and supplies are neat, clean, safe and utilized appropriately at all times.

• Ensures community and department policies, procedures, and guidelines, as well as local and state regulations, are met and followed by everyone in the area.

• Manages the nursing department budget

• Leads the quality assurance and improvement efforts

• Coaches and teaches partners and works with them to create the Otterbein Experience

Qualifications

• Education: Graduate of approved nursing program

• Licensure/Certification: Valid Michigan Registered Nurse (RN) license

• Experience: The successful candidate will have strong clinical skills, effective communication and leadership skills, a commitment to exceptional customer service and previous management experience. The candidate will also need to demonstrate alignment with Otterbein mission and values and have a passion for serving others. At least five year in a nursing leadership role preferred.

BENEFITS*

Health & Wellness

• Medical Insurance with free virtual doctor visits

• Vision & Dental Insurance

• Pet Insurance

• Life Insurance

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for personal and professional support

Financial Security

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with company match

• Paid Time Off (PTO) that accrues immediately from day one

• Access to DailyPay, enabling you to access up to 100% of your earned wages on a daily basis

• Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 per year for ANY field of study

• Tuition Discounts through exclusive partnerships with the University of Cincinnati, University of Toledo, and Hondros College

• Employee-Sponsored Crisis Fund available for those facing unforeseen challenges

• Legal & Identity Theft Protection

Growth & Development

• University Partnerships with University of Cincinnati, University of Toledo, and Hondros College for exclusive tuition discounts

• Multiple Partner Discounts available for various products and services through Access Perks

• Access to 1,000s of hours of personal and professional development material through RightNow Media @ Work

*Some benefits, including PTO and tuition reimbursement, are based on hours worked.

Apply today and begin a meaningful career as a Director of Nursing (DON) at Otterbein!

A warm family in Cupertino, CA is seeking a flexible, reliable part-time nanny to support their two school-aged children (ages 11 and 8). The ideal candidate will provide local transportation to afternoon activities, prepare light snacks, and assist with light household tasks.

Responsibilities:

• Safely transport children to and from local classes and activities (approximately 2 miles away)

 - Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback

Real agent builder. You have launched customer-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously.

0-to-1 operator. You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists.

AI-native problem solver. You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs.

First-principles thinker. You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Customer-embedded builder. You believe the best products are built shoulder-to-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Technical depth. You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. Builder mentality. Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative. You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life.

 - 5 – 7 years of experience as a Product Manager

 - Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes

 - Experience building AI-native products or customer-facing agent systems

 - Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams

 - Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas

 - Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles

 - Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience building with modern AI systems

 - Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area

 - A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company

jobs.title: Director, Global Communications
jobs.description:
The Director, Global Communications will serve as a strategic communications leader supporting Universal Film's corporate communications and media relations efforts. Partnering closely with senior communications leaders and stakeholders across the division distribution, home entertainment and film labels, this role will help shape and execute communication strategies that elevate the organization’s reputation, business priorities, and executive visibility.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution, anticipating opportunities and challenges while delivering measurable impact. They are equally comfortable developing communications strategies, counseling stakeholders, managing complex issues, and driving alignment across a matrixed organization.

Strategic Communications & Media Relations

• Develop and execute strategic communications programs that support Universal Film’s business priorities
• Monitor industry, competitive, and cultural trends, identifying opportunities and risks that may impact the organization
• Partner with business leaders to proactively develop communications strategies that connect business priorities to broader NBCUniversal objectives
• Contribute thought leadership ideas, storytelling opportunities, and innovative communications approaches that strengthen visibility and engagement

Execution & Impact

• Serve as lead on division priorities including coordination across the enterprise including Government Affairs, Legal, MPA, HR, Global TV Distribution, Film Music, Talent Development, AI and Innovation
• Collaborate and coordinate editorials and issues with Focus, DreamWorks and Universal Theatrical Group
• Draft and oversee communications materials, including press releases, messaging documents, presentations, and executive communications
• Serve as support and partner with the lead for other media relations efforts, including box office reporting, transactional communications, executive visibility initiatives
• Manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of quality, responsiveness, and follow-through
• Maintain and update team calendar of initiatives including speaking engagements, awards submissions, editorial and event calendars
• Oversee and coordinate industry coverage reports for team, including key financial events like earnings and investor conferences
• Manage media lists and media list databases with a focus on updating in real-time to keep the team informed in a timely manner of all reporter and outlet changes

Collaboration & Leadership

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRABA

 

Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain.

 

We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships.

 

But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.

 

We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

 


THE ROLE

 

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses.

 

You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0-to-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI.

 

You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them.

 

This role reports directly to our VP of Product.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform

 - Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities

 - Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams

 - Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners

 - Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work

 - Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance

 - Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions

 - Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture

 - Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact

 - Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 

Real agent builder. You have launched customer-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously.

0-to-1 operator. You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists.

AI-native problem solver. You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs.

First-principles thinker. You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Customer-embedded builder. You believe the best products are built shoulder-to-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer-embedded product development models is highly valued.

Technical depth. You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details.

Builder mentality. Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative. You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 

 - 3 – 5 years of experience as a Product Manager

 - Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes

 - Experience building AI-native products or customer-facing agent systems

 - Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams

 - Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas

 - Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles

 - Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience building with modern AI systems

 - Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area

 - A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company

 


BENEFITS

 

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 💰 Competitive Salary

 - 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

 - 🍽️ Dinner Provided via Grubhub & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health

 


SALARY RANGE DETAILS

 

The compensation range for this position is set between $150,000 and $190,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long-term success and upside of the business.

The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.

 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

 

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.

 


OUR VALUES

 

Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession - We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems

jobs.title: Copy of Senior Sales Performance Consultant
jobs.description:
This role will be based in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Chicago, New York City.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about the science of selling and at driving organizational change. We are looking for a Sales Performance Consultant who will partner with LinkedIn Talent Solutions (LTS) senior Sales leaders and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and our Go-to-Market Enablement (GTME) team to deliver transformational behavior change initiatives that lead to improved business results.

As a Senior Sales Performance Consultant, you are responsible for recommendations and execution that improve sales strategy, processes and performance. You are highly attuned to the Sales organization’s strategy and goals, acting as an extension of its leadership team and partnering with Sales leaders to provide proactive recommendations that help grow the business.

You will leverage qualitative and quantitative analyses to provide insights into current sales blockers and skills and technology gaps that limit the potential of the sales team. Your extensive sales and business acumen ensures your successful evaluation of gaps in existing sales data and sales strategies. With these insights, you will identify opportunities for business critical sales processes, skills and technology enablement, creating strategic plans to improve seller performance by either winning more or saving time. You will design and execute tailored solutions, deliver learning experiences and change management strategies that enhance sales teams’ career trajectories and drive measurable results that move the business forward. Through your deep understanding of sales, you will act as the voice of the field to input into global enablement priorities and initiatives.

Responsibilities:

• Partners with business and cross-functional leaders as a Strategic Business Partner to deeply understand business strategies, goals, drivers and gaps, and proactively recommend opportunities to increase field productivity and growth — including tactics beyond enablement — to business leaders and cross-functional GTM team.

• Builds a comprehensive and concise strategic enablement plan that drives measurable behavior change and business results.

• Leverages enablement content and programs from GTME to create impactful behavior change programs that reinforce new or existing GTM motions, and acts as Voice of the Field to shape GTM Enablement priorities and ensure programs meet stakeholder needs.

• Executes last-mile delivery and change management of enablement initiatives by translating GTME strategy into actionable steps, partnering with field leaders on needed sponsorship and communications, identifying and executing needed reinforcement, and monitoring measurable outcomes to ensure sustained behavior change and shared accountability.

• Owns holistic enablement measurement strategy including both short- and long-term behavior change metrics, as well as alignment to business KPIs, aligning timelines for impact with the rhythm of the business (e.g., quarterly gap-closing initiatives, annual skill development priorities).

• Works as part of a team that supports the culture and values of the organization, including people development and Inclusion and Belonging.

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years combined of sales, sales operations, change management, sales enablement or consulting experience

• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, marketing, communications, engineering, product management, education, or other related fields.

Preferred Qualifications

• Executive communications skills with demonstrated ability to influence executives and align groups of senior stakeholders without formal authority

• Ability to navigate a complex, matrixed and fast paced organization, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to design and implement large-scale programs and change management initiatives that deliver transformative business outcomes

• Deep behavior and / or technology change management experience

• Resourcefulness in ambiguity – ability to self-solve when faced with challenges

• AI fluency – applies sound judgment about when and why to use AI, structures effective prompts, and uses repeatable verification to discover business insights and develop solutions that drive business impact

• Business Acumen

• Cross-Team Collaboration

• Operational Excellence

• Problem Solving

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager, Dedicated Accounts
jobs.description:
About OfficeSpace:

OfficeSpace Software provides the leading AI operating system for the built world, that helps teams plan, connect, and perform in the workplace. As a performance-based, PE-backed company, we hire based on merit and a willingness to do what it takes to succeed long-term. You’re a great fit for the role if you’re entrepreneurial, passionate, motivated by building at light speed, and an Agentic AI early adopter. Our world-class teams operate in the US, Canada, and Costa Rica in a culture of trust, respect, growth, and impact.

As a Client Success Manager, Dedicated Accounts, you own the success, retention, and growth of a portfolio of high-value mid-market customers. You build trusted relationships, turn OfficeSpace capabilities into measurable business outcomes, and help customers get more value as their workplace strategies evolve.

You combine strategic account leadership with AI-enabled execution. You use customer intelligence and AI to spot risk, uncover opportunity, and move faster—while applying human judgment where relationships, commercial decisions, and customer trust matter most.

What you’ll do

• Own retention, adoption, customer outcomes, and growth across a portfolio of dedicated mid-market accounts.

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders. Become the strategic partner customers rely on to connect OfficeSpace capabilities to their workplace goals.

• Create and lead outcome-driven Success Plans that define priorities, measures of success, risks, and opportunities.

• Lead strategic business reviews that demonstrate ROI, adoption, business impact, and clear next steps.

• Turn AI-generated account intelligence into action. Validate health signals, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and determine the right customer engagement strategy.

• Own renewal readiness and partner with Sales to shape expansion, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.

• Guide customers through adoption, optimization, and evolving workplace strategies with recommendations grounded in their business needs.

• Orchestrate AI-assisted workflows for account research, meeting preparation, portfolio analysis, follow-up, and planning—then validate outputs before they influence customer decisions.

• Collaborate with Support, Product, Marketing, Sales, and Professional Services to solve complex customer challenges and deliver strong outcomes.

• Turn customer feedback and portfolio patterns into insights that influence product, customer success, and go-to-market decisions.

• Improve success playbooks and AI-enabled workflows so the team can deliver greater impact at scale.

What you bring

• 2+ years of Client Success, Customer Success, or Account Management experience in SaaS, ideally supporting mid-market customers.

• A track record of driving adoption, retention, renewals, and measurable customer outcomes.

• Strong commercial judgment and experience supporting renewals and identifying expansion opportunities.

• The ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and navigate complex customer organizations.

• Experience leading strategic business reviews and connecting product usage to business value.

• Strong analytical skills. You can turn customer, product, and commercial data into clear decisions and recommendations.

• Working knowledge of Customer Success and CRM platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, or equivalent tools.

• Practical AI fluency. You know how to use AI for analysis, research, planning, forecasting, and workflow acceleration without outsourcing judgment.

• The ability to orchestrate multiple AI tools, evaluate output quality, verify important conclusions, and determine when human intervention is required.

• Strong prioritization and portfolio management skills across multiple customer accounts.

• Curiosity and adaptability. You learn quickly and put emerging AI capabilities to work when they improve customer outcomes.

• Availability to work Central or Eastern time zone hours.

Why OfficeSpace?

• High-Performance Culture: At OfficeSpace, we believe in the power of accountability, focus, and drive. Our A-Player team members work together to deliver measurable, meaningful results. We recognize and reward those who push boundaries and achieve excellence.

• Ownership and Accountability: We trust our employees to take full ownership of their roles, providing the autonomy to innovate and the support to succeed. We seek individuals who are self-motivated and thrive in an environment where they can drive impactful outcomes.

• Technology-Forward: As a company invested in cutting-edge technology, we integrate AI and other advanced solutions across our platform to enhance productivity, customer experience, and process efficiency. Our team members are excited by the potential of AI and proactively explore ways it can drive our success.

• Growth Mindset: Continuous learning and improvement are integral to our culture. We encourage our team to embrace challenges, seek knowledge, and develop both personally and professionally.

• Innovation and Agility: We foster a dynamic, fast-paced environment where fresh ideas and bold solutions are celebrated. We embrace change and thrive on turning challenges into opportunities, with a team that is agile, proactive, and resilient.

• Collaborative, Results-Driven Environment: We value purposeful collaboration that leads to shared success and stronger results. While our team members are independent, they recognize the value of working together to drive our mission forward.

• Competitive Benefits and Rewards: OfficeSpace offers comprehensive and competitive benefits packages globally, designed to support our team’s health, well-being, and financial security. We invest in our people so they can excel. OfficeSpace is committed to building and promoting a diverse workforce and celebrates the unique qualities that individuals of various backgrounds and experiences offer. We are committed to basing all employment-related decisions upon valid job-related factors without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, religion, national origin, genetic information, military status, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Principal Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
ICON is building the future of human shelter using large-scale additive construction technology to deliver homes and structures that are more resilient, more sustainable, and more attainable than anything conventional construction can produce. Our work spans single-family housing to large-scale federal facilities, and our projects are redefining what's structurally possible when design, engineering, and technology are developed as a unified system.

ICON is looking for a Director of Structural Engineering to lead and own the structural delivery of ICON's design-build projects. This is a senior engineering leadership role where you will serve as Engineer of Record for internal project delivery and engage with external engineering professionals in a design-assist capacity. The role sits at the intersection of structural practice, computational design, and a construction technology that doesn't have decades of precedent to fall back on. This role will report to the Senior Director Design Delivery at our Austin, TX office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Function & Team Leadership

• Own ICON's structural engineering function — its standards, tools, methods, and delivery quality across the project portfolio.

• Build, lead, and develop the structural engineering team; own hiring, performance, and career growth.

• Set and steward structural design standards, details, and review processes; drive their adoption across design-build teams.

• Own the structural engineering budget and resourcing; forecast capacity against the project pipeline and resolve bottlenecks before they hit schedule.

• Contribute to engineering-wide strategy and policy alongside senior leadership; represent structures in portfolio and roadmap decisions.

Engineering Leadership & EOR Accountability

• Serve as Engineer of Record across ICON's design-build project portfolio, taking full structural responsibility from design through construction completion.

• Lead structural calculations and documentation for complete building and wall systems, coordinating across ICON's architecture, materials science, print path, and construction teams.

• Evaluate ICON's structural building systems for compliance with applicable building codes, standards, and performance criteria — including systems with no direct code precedent.

• Provide senior-level guidance on foundation system design across varied site and soil conditions.

Design-Build Integration

• Act as the primary structural voice in cross-disciplinary design-build teams, coordinating with architects, MEP consultants, Construction Architects, Print Path Technologists, and Project Managers to keep projects moving without sacrificing structural integrity.

• Maintain project delivery schedules in collaboration with the broader design-build team, identifying and resolving structural bottlenecks early.

• Propose structural designs optimized for both performance and cost, leveraging state-of-the-art computational tools to explore solutions that conventional structural practice wouldn't consider.

Team & Consultant Oversight

• Lead and develop a small team of structural engineers executing project delivery.

• Review structural drawings from third-party consultants for conformance with ICON standards, cost efficiency, and constructability using ICON's technology.

• Review shop drawings and submittals from contractors for conformance with ICON's structural standards and details.

Field & Testing

• Conduct field inspections, site observations, and structural testing in support of new project construction.

• Participate in test preparation and execution with project team members and external partners.

• Travel to project sites as required (typically 1–2 overnight trips per assignment).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• 9+ years of structural engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to concrete structural systems.

• Licensed PE in your state of residence; ability to obtain Texas PE licensure within 6–8 weeks of hire.

• Degree in Structural or Civil Engineering (or closely related discipline).

• Demonstrated experience across multiple structural system types — concrete, wood-framed, light-gauge steel, and structural steel.

• Proficiency with structural analysis software and computational design tools.

• Working knowledge of AutoCAD, FEA software (Abaqus or equivalent), Navisworks, and Microsoft Office.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, building envelope details (cladding, curtain wall, waterproofing, roofing), and structural specifications.

• Working knowledge of test methods and standards required for code compliance of structural systems.

• Strong communication skills — written and verbal — and the organizational discipline to manage multiple projects against hard deadlines.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Advanced degree in Structural or Civil Engineering.

• 9+ years specifically in complex concrete structural projects within a design-build delivery environment.

• Experience with computational design and parametric structural modeling; familiarity with Trimble Tekla, Autodesk Forge, or CATIA.

• Background in forensic structural investigation and failure analysis.

• Familiarity with sustainability metrics in structural material selection — embodied carbon, life cycle assessment, material efficiency.

• Experience with novel or non-standard construction methods where engineering judgment had to extend beyond established code pathways.

ICON is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an innovative, inclusive, diverse and discrimination-free work environment. Employment with ICON is based on merit, competence, and qualifications. It is our policy to administer all personnel actions, including recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. Furthermore, as a federal government contractor, the Company maintains an affirmative action program which furthers its commitment and complies with recordkeeping and reporting requirements under certain federal civil rights laws and regulations, including Executive Order 11246, Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (as amended) and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 (as amended).

jobs.title: Maintenance Manager
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

In the role of Maintenance Manager, the successful candidate will assist the Deputy/Site/Project Leader in overseeing and managing all daily maintenance activities for the project site to ensure operational standards. Support the Deputy/Site/Project Leader in addressing maintenance challenges, providing hands-on assistance and contributing to quick, effective solutions. Help relay site goals, procedures, and updates to team members, ensuring clear and consistent communication throughout the site. Flexibly manage various responsibilities, stepping in to handle tasks as needed, and adapting to the changing needs of the site. Assist in maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency, working closely with the Deputy/Site/Project Leader to implement process improvements. Oversee the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment. The Maintenance Manager leads a team of supervisors, technicians, and contractors to ensure efficient plant performance, reduce downtime, and enhance equipment longevity. Ensure the timely, accurate and cost effective delivery of maintenance services including: planned system overhauls, renewal, replacement, and on-demand corrective repair services. Foster a positive and collaborative work environment by supporting team members, helping to resolve any issues, and promoting teamwork.

• Safety: Foster a safety-driven culture across the site, ensuring all employees have proper training, resources, and PPE. Maintain compliance with OSHA, State, and Veolia Safety and Environmental programs.
• Compliance: Oversee maintenance activities to comply with the environmental and safety regulations for the site.
• Reliability: Monitor project delivery performance, maintaining high standards of quality and consistent results. Focus on preventive and predictive maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment.
• People Focused: Promote a positive work culture, manage resources effectively, and communicate business initiatives and goals to team members. Evaluate and mentor the team to drive performance and growth.
• Customer Obsessed: Build and maintain strong customer relationships, addressing escalated issues promptly. Contribute to new business opportunities and work towards improving Net Promoter Scores.
• Cost Effective: Optimize maintenance strategies to reduce downtime and extend the lifespan of our equipment. Establishes maintenance schedules and ensures that machines, equipment, tooling and other accessories are properly maintained and in top working condition to maximize overall effectiveness. Ability to work with vendors to reduce cost and recommend cost-effective solutions for improving plant efficiency and reducing operational costs.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Assigns personnel to shifts and plans daily schedules to provide preventative, predictive and preventative maintenance, repairs and installation of equipment, instrumentation and controls. Coordinates schedule to ensure that maintenance resources are being utilized to achieve project objectives.
• Prepares work orders either manually or from a CMMS system as required and prepares work related reports, procurement requisitions, charts, graphs and data submittal requirements in an accurate and timely manner.
• Ensures that consistent maintenance and quality assurance procedures are followed in all assigned areas and shifts. Ensures that uniform recordkeeping is performed facility wide.
• Responsible for job planning including estimates for labor and materials, reporting on performance against goals/estimates, maintaining records of maintenance execution, equipment histories and equipment parts usage, and logistical requirements.
• Maintain a well-organized parts and equipment inventory and storage.
• Schedule and allocate labor to ensure work tasks are completed in a timely and efficient manner.
• Document and track each work task to ensure efficiency, communicate any major variances.
• Develop and create SOP’s for routine and non-routine maintenance tasks and up-load into maintenance system (VAMS) as needed.
• Perform work tasks and duties in a cost-effective manner and communicate budget.
• Provide any OEM/equipment training needs.
• Work with department management to schedule any routine maintenance if shutdown/downtime/availability is needed during normal production hours as needed.
• Track asset availability including uptime, and downtime with downtime cause.
• Perform equipment failure analysis and document findings, lead RCAs as needed.
• Actively participate in weekly Operations & Management meetings.
• Proactively manages safety and environmental issues and ensures compliance with Federal and State standards including Hazardous Waste Disposal and Air Quality Standards. Ensures that issues are identified, addressed, and elevated if necessary, in a timely manner.
• Works with operations leadership to recommend and maintain an up-to-date plan of action to be taken in event of emergencies such as machine, equipment or power failure, or need to release dammed water to affect flood control. Execute and supervise the plan if necessary.
• Ability to foster teamwork and collaboration, ensuring that communication flows smoothly across all team members to ensure team alignment and site goals are met.
• Supports the Site/Project Leader in managing team performance, helping to identify areas for improvement and offering coaching as needed.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills to assist in liaising with the Deputy or Site Leader, staff, and vendors.
• Assists the Site/Project Leader in promoting a safety-first culture and conducting regular safety checks or audits.
• Must be able to serve as a point of contact for 24-hour emergency on-call if required by site.
• Assists the Site/Project Leader in mentoring junior team members, providing guidance and support for skill development and performance improvement.
• Demonstrates a desire to grow into a future leadership role, with a focus on developing both maintenance and leadership skills.
• People Management:Promote a positive work culture.Leads, trains, and manages maintenance technicians and field staff.Assign and schedule maintenance tasks to ensure efficient plant operations.Manages staff performance and ensure adherence to safety protocols and maintenance procedures.Communicate business initiatives and goals to team members.Typically manages less than 7 FTEs.
• Safety Management:Implement and enforce comprehensive safety protocols, procedures, and best practices at the maintenance level.Lead and Conduct regular safety training and awareness programs for all site personnel.Contributes to the overall site safety performance metrics, including incident rates and near-misses, to drive improvement.Conduct risk assessments for maintenance tasks.Implementing Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures for hazardous energy control.
• Compliance Oversight:Proactively manages safety and environmental issues and ensures compliance with Federal and State standards including Hazardous Waste Disposal and Air Quality Standards and maintenance contract requirements.Ensure adherence to established environmental, health, safety, operating, maintenance, and emergency response procedures.Enforce compliance with OSHA, EPA, local water authority regulations, and company policies.Maintain records of equipment inspections, maintenance logs, and work orders using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
• Operational Reliability:Develop, implement, and oversee preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure equipment reliability.Monitor project maintenance performance.Maintain high standards of quality and consistent results.Coordinate problem resolution and manage conflicting priorities.Ensure proper maintenance of SCADA systems, control panels, and instrumentation used in water and wastewater treatment.Coordinates the proper response to equipment failures, breakdowns, and emergency maintenance issues.
• Customer Relations:Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with site-level customers and vendors.Coordinate with vendors and manage contractors for specialized repairs or equipment servicing.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve customer experience and satisfaction.
• Cost Effectiveness:Identify and implement maintenance efficiencies and cost-saving initiatives to enhance site-level performance.Implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to reduce downtime.Manage overtime and other spending areas to ensure compliance to budget.Create, monitor and manage inventory of parts, tools, spare parts and maintenance supplies.Ensure timely procurement of replacement parts and necessary equipment.

Work Environment:

• The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.
• A degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred but not required.
• 10 years of experience in maintenance within the water and wastewater industry, 5 of which in a supervisory or management maintenance role.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Operational Knowledge:Comprehensive understanding of unit processes applicable to water and/or wastewater treatment facilities.Knowledge of pumps, motors, valves, blowers, compressors, and SCADA systems.Ability to interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals.Ability to prepare as-built red line drawings.
• Systems Expertise:Strong troubleshooting skills in mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems.Preferred knowledge of a) Electrical systems relevant to water/wastewater facilities b) Mechanical systems used in treatment plants c) Instrumentation and control systems for process monitoring and automation.
• Computer Skills:Proficiency in general computer applications, including: a) Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) b) Data entry and management systems c) SCADA systems (desirable) d) Computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) e) knowledge of google software platform
• Additional Desirable Skills:Familiarity with water quality testing and analysis techniques.Understanding of regulatory compliance requirements.Complex troubleshooting skills for equipment and processes.Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics.Ability to work in high-pressure, emergency response situations.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must be able to obtain certifications as required.
• Confined Space Entry Certification and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Training.

Physical Requirements:

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
• The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, climb stairs or ladders, sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell.
• The employee may regularly lift 10-25 pounds and may occasionally lift and or move up to 50 pounds.

Benefits:  Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Child Nutrition Specialist
jobs.description:
The Child Nutrition Specialist works as a part of the KIPP Texas Public Schools Cafeteria Team to prepare and serve breakfast, lunch and supper for all students at their assigned campus. The Child Nutrition Specialist will work effectively in the cafeteria/kitchen or where designated by the Child Nutrition Site Supervisor. The Child Nutrition Specialist will help  to create a warm and friendly atmosphere to enhance the student’s meal time experience. This position will efficiently handle the sale of food, and to prepare an accurate, balanced tabulation sheet for Child Nutrition accounting purposes.This position must have a firm understanding of HACCP principles, general nutrition and food preparation. This position will abide by the policies, procedures, and standards for physical and food safety, freshness and sanitation.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Know, understand, and assist in implementing the requirements of the Child Nutrition Program.
• Work on the serving line when necessary to ensure quick, smooth meal services.
• Comply with Health Department Codes for food service.
• Comply with all safety measures and regulations throughout the cafeteria and kitchen and report any injuries or unsafe conditions in the workplace to the Child Nutrition Site Supervisor.
• Support the Child Nutrition Site Supervisor with all kitchen and cafeteria duties.
• Carefully prep and prepare products according to the recipe.
• Ensure the quality, taste and presentation of all prepared items.
• Use safety precautions relative to working with food service equipment and materials.
• Firm understanding of FIFO and the Temperature Danger Zone.
• Follow established HACCP food safety, cleaning and maintenance procedures.
• Maintain the cleanliness of the kitchen and cafeteria area.
• Operate dish machines to company and manufacturer specifications.
• Use proper measurements of detergent and sanitizer in the dish machine.
• Support all efforts to recycle and compost.
• Store stock in an efficient and safe manner.
• Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma
• Food Handler certification required
• One (1) year experience in food and hospitality related role (preferred)
• Experience in school-based Child Nutrition (preferred)
• Experience in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing organization (preferred)

COMPETENCY AND SKILLS:

• Ability to communicate professionally, both written and verbally with team and management.
• Must be self-motivated and able to problem solve effectively.
• Possess an entrepreneurial spirit, is proactive and flexible, and is willing and able to play different roles in the team in order to meet the varied and constant needs of the students.
• Model positive and healthy character traits and habits, such as being consistent and understanding.
• Fundamental understanding of sanitation and cleanliness.
• Unquestioned integrity and commitment to the KIPP Texas Public Schools mission and KIPP Texas Public Schools community.

Physical Requirements:

NBCUniversal is seeking an Analyst to join the Streaming Monetization team. You will focus on developing monetization insights, optimizing yield strategies, and supporting planning and sales teams with comprehensive analysis of streaming supply and demand. As an Analyst, you will leverage data driven insights to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and solve challenges that directly impact NBCUniversal's streaming revenue growth.

The ideal candidate has had exposure to digital ad sales and is looking to dive into the analytics to inform business stakeholders. This is a role for someone who enjoys analyzing data in spreadsheets and databases.

Responsibilities

• Analyze Streaming Monetization KPIs, including sell-thru, capacity, demand, and pricing trends, and translate findings into clear, executive-ready narratives that support operational and leadership decision-making
• Create weekly reports for senior leadership on monetization insights, financial pacing, and sales trends, using data analysis to identify trends and communicate compelling stories
• Conduct investigative analyses across multiple data sources to diagnose business questions, validate assumptions, and uncover root causes behind performance trends or discrepancies
• Use curiosity and analytical rigor to dig beneath surface-level metrics- identifying drivers, risks, and opportunities that inform monetization strategy
• Balance long-term, self-directed analytical projects with ad hoc, time-sensitive business requests, maintaining accuracy, organization, and clear communication across competing priorities
• Develop automations, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions to streamline manual processes, reduce turnaround time, and improve stakeholder access to actionable insights
• Analyze consumption trends and performance of sponsorships and ad innovations to inform forecasting, packaging, and optimization health

• Minimum one (1+) year of experience; preferably in ad sales, analytics, or publisher/supply side
• Proficiency with MS Excel and PowerPoint

Eligibility Requirements

• Must be willing to work in New York, NY
• Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States

• Strategic thinker with the ability to derive conclusions and recommendations from raw data
• Self-starter with strong attention to detail, sense of curiosity, accountability, and ability to execute projects of all sizes with vision and purpose

• Team oriented and collaborative with an aptitude and willingness to learn

jobs.description:
Position Overview

About Fetch

At Fetch, we’re dedicated to helping pets live their healthiest and happiest lives. Our comprehensive insurance coverage is designed with modern pet parents in mind, and we’re proud to support the animal shelter community. We believe in ensuring pets receive the best care possible and are committed to making that vision a reality every day.

Fetch is a high-growth Warburg Pincus portfolio company with an expanding team of over 350 pet-loving employees working together to shape the future of pet health and wellness.

About the Industry

The pet insurance industry is more important than ever, offering peace of mind and financial protection for pet owners. The sector is expanding quickly, fueled by growing awareness of the need for accessible, high-quality veterinary care. With advances in veterinary medicine, pets now have access to the most effective treatments available, making pet insurance an essential component of modern pet care.

P&C License Preferred

Up to 75% Car Travel Required - Phoenix and Surrounding Area

We’re hiring a Travel-Focused Pet Insurance Sales Associate who thrives on movement, relationship-building, and making meaningful connections. This isn’t your typical desk job — you’ll be on the road, meeting with shelter partners in various locations, representing Fetch in person, and engaging pet parents face-to-face to share why Fetch’s coverage matters. Travel is at the heart of this role (up to 75% of your time), and candidates should be excited about the opportunity to explore different regions and expand their impact. Candidates must be willing to travel extensively and could have the option to a paid relocation to one of Fetch’s thriving regional hubs as part of this dynamic, growth-oriented position.

REQUIREMENTS

• Willing to travel, up to but not limited to, 75% in the Phoenix area

• Representing Fetch as a confident, friendly, trusted advisor to sell pet insurance policies to prospective pet parents at our partner location in the Atlanta and Jacksonville area

• Communicating competitive advantages of Fetch; demonstrating a deep understanding of Fetch and competitor pet health insurance products

• Turning prospects into loyal clients, raving fans, and repeat customers

• Accurately recording prospect and customer information in Fetch CRM

• Establishing productive, professional relationships with key personnel at our partner locations to assist in meeting performance objectives and partner expectations monthly

• Proactively assessing partner needs on an ongoing basis through onsite focus and follow-up meetings

• Collaborating with leadership to identify opportunities for new business

• Communicating with your peers via chat to identify challenges and successes

• Virtually attending monthly company meetings or check-ins as required

• Managing expense budget and submitting completed reports monthly

• Managing all administrative tasks and responsibilities relative to the partnership

• Living up to Fetch’s commitment to continuously exceed customer expectations

SKILLS

• Ability to travel to various shelters across the country. Some travel may be regional and within driving distance, while other travel may be national and require air travel

• Ability to structure your work week during peak hours a must (Friday-Sunday) when it is most lucrative for the agent

• Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license or willing to obtain a P&C license at the expense of the Company within 30 days of employment (subject to state requirements)

• Proven self-starter with 3-5 years of in an animal care role

• Energized by being an industry pioneer

• Passion for prospecting new sales opportunities on a daily basis (must enjoy speaking with people face to face)

• Familiar with animal health or animal welfare a plus, but not required

• Ability to think and act independently within a fast-paced sales cycle

• Proven success in building relationships using a consultative, solution-focused approach

• Demonstrated customer service skills and the ability to understand Fetch's customers’ needs

• Must be willing to travel to various industry events as required

• Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills

• Excellent team player; proven ability to apply innovative ideas and critical thinking

Professional Traits that are not unique to this position, but necessary for Fetch employees:

• Exhibits excellent business judgment

• Positive attitude

• Sets the bar high for team standards

• Is action and results-oriented and self-reliant

Compensation

• The pay range for this position is $55,000 - $100,000+ on a full-time basis

• Along with base salary, your position may qualify for additional bonuses

• This position is eligible for the Company’s bonus plan(s)

• Up-to $5,000 relocation fee

Benefits & Perks

At Fetch, we recognize the importance of work-life balance and prioritize our employees' mental health and well-being, ensuring everyone can flourish both professionally and personally. Not just pets, we want our employees to live their best lives too — here at Fetch, you have access to the valuable benefits listed below.

• Comprehensive Medical, dental, and vision plan for you and your family

• Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) are available

• Highly competitive 401(k) matching

• Generous 20-day PTO Policy, with rollover options. Earn an additional day of PTO each year on your anniversary with Fetch, for a maximum of 30 days

• Paid company (9) holidays, including (1) floating holiday

• Fetch Pet Insurance discount - up to 50% off, up to $1,000 savings/year

• Educational Assistance Program

• Fetch Discount Perks Program

• Volunteering - earn up to 8 hours per calendar year at nonprofit organizations

• Employee Referral Incentive

• Tuition Assistance

• Commuter Benefits

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Pay Range

$55,000—$100,000 USD

Recruiting Fraud Alert

At Fetch, your personal information and online safety are paramount. Please be aware that only Fetch Recruiters and Hiring Managers will contact you regarding your application or background. All official communications from Fetch employees will originate from a fetchpet.com email address. You will never be asked for payments, financial details, or sensitive information like social security numbers by our Recruiters or Hiring Managers.

EEO Statement

We’re committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of pet parents everywhere—hiring and developing individuals from all backgrounds and experiences to strengthen our inclusive, collaborative culture.
