jobs.title: Sr. Manager, External Reporting
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Sr. Manager, External Reporting is responsible for managing all aspects of our external SEC reporting and technical accounting, as well as direct involvement and review of the consolidation process in Oracle FCCS and ownership of certain internal reporting deliverables. The position requires a strong self-starter with an exceptional work ethic, strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal), and the ability to adapt quickly and learn new tasks independently.

Position location: Deerfield, IL - Hybrid (Flexibility to work from home Mondays and Fridays)

RESPONSIBLIITIES:

What you will be doing

• Manages the preparation of SEC filings, including Annual Form 10-K, Quarterly Form 10-Q and other required filings. Leverages monthly and quarterly business review materials in addition to other internal strategic publications to build a sound understanding of the business which enables ownership of MD&A section and all the footnotes to the financial statements.
• Responsibility for detailed review of the financial statement disclosures, the tie-out information for notes to the financial statements, and completion of disclosure controls and procedures related to internal control over financial reporting.
• Manages the accounting process around acquisitions and divestitures, including the roll forward of closing balance sheet to opening balance sheet and the preparation of technical memoranda associated with acquisition accounting.
• Provides support to Investor Relations in earnings release and other financial information.
• Manages various monthly and quarterly reporting activities including restructuring analysis, defined benefit plans review, monthly cash reports and other pertinent analyses.
• Manages in the development, maintenance, and distribution of Fortune Brands accounting policies; leading efforts with the business units in ensuring consistent application of enterprise -wide accounting policies.
• Effectively manages the relationship and process with external auditors, internal auditors and actuaries for preparation of the Company’s regulatory filings.
• Research technical accounting matters, monitors US GAAP and SEC developments, assists with company-wide implementation of new accounting pronouncements and reporting requirements.
• Assists Fortune’s business units and corporate accounting assessment of complex technical accounting matters including defined benefit plans, acquisition accounting, share based compensation, restructuring, EPS and revenue recognition.
• Manages the preparation and review of goodwill and indefinite-lived intangible asset testing.
• Manages the preparation and review of definite-lived intangible asset and long-lived asset group testing.
• Provide support or lead other key strategic projects as needed.
• Perform and/or coordinate yearly performance reviews for direct report(s) including assistance in career development where appropriate.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• B.A/B.S. in Accounting
• 7+ years of accounting experience in external reporting
• CPA
• 5+ years of management experience
• Possess technical expertise related to GAAP and external reporting including, but not limited to, SEC reporting, business combinations, pension accounting, intangible assets, revenue recognition and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements
• Demonstrated recent experience in researching and preparing technical accounting memoranda for complex issues and new pronouncements

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master’s degree
• Public Accounting experience with public company clients
• Oracle FCCS and/or SAP experience a plus

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor - Night Shift
jobs.description:
This role follows a 2nd shift schedule, working from 5:30 PM to 4:30 AM, with designated days off on Monday, Tuesday, & Wednesday.

The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the warehouse team for their shift, ensuring that each required task is executed and conducted properly and safely.  The Warehouse Supervisor is also responsible for anticipating and troubleshooting issues as they arise and managing the performance of warehouse leads and associates on their shift with little guidance; using all information available and collaborating with other stakeholders as needed.

Detailed Responsibilities

Supervision of Core Warehouse Functions:

The Warehouse Supervisor must demonstrate proficiency in all warehouse functions and processes and ensures compliance with standard procedures on a daily basis. The Warehouse Supervisor is accountable for maintaining the layout and organization of all warehouse spaces and ensuring warehouse team is creating and promoting a safe workplace.

• Receiving: Works with leads, receivers, and warehouse associates to monitor receiving activities to ensure accuracy, integrity of product and dock maintenance are all kept up to company standards. Ensures issues with facility spaces or powered industrial trucks are escalated to Maintenance team via established reporting systems. Responsible for WMS compliance of team at receipt through the putaway to storage process. Ensures all receiving processes are completed in accordance with SOP. Must be able to adapt plans and communicate effectively to the team ad hoc changes or directives that are not outlined in an SOP. Communicates any variances or issues immediately to the team and all stakeholders affected. Establishes a clear follow up timeline for root cause analysis. Ensures retraining and additional communication are conducted as needed. Conducts audits of receiving and putaway processes to ensure accuracy and compliance of execution metrics. Provides immediate feedback to team members to promote growth and development. Assesses efficiency of receiving activities and works with receivers and putaway team to improve efficiency and workflow when tasks are not being completed at expected pace.

• Issuing Product to Production:

• Ensures full utilization of WMS for product moves to and from the production / shipping floor.

• Familiarizes themselves with all trackers and inventory items to be able to verify production needs and provide guidance to team on correct product

• Stays abreast of e-mails and other forms of communication directing changes to products required for production as a result of product shorts, delivery delays, or quality issues. Supervisor is expected to communicate to warehouse team in a timely manner to preclude errors or production stops.

• Ensures warehouse drop list is utilized to pull product for the production floor

• Ensures product is placed in the correct quantity and location on floor per WMS and follows up when not meeting expectation

• Upholds standard procedures for staging product in coolers and freezers when applicable

• Must be able to read boxing call-out sheet and distinguish which meats are assigned to meals to clarify for the team and audit processes.

• Works with warehouse lead to ensure team is making progress against task list

• Works in collaboration with production management to problem solve when warehouse team responsibilities impact production efficiency

• Conducts end of shift walkthrough to make sure that end of shift clean up duties have been completed and that all items are returned to the designated locations by assignment and temperature before leaving for the day. This requires a recap to be documented and communicated to all of the warehouse team.

• Conduct audits of storage to ensure putback process adhered to by team.

• Shipping:

• Conducts check of pallet shipping sheet and the admin shipping list to verify documentation for cases shipped has been properly completed and all cases scanned in facility

• Coordinates with logistics provider to manage pick-ups; accurate loading for outbounds via “Outbound Trailer Scheduler”

• Ensures standard processes for tagging, storage, and loading of outbound pallets are followed

• Verifies all special out-bounds, such as transfers, to ensure accuracy of load and all documentation is uploaded per SOP

• Audits load sheets completed by the loaders to ensure accuracy

• Communicates all doors remaining for pick up per recap and/or dock log. Ensures all corresponding BOLs are completed and uploaded if picked up. If still pending pickup, ensure the load sheet and BOL are prepared and left for the oncoming shift.

• Logs all trailers pick up in pallet shipping sheets and ensures uploaded to file for reference.

• Ensure hourly dock checks are completed so no truck is left behind or misses dock out. Escalate and Communicate any issues to logistics and/or manager for follow-up.

Supervision of Warehouse Personnel:

The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for leading the warehouse team on their shift. Supervisory responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Adheres to safety related procedures and works with associates to create “safety first” work environment Develops an environment that is conducive to teamwork and collaboration Communicates job expectations clearly and builds departmental standards for performance Lives the Home Chef Values and models our Home Chef Competencies Manages attendance reports and follows up on assigned points and coaching Conducts rotational check-ins with all members of warehouse team to ensure all team members are progressing against task lists and communicated expectations of performance Works with team leads and associates to problem solve when issues arise Ensures that immediate and long term solutions are put in place to preclude future occurrences Escalate the issue and resolution to idea share with other shifts and other plants Ensures all warehouse associates have been properly trained to safely move materials within the facility. jobs.title: Director, FP&A Commercial
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Director of FP&A Commercial will provide support to the Finance organization and reporting to the Head of FP&A. The role will primarily support Commercial.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Lead the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range planning processes for the various Commercial functions, ensuring alignment between financial objectives and business strategy

• Develop and maintain robust financial models, forecasts, and business analytics to evaluate revenue performance, pricing strategies and growth opportunities

• Review material business terms & conditions on vendor agreements, contracts and purchase requisitions

• Develop NPV, forecasting and revenue modeling for indications prior to launch, providing data-driven assumptions for early Commercial planning

• Partner with Accounting to assist with monthly & quarter-end close processes for expenses and accruals, budget vs. actual analysis and compliance with internal controls

• Help drive continuous improvement within the Finance organization to streamline processes, improve communication, and enhance the flow of information to the business.

• Ensure associated financial risks and opportunities both near and longer-term are identified and periodically reviewed

• All other duties as assigned

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field required

• A minimum of 12+ years of life science industry experience

• Demonstratable experience of working within a fast-paced finance function

• Strong critical thinking skills and understanding of budgeting, planning and projection processes

• Strong Excel and financial systems experience, with the ability to manipulate and interpret key financial data

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

• Demonstratable experience of prioritizing workload and managing multiple tight deadlines effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to forge strong internal and external working relationships, and the confidence to challenge information constructively

• Enthusiastic team player with an approachable manner and an ability to engage with colleagues across the business with a constructive and can-do attitude to deliver the successful completion of team outputs within required deadlines

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$205,000—$220,000 USD

This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

Over the past twelve months, we’ve seen rapidly growing demand for software engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep technical work, customer impact, and product strategy. As Fin, becomes mission-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re building a team of Forward Deployed Software Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with some of Fin’s most strategic customers, partnering closely with our R&D and Go-to-Market teams to design and deliver high-impact solutions. You’ll go beyond implementation — helping shape product direction, influencing roadmap decisions, and ensuring Fin delivers real, measurable business outcomes in complex, real-world environments.

If you’re excited by ownership, creativity, and solving ambiguous problems, and you want to work at the frontier of applied AI while collaborating with world-class Product, Engineering, and GTM teams, this role offers a rare opportunity to combine technical excellence with real customer impact.

What will I be doing?

• Drive adoption of Fin by helping prospects unlock the power of our AI capabilities to automate and scale their support operations.

• Embed deeply with strategic customers to understand their business challenges and technical requirements, and provide the insight needed to achieve outstanding results with Fin.

• Work hands-on with customers’ technical teams as a trusted technical expert, coding side-by-side to drive projects through to completion.

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Success, and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, successful project delivery, and actionable product feedback.

• Contribute to the evolution of the Forward Deployed Software Engineering function by codifying best practices and sharing insights from customer engagements to help the team scale and grow.

What skills do I need?

• Strong engineering background, preferably in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering or Physics.

• Experience building a SaaS product with real-world usage. Bonus points for former founders or early startup engineers.

• You’re interested in AI/ML and enjoy quickly building a strong understanding of novel problems, capabilities, and architectures — including the trade-offs and limitations involved.

• You bring strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organizational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and for Intercom.

• You’re a strong coder. You have deep knowledge of at least one high-level programming language (for example, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, etc.). It doesn’t need to be a language we use today — great people are effective learners and are quick to pick up new tools or introduce better ways of working.

• You’re able to prototype and ship software quickly, while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes.

• You’re proficient in using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively.

• You’re a strong communicator who can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non-technical audiences, adapting depth and detail as needed.

• You’re willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build strong relationships and develop a deep understanding of their needs.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $180,000 - $200,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

Accessories serve as the interface with the da Vinci system and enable safe and effective robotic-assisted surgery. They may be reusable or single-use medical devices (consumables), with yearly volumes in the millions. Our customers interact directly with accessories in every surgical procedure, and they serve a critical role in customer satisfaction and patient outcomes.

The Sr. Mechanical Engineer will work on product development of a variety of Accessories. The successful candidate must excel in a fast-paced team environment and be capable of creative problem solving when faced with the time pressures and design constraints typical of product development. They must have a strong sense of ownership, shared responsibility, commitment to high product quality and be comfortable collaborating across organizational boundaries. Projects will include a mix of product improvements, component enhancements, cost savings and manufacturing improvements to enable significant volume growth.

Essential Job Duties

• Provide mechanical engineering sustaining support for resolution of manufacturing and field issues:Characterize sources of variations in product performance and implement mitigations accordingly.Investigate and determine root cause of design, manufacturing, or material issues.Resolve complex engineering challenges through hands-on product testing and collaborate with subject matter experts both internal and external to organization.Perform complex tolerance stack analyses to evaluate potential failures or performance concerns
• Design, develop and document components and assemblies for surgical system accessories:Review and understand product functional and design specifications.Create, analyze, and test product designs and their components.Research, understand and design to relevant product specific standards.Develop, implement, test, and document solutions that meet clinical, functional and product requirements.Designing for manufacturing and automation, sterilization processes and biocompatibility.
• Provide mechanical engineering expertise to support continuous production of high-quality surgical accessories to our customers:Collaborate with manufacturing, purchasing, test engineering, and supplier engineering to facilitate transfer of designs into production.Develop components and product mechanical drawings in a regulated environment for high volume manufacturing processes, including plastic injection molding, thermoset compression molding, machining.Develop Design History Files per FDA requirements.Adept in risk management and design control documentation.

• Support design for automation such that our product designs can enable technologies that allow volumes to continue to grow year over year.
• Help establish individual and team goals aligned with overall project and company goals.

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 8 years of medical product experience (Prior sustaining experience in high volume product preferred)
• Proficiency using CAD to design parts and assemblies and to create specification drawings in a PDM environment; Solidworks strongly preferred.
• Experience with complex interface compatibility and tolerance analysis
• Strong working knowledge of GD&T
• Ability to communicate effectively and accurately (written and oral) across all levels and functions, including presenting to a technical audience.
• Demonstrated ability to think at a systems level, interface between multiple design groups, and negotiate conflicting requirements.
• A passion for solving tough technical problems - Strong mechanical intuition and persistence to drill down to pinpoint root cause of problems, solving problems using fundamental principles.

Required Education and Training

B.S. Mechanical or Biomedical Engineer (or equivalent) required, MS preferred.

Working Conditions

Ability to Travel up to 10%

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Proven experience with design for assembly, manufacturing, and automation. Experience working on products with volumes in the 10’s of millions is preferred.
• Demonstrated knowledge of materials (preferably plastics, silicones, polyurethanes, isoprenes) and material properties. Ability to apply knowledge of engineering materials and component selection criteria to product designs through strong concept development, design analysis, hands-on prototyping, and reliability testing skills.
• Comfortable with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer.
• Comfortable with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, and risk analysis

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What you'll be doing

• Design and develop solutions to applications, system administration, or network issues.

• Design, develop, and test product features that meet business and technical requirements of NetSuite ERP modules and workflows.

• Work with Scrum Master, Product Owners, and other company stakeholders to understand business requirements, policies, and procedures.

• Full lifecycle implementation of core and Advanced NetSuite modules.

• Triage and correct performance and/or data integrity concerns by reviewing and evaluating code, data patches, system logs, and process/memory/disk consumption utilization.

• Design for scale and reliability.

• Engage in problem solving, including external and internal customer problems.

You are required to have

• Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

• 2 years of experience in the position, as a Senior Systems Engineer, Software Developer Analyst, or a related occupation.

• Will also accept a Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field and 5 years of progressive experience in the position, as a Senior Systems Engineer, Software Developer Analyst or a related occupation.

• Must have at least 2 years of prior work experience in the following: NetSuite ERP (Administration and Development) with NetSuite GL, Fixed Assets, OM, AR, Purchasing & AP. Developing and managing NetSuite workflows, custom records, fields, forms, and advanced PDFs, Saved Searches, Advanced Reporting, SuiteAnalytics, custom reports, KPIs, and dashboards. Designing, developing, and testing NetSuite ERP applications, customizing NetSuite ERP modules, and developing NetSuite ERP Workflows to fit business requirements. Analyze business requirements, identify problems, propose and develop technical solutions, gather detailed needs from stakeholders, and support ongoing enhancements through close interaction with business users. Implement, enhance, and integrate NetSuite with global platforms and third-party applications, including Concur, Certa, FxLoader, Tungsten, and similar enterprise systems. SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (REST & SOAP), Suitelets, RESTlets, SQL, MySQL, HTML, CSS, XML, JSON, JavaScript, SDF, ODBC, Git/GitHub, Postman, JIRA, Confluence, Visual Studio, and DBeaver.

Up to one day per week telecommuting may be permitted.

#LI-DNI

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

jobs.description:
About Routeware, Inc.

Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs. Our solutions help organizations save time and money, increase efficiency, improve safety and help make our world a greener place.

Based in Portland, Oregon, the company employs a distributed team across North America and the UK. Our brands, products, and services provide an all-in-one platform to municipal and private waste haulers and other fleet services. As part of an essential and growing industry, we seek solution-oriented team players who want to positively impact the environment. Our work environment is collaborative, dynamic, fast-paced, and fun with a strong appreciation for innovation and initiative.

Our Mission:

• Transform waste collection to drive a better future for generations to come.

Our Values:

• Adaptability - The waste industry and technology are ever-changing, and the Routeware team never stops adapting to be at the forefront of technology innovation, supporting our customers to stay ahead.
• Mission-driven - At Routeware, it matters to us that our work has a lasting positive impact on our customers' outcomes, our fellow team members' well-being, and the long-term sustainability of our environment.
• Human-first - While technology drives our products; the real, live, caring people at Routeware are the true drivers of meaningful outcomes for our customers.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Escalation-level technical support role covering Routeware’s core platforms — RCC (SQL Server routing/waste management) and SmartCities (MySQL municipal fleet/waste management SaaS). Combines database investigation, SQL report development, and fleet hardware troubleshooting to resolve issues front-line support can’t, and to fix root causes.

RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

• Troubleshoot fleet hardware: Howen MDVR/DVR units, Android tablets (rwMobile), and RFID readers
• Track and document escalations in Jira using established issue-type conventions
• Build/maintain internal tools and references to speed up investigations

QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong SQL skills (SQL Server and MySQL), including complex joins and root-cause query debugging
• Experience investigating data integrity issues in a production, customer-facing system
• Comfort troubleshooting in-vehicle hardware/software integrations
• Ticketing system experience (Jira or similar)
• Strong root-cause analysis and clear technical communication

PREFERRED

• Routing, fleet, or municipal software background
• GPS/telematics data experience
• Experience building internal tooling to support investigations

BENEFITS

• Medical and Dependent FSA
• 401K match
• Unlimited PTO
• Ten company holidays
• 1 Volunteer day

jobs.title: Recovery Support Specialist-Full Time
jobs.description:
Location: DeKalb

Full time, 40 hours per week

Sun/Monday 7-3:30pm

Tues-Thursday 3-11:30pm

Department description:

The Living Room is a space provided by Northwestern Medicine Ben Gordon Center for people to address crises as an alternative to going to an emergency department.

The Recovery Support Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Uses personal and training experience to create a safe space for consumers to calmly process crisis events, learn and apply wellness strategies, and prevent future crisis events. As a member of a multidisciplinary team, the Peer Recovery specialist operates from the Crisis Now concept and focuses on practices including recovery orientation, trauma-informed care, and a philosophy that crises are an opportunity for learning.   All services are designed to proactively divert crises and break the cycle of hospitalizations.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as an individual advocate for consumers.
• Utilize training and personal recovery experiences to provide peer support for consumers.
• Provide recovery information and activities to all consumers; information, resources and connection to natural supports; and must follow principles of trauma informed care.
• Assess and evaluate consumer’s needs, strengths, goals, and resources.
• As directed, transports consumers to and from home, appointments, meetings, and/or school.
• Advocate within systems to promote person centered recovery support services. Work with an interdisciplinary team in reviewing cases and developing individual plans.
• Implement individual service plans through rehabilitation services such as case management, advocacy, outreach, skills training groups (i.e. WRAP), social rehabilitation, and community support as indicated.
• Provide linkage case management, participate in treatment planning and discharge planning.
• Consult with other staff regarding assessment and treatment/intervention planning. Consults with licensed hospital professionals regarding clinical situations and maintains close communication with supervisor.
• Consult with other service agencies around case-specific and programmatic issues.
• Refer and link consumers to other human service programs and care providers as indicated.
• Serve as a liaison to other community agencies as needed.
• Build relationships with local police, fire, emergency departments, and other organizations to promote awareness of Living Room services.
• Provide on-site support and introduction to services to patients within the hospital and outpatient settings (e.g. Emergency Department, Medical Floors, etc.).
• Train other providers and non-providers in areas related to service specialties.
• Document service provision as required by NM standards.
• Maintain clinical and management records in accordance with established policies and procedures.
• Demonstrate ability to meet the productivity requirements set in accordance with program goals.
• Attend required staff and other meetings
• Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School Diploma or equivalent

Licensure:

• Valid Driver's License
• Proof of auto insurance.

Certification:

• Upon completion of 2,000 supervised work hours, the Recovery Support Specialist is required to obtain their Certified Recovery Support Specialist (CRSS) credential.

Experience:

• Recovery Support Specialists should be able to articulate their personal experience in recovery when working with patients who are experiencing mental health and/or drug/alcohol issues as it relates to providing peer support services to these patient populations.
• Annual Driving Abstract

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in behavioral health related field
• One year experience working with individuals suffering from severe mental illness and/or drug and alcohol issues.
• Experience with Medicaid Rule 132/140
• Knowledge and understanding of SUPR 2060
• Certified Recovery Support Specialist (CRSS)
• Wellness Recovery Action Planning classes (WRAP)
• Certified WRAP facilitator

Additional Information

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Qualitative Market Research
jobs.description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

Konovo's solutions empower organizations to make data-driven decisions that enhance patient outcomes and streamline healthcare processes. We supply healthcare organizations with real-time access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest available anywhere in the world. Our 300+ employees are spread across 25 U.S. states and five countries, collaborating to support some of the largest organizations in the healthcare industry. Our customers include over 300 leading global pharmaceutical, medical device, market research agency, and consultancy companies.

As we shift to a more product and technology-driven organization our team’s work to provide best-in-class services to our customers is more important than ever before, and we are expanding our remote Client Services team in Bosnia and Herzegovina. We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager, Qualitative to oversee and manage the full project lifecycle - from project commission to invoice. We’re transforming as a business and in this role, you’ll get to collaborate with every function in our organization and be a connector who partners broadly to help delight customers and grow our business.

If you are a client-focused, results-driven, and detail-oriented market research professional looking to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!

How You’ll Make an Impact:

• Project Management: Lead and manage multiple global market research projects from proposal acceptance through final invoicing, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meeting client expectations.

• Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, understanding their needs, managing expectations, and providing strategic recommendations throughout the project lifecycle.

• Problem-Solving: Identify potential risks and challenges, proactively addressing issues to keep projects on track and identify growth opportunities for our business

• Bid and Proposal Development: Work closely with sales and research teams to develop competitive and compelling research proposals, pricing strategies, and project feasibility assessments.

• Quality Control: Implement best practices and quality control measures to maintain high standards in data accuracy, reporting, and client satisfaction.

• Operational Execution: Oversee all aspects of project execution, including survey programming, translations, data collection, and field reporting, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

• Budget & Financial Management: Track project budgets, manage costs, and invoicing to ensure accurate and timely financial processing.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless execution and delivery of projects.

What We’re Looking For:

• Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of qualitative market research project management experience, in a client-facing role. Prior healthcare experience is a must.

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations effectively both to internal and external stakeholders.

• Client-First Mindset: Exceptional ability to build and maintain client relationships with a focus on delivering value and results.

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in market research tools, methodologies, and project management software (e.g., Decipher, Confirmit, Salesforce, MS applications, etc.).

• Attention to Detail: Highly organized with strong analytical skills and the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

• Problem-Solving Ability: Adept at identifying challenges and developing creative, data-driven solutions.

• Results-Driven: Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment, ensuring projects align with company and client goals.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• AI-Enabled Tools: Comfortable leveraging AI-enabled tools to streamline workflows, improve response quality, and increase speed without compromising data integrity or customer experience.

Why Konovo?

• Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions and industry-leading services that transform healthcare insights.

• Be part of a mission-driven company that is revolutionizing healthcare decision-making.

• Join a fast-growing global team with career advancement opportunities.

• Thrive in a collaborative, remote work environment that values innovation and flexibility.

• Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organizations innovate faster.

If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to be part of our journey.

jobs.title: Director, TA Operations & Enablement
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Lead the transformation of Appian's global talent acquisition infrastructure by modernizing systems, implementing structured assessments, and driving operational excellence that accelerates hiring quality across a high-growth AI-Powered Process Automation company.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The People Team at Appian is the strategic engine behind our rapid growth in the AI-Powered Process Automation market. This team owns the end-to-end talent acquisition infrastructure that enables Appian to attract, assess, and onboard world-class talent across engineering, sales, customer success, and corporate functions. You will have significant autonomy to modernize our TA operations, influence hiring strategy, and scale systems that directly impact our ability to compete for top talent in a competitive landscape.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Appian is scaling fast in Enterprise-Grade Orchestration, and hiring speed and quality are central to winning that market. This role owns the challenge of building a scalable, automated, candidate-centric TA operation that keeps pace with growth without sacrificing quality. You'll have executive visibility, a clear mandate to modernize our infrastructure, and the resources to change how Appian hires globally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Architect and implement a structured assessment framework that standardizes candidate evaluation, reduces bias, and improves hiring quality across all functions and regions.

• Partner with the Global Head of TA to deliver strategic initiatives, building credibility with recruiters, hiring managers, and partners through transparent communication and reliable execution.

• Drive TA operational excellence through SOP development, data audits, and process governance that ensures consistent execution across the function.

• Partner with Technology, Legal, Finance, and HRBPs to modernize the recruiting tech stack: prioritize Greenhouse feature adoption, deploy Appian-built automation, design and deploy reporting that supports global TA efforts, and troubleshoot system integrations to lift recruiter efficiency against measurable benchmarks.

• Manage and develop a high-performing TA operations team by coaching talent, setting clear performance expectations, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Education: Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher

• Operations Leadership: 12+ years of progressive product or operations leadership experience in enterprise environments, with at least 5 years within HR or Talent Acquisition functions.

• Assessment Expertise: At least 2 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and optimizing structured assessment platforms and candidate selection frameworks that drive hiring quality.

• Workflow Design: Demonstrated success designing and scaling tailored workflows and operational models across varied business functions and international regions.

• Execution Excellence: Proven history of operating as an execution machine, staying ahead of the ask, owning projects end-to-end, and taking personal accountability for outcomes.

• People Leadership: Proven success managing, coaching, and developing talent with a track record of building high-performing teams.

• Technical Capability: Demonstrated history of hands-on capability including building workflow maps, configuring system rules, auditing data, writing SOPs, and troubleshooting technical integrations.

• Technology Expertise: Deep expertise in enterprise ATS/CRM platforms such as Greenhouse, SuccessFactors, or Workday, and recruiting automation tools including AI sourcing/screening, assessment tools, scheduling platforms, and candidate engagement technologies.

• Vendor Management: Proven experience overseeing TA vendor ecosystems, conducting audits, leading contract negotiations, enforcing SLAs, and driving operational accountability.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• User-Centric Design: Experience in user-centric design principles applied to talent acquisition systems and candidate experience optimization.

• Greenhouse Platform: Direct experience with Greenhouse ATS configuration, optimization, and advanced feature implementation.

• Recruitment Marketing: Experience in recruitment marketing strategies, employer branding campaigns, and candidate engagement initiatives.

• Analytics: Experience in reporting and analytics within TA or other operational domain

The base salary range represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. jobs.title: Civil / Highway Engineer – Roadway Design Technical Lead (See New Rates!)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a motivated and experienced Civil/Highway Engineer- Senior Roadway Designer to join our roadway design team, with specific familiarity with the South Carolina Department of Transportation (SCDOT) design standards, manuals and processes. The successful candidate will perform design of highway/roadway projects from preliminary through final construction plan stages, prepare right-of-way (ROW) plan sets, coordinate utility relocations, and produce technical design deliverables in accordance with SCDOT and AASHTO standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and review roadway design plans including alignments, typical sections, cross-sections, profiles and geometric layouts consistent with SCDOT’s Roadway Design Manual and Plan Preparation Guide.
• Develop and document design calculations for roadway geometry, drainage systems, earthwork, pavement design, slopes, and other roadway features.
• Produce construction plans, specifications and cost estimates (PS&E) for state and local roadway projects, including maintenance of traffic (MOT), signing & pavement marking, and right-of-way plan development.
• Coordinate subsurface utility engineering (SUE) activities, utility relocations, right-of-way acquisitions and provide input for related plan sheets.
• Use CAD/design software (MicroStation, GEOPAK/OpenRoads, Civil3D, etc.) to prepare and finalize plan sets, profiles, cross sections and quantity summaries.
• Collaborate with multi-discipline teams (traffic, drainage/hydraulics, bridge/structures, survey, environmental) to ensure integrated design solutions.
• Conduct field reviews, attend stakeholder meetings, assist with public information meetings and interface with SCDOT, consultants and contractors as necessary.
• Perform quality control checks on design deliverables to ensure adherence to internal standards and SCDOT policies.
• Mentor junior engineers and technicians; assist in project scheduling, resource management and client/agency coordination.
• Stay current on SCDOT, AASHTO and FHWA policies, manuals and industry best practices; maintain awareness of emerging roadway design tools and processes.

Working Conditions & Environment

• Office environment with periodic field visits to project sites (construction, surveying, field review).
• Some travel within South Carolina may be required.
• Occasional after-hours or high-priority deadlines on state projects may necessitate extended hours.

Career Growth & Opportunities

This position offers strong opportunities for professional growth in transportation design, particularly working on SCDOT projects that impact the region’s infrastructure. Successful candidates may advance to Senior Designer or Project Manager roles, lead multi-discipline teams and take on higher‐profile highway/bridge projects.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering plus six (6) years of roadway/highway design experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience
• Exposure to state DOT projects in South Carolina
• Familiarity with SCDOT roadway design manuals and plan preparation guidelines
• Proficiency in design software such as MicroStation, GEOPAK/OpenRoads Designer, AutoCAD Civil3D, and MS Office tools
• Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred or ability to obtain within 12 months of hire

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in South Carolina
• 8 + years of experience
• Experience preparing right-of-way plans, coordinating SUE and utility relocation with SCDOT projects
• Experience with alternative delivery methods (design-build, on-call roadway design contracts) and knowledge of SCDOT procurement/contracting processes
• Experience in drainage/hydraulics design, MOT planning, stormwater management and rehabilitation of existing roadways
• Familiarity with ProjectWise, Bluebeam Revu, or other document management/collaboration tools
• Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills; ability to work collaboratively in multi-discipline teams

Relocation assistance is not available.

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. jobs.title: Senior Proteomics Scientist
jobs.description:
This scientist has a proven track record of cellular and molecular proteomics, analytical chemistry and/or biochemistry to play a key supporting role in the MS-based proteomics group in the Exploratory Biomarkers team. The scientist will contribute to the development of proteomic workflows using robotics and automated liquid handlers with the outcome to accelerating and alleviating the manual-intensive aspects of sample prep increasing throughput and depth. The candidate will apply new and established workflows to biological systems and various sample types (tissues, biofluids and cells) for biomarker discovery and mechanism of action studies.

• Contribute to innovative therapeutic platforms and apply cutting-edge proteomic technologies for disease profiling and biomarker discovery
• Generate proteomic datasets for disease profiling and mechanism of action studies
• Assist in instrument troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs
• Work with cross-functional teams and across different therapeutic areas and academic collaborators on these projects

Required Education, Experience, Skills and Certifications

• MS and 3+ years or equivalent, BS with 5+ years relevant lab experience in biochemistry, proteomics, analytical chemistry, or related field in academic, pharma or biotech industry, or PhD with 0-1 years postgraduate experience
• Hands-on experience with proteomics, minimum 1 year of hands-on lab experience
• Quick to learn new systems and processes, with a focus on continuous improvement
• Strong organizational and communication skills with a high attention to detail
• Able to conduct experiments and analyze data independently
• Strong time management skills
• Good team player
• Skilled at managing multiple priorities and building strong cross-functional relationships
• Able to help maintain various lab instruments
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)

Preferred Education, Experience, Skills and Certifications

• Experience using an electronic lab notebook
• Cell Culture experience
• Experience communicating results in small group meetings and/or in reports
• Sample preparation of limited tissue samples with Ultrasensitive proteomics

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

The Senior Solution Architect (Sr. SA) is a highly visible, strategic, and tactical role that requires business acumen, technical creativity, and industry experience. This is a technical position where you will assist our sales and project teams in helping them craft innovative cloud-based solutions using integrator.io, Celigo’s iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service). Secondarily, you will also be working directly with customers to provide strategic integration architectural designs, business process assessments, and roadmaps for their implementations using integrator.io.

What would you do if hired?

• Work independently, or as part of a larger sales team, to utilize your industry experience and creativity in crafting cloud-based solutions around SaaS and legacy application integrations. The solutions that you will craft will include web application integrations, complex business process automation, integration between cloud applications or between cloud and on-premises applications, etc.

• Conduct customer and partner scoping sessions that probe their business needs and craft a workable, technical solution using Celigo products and services.

• Write requirements and design documents that define the solution, method of integration, assumptions, customizations, and use cases.

• Be the voice of the customer internally, helping shape our product design and delivery.

• Provide design documents, business process assessments, change orders, and other deliverables during customer projects in the Solution Architect role, working with a project team and project manager.

• Architect repeatable solutions that can be productized or reused by service teams or partners.

• Be assigned to consulting projects to work directly with customers on their short- and long-term integration projects to provide high-level architecture designs, roadmaps, and be the subject matter expert on how best to utilize Celigo products.

Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

• Genuinely curious about new integration patterns, LLM-based architectures, and emerging platforms. You build this knowledge before a deal requires it, and treat unfamiliar technology as something to dig into rather than avoid.

• Comfortable applying AI as part of daily work, whether that's using it to prototype a solution faster, draft a first pass at requirements, or explore how an LLM integration might fit a customer's use case.

• Connects technical decisions back to what the customer is actually trying to achieve, and can explain the bigger picture to both the sales team and the customer.

• Ships a workable solution design quickly, gathers real feedback, and iterates, rather than holding out for the perfect architecture before showing anyone.

• Takes ownership of the customer's success beyond the scope of a single deliverable. If something needs to move, you move it without waiting to be asked.

• Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact well with all team members and external customers.

• Strong problem-solving skills to take abstract ideas and business use cases and translate them into both process and technical solutions.

• Ability to handle a variety of assignments simultaneously, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain a high standard of attention to detail, working independently as needed.

Education & Experience

• 10+ years of combined industry experience in enterprise software implementation, technical consulting, sales engineering or solution consulting, or business process consulting.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. MBA or MSIS preferred.

• A technical background is required. This isn't a coding role, but a deep understanding of integration technologies such as file transfer protocols, SOA, and Web Services APIs is a must.

• Solid knowledge of business operations (quote to cash, supply chain management, procure to pay, accounting, etc.).

• Hands-on experience with CRM, ERP, or eCommerce systems such as SAP (Hana, Business One), NetSuite, Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Shopify, or Amazon.

• Experience leading integration teams and designing enterprise-scale integration solutions preferred.

• Understanding of LLM models and how to integrate with existing systems preferred.

• Knowledge of API lifecycle management, prior SaaS/On Demand application experience, and EDI knowledge for trading partner transactions are all a plus.

• Extensive experience working with external customers in a pre-sales or consulting role.

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $140,000 and $165,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

• Celigo is the #1 ranked iPaaS platform (G2, 8 quarters running)

• Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year

• Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management

• Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

• Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency

• A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented

• Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field

• Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily

• Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

• Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)

• Wellness days and holidays to recharge

• Parental leave and a generous benefits package

• Monthly tech stipend

• Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. jobs.description:

training and mentoring by the QA/QC Vice President. The Quality Director participates in submittal and shop drawing reviews, initial trade pre-construction meetings, trade pre-installation meetings, and frequent

job site walkthroughs and reporting.  Oversees construction quality through the process until completion.

• Develop and facilitate quality training sessions/education.
• Lead job site pre-installation meetings with the teams and provide a solid level of competency with the processes.
• Lead the field of Quality and demonstrate leadership throughout the industry.
• Manage subcontractor quality plans - perform a review and give detailed analysis and feedback to the subcontractor.

• If necessary, research building materials, ensure compliance of materials, suggest/incorporate changes in materials as necessary.

• Provide technical advice to field and office personnel and keep accurate records of the conversations.
• Serve as a resource to project teams to identify potential quality issues and identify remediation.

• Management Program.

• Maintain and update revisions of the Quality Program and associated quality policies and manual.

About Construction Management – AECOM Hunt

Founded in 1944 in Indianapolis, Indiana, AECOM Hunt has been building for over 70 years. AECOM Hunt’s storied history has encompassed many notable projects in the automotive industry; iconic sports stadiums; a broad portfolio in transportation; and many repeat clients in the hospitality industry. From iconic stadiums and arenas, next-gen transportation hubs and sustainable healthcare and academic buildings, AECOM Hunt’s expertise, leadership and dedication are unparalleled.

• BS Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related curriculum and 10 years of professional Construction Quality Management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership.

• Understanding of the multiple building codes, requirements, etc.
• Experience in all construction-related trades, including building envelopes, life safety, interiors, MEP/FP.
• Experience in large construction, ground-up projects in: Aviation/airport
• 10 years of Construction Quality Management experience.
• Construction building envelope experience.

• The following physical demands represent those typically required of individuals working in construction field roles, with or without accommodation. Construction field positions require physical stamina and mobility, including the ability to climb ladders and stairs, use personnel hoists, and move through various terrain and active construction zones. Vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. These environments may include proximity to heavy machinery, elevated work areas, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and potential electrical risks. Noise levels may vary from moderate to high depending on the phase of construction. Employees may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and must remain alert to ensure safety. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on the scope and progress of the project.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Products & Delivery
jobs.description:
AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Research (IR) organization is seeking a Manager, Data Products & Delivery to lead a team responsible for delivering curated data products within ARCH, AbbVie’s R&D Convergence Hub. As part of the DELOS team — Data Exploration and Linked Outcome Solutions — this role helps build the trusted, well-curated, AI-ready data foundation needed to advance analytics, reporting, knowledge graph capabilities, and AI-enabled use cases across R&D.

In this role, you will lead a blended team of direct employees and contractors, including data engineers and data curation specialists, accountable for high-quality, well-documented, reusable data products. The team’s work spans data curation, data quality, data modeling, metadata, governance, documentation, pipeline coordination, and execution. You will guide day-to-day priorities, lead data curation decisions, coordinate work across initiatives, remove barriers, and help ensure solutions are reliable and aligned with business, scientific, and platform needs.

Working closely with business stakeholders, platform teams, architects, and data owners, you will help translate business and scientific needs into reliable data delivery plans, support data standards, and help drive continuous improvement across data management processes and workflows. You will partner with the Associate Director – Data Strategy, AI & Knowledge Enablement to execute priorities and support the successful delivery of ARCH data initiatives.

This role is an opportunity to lead a team at the center of AbbVie’s R&D data transformation, helping deliver trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that improve how research data is accessed, connected, understood, and used across the organization.

Responsibilities:

• Data Product Leadership: Lead planning and execution for curated, reusable, and AI-ready data products across multiple projects and workstreams. Translate business and scientific needs into clear priorities, coordinate timelines and dependencies, manage risks, and ensure outcomes are practical, scalable, and aligned to stakeholder needs.
• Technical Coordination & Issue Resolution: Coordinate with data engineers, architects, platform teams, and data owners to resolve blockers, manage dependencies, support timely decisions, and ensure teams have the clarity needed to execute effectively.
• Team Leadership & People Development: Mentor, supervise, and coordinate employees, contractors, and external partners supporting data curation, data modeling, engineering, and delivery activities. Set clear expectations, provide feedback, support development, and foster an inclusive, accountable team culture.
• Operating Rhythm & Continuous Improvement: Establish and maintain team operating rhythms, including backlog health, sprint ceremonies, progress visibility, and issue escalation. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, documentation, and consistency across data product workflows.
• Data Curation Decision Leadership: Lead decisions related to data curation standards, quality expectations, metadata, lineage, documentation, and reusable data practices. Partner with stakeholders to prioritize remediation activities that improve trust, usability, and consistency.
• Stakeholder, Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Partner with business, scientific, technology, platform, vendor, and external-partner stakeholders to understand priorities, align plans, communicate risks and dependencies, and support relationships that advance organizational goals.
• Compliance & Standards: Ensure team activities follow AbbVie policies, data governance standards, software development lifecycle practices, data security expectations, and relevant compliance requirements.

Required:

• Bachelor's Degree in information technology, data engineering, data management, analytics, life sciences, or any related field with 7 years’ experience; Master's Degree with 6 years’ experience; PhD with 2 years’ experience.
• Experience mentoring, supervising, or coordinating technical team members, including employees, contractors, vendors, or external partners.
• Experience leading technical delivery in data engineering, data management, data platform, or analytics environments.
• Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, resolve technical and delivery challenges, manage priorities across concurrent workstreams, and keep stakeholders informed through clear written and verbal communication.
• Experience managing delivery using Agile practices and planning tools such as Jira, including backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery tracking.
• Experience applying data quality, metadata management, governance, lineage, and data modeling practices to support trusted, reusable data products.
• Working knowledge of modern data platforms, data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, cloud technologies, SQL-based environments, data warehousing or lakehouse patterns, analytics enablement, and AI-ready data delivery practices.
• Experience collaborating with cross-functional business, scientific, technical, platform, vendor, or external-partner teams.
• Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to translate priorities, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Data product leadership, with the ability to translate priorities into clear plans, guide execution, remove barriers, and support practical decisions across business and scientific use cases.
• People leadership and team coordination, including expectation setting, feedback, development support, and inclusive team practices.
• Operating discipline across Agile planning, backlog prioritization, sprint execution, progress tracking, risk management, and issue escalation.
• Stakeholder communication and influence, with the ability to translate priorities, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for technical and non-technical audiences.
• Data curation and stewardship mindset, with attention to quality, metadata, documentation, lineage, standards, and trusted reusable data practices.
• Technical fluency with modern data platforms, pipelines, integration patterns, orchestration, cloud-based data environments, and AI-ready data practices sufficient to partner effectively with technical teams.

Preferred:

• Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience preferred.
• Experience supporting research, clinical, scientific, or life sciences data environments.
• Familiarity with graph databases, knowledge graphs, ontology-based data structures, or linked-data concepts.
• Experience working with AWS/Azure-based or cloud-based data platforms.
• Experience working with regulated data environments, including data governance, documentation, security, or compliance expectations.
• Exposure to analytics, machine learning, AI-enabled use cases, or AI-ready data product delivery.
