jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Sr. Sales Engineer for, you will be the go-to product and technical expert for Alpaca's enterprise partners across. You will bridge technical and business conversations: a customer-facing engineer with strong API knowledge, experience supporting enterprise customers, fluency in Mandarin for customer interactions, and sufficient English proficiency to collaborate effectively with our global team. You will support enterprise partners and expand our base of enterprise partners, acting as the technical bridge between local partners, vendors, and regulators and Alpaca's global engineering team.

What you will do:

• Provide technical support and relationship management for existing enterprise customers, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the partner lifecycle.

• Partner with the Sales and Solutions teams on pre-sales technical discussions, solution design, and API consultations, and present compelling product and technical use cases to prospective clients.

• Guide new enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, and onboarding.

• Act as the voice of customers by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve localized experiences; translate complex business and technical requirements into clear specifications for Alpaca's global engineering team.

• Serve as the product and technical subject matter expert, capable of thoroughly understanding and articulating all aspects of the Alpaca platform to diverse audiences and stakeholders.

• Work closely with local compliance and operations teams to understand local and regional product requirements.

• Own technical sales engagement end-to-end: discovery calls, solution validation, RFPs, and security questionnaires that win deals; lead demo strategy and execution.

• Create sales support materials and documentation for new features and products, where needed.

• Coordinate with local regulators, vendors, and partners, and relay those requirements to global product and engineering.

• Help customers successfully adopt Alpaca's platform while maintaining a high standard of technical and customer support; travel as needed.

• Stay updated on internal product development timelines and work closely with the product team to test and roll out new features to partners.

What we look for (Must-Haves):

• Experience supporting enterprise / B2B customers in a technical, sales engineering, or solutions engineering role (typically 5+ years), ideally at API or SaaS-first companies.

• Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, and software integration workflows; hands-on experience with APIs, WebSockets, Postman, Grafana, and JSON.

• Able to translate complex technical concepts into simple, understandable terms.

• Self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, manages multiple assignments simultaneously, works independently, and drives projects to completion with close attention to detail.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):

• Experience in fintech, capital markets, brokerage, or financial APIs; experience at a Broker-Dealer or securities firms.

• Knowledge of brokerage, post-trade, and settlement operations, as well as regulatory context.

• Closing enterprise deals alongside Account Executives.

• US securities qualifications (e.g., SIE and/or Series 7).

• Familiarity with Metabase.

• Experience working with the FIX protocol.

• Experience working with OpenAPI, ReadMe, and documentation.

• Excited to learn more about the securities industry.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Internship 2027 Hardware Engineer, Machine Integration & Test
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Getting an autonomy stack onto a 40-ton excavator is a hardware problem long before it's a software one — brackets, harnesses, enclosures, and interfaces that survive vibration, dust, and weather. As our Machine Integration intern, you'll design and build the physical interfaces between our system and the machine, plus the test stands we use to prove them out before they ever hit a jobsite.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Integrate sensors, compute, and wiring onto machines alongside the hardware team

 - Design brackets, enclosures, and interface hardware in CAD, then help fabricate and install them

 - Build test stands for validating subsystems on the bench instead of in the field

 - Run lab tests, capture data, and iterate on designs based on what breaks

 - Document build and install procedures so the next machine goes faster than the last

 - Close the loop with the field team on what's working and what isn't


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


REQUIRED

 - Currently pursuing a BS or MS in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, or a related field — or bringing equivalent hands-on experience

 - CAD proficiency (SolidWorks, Onshape, or similar)

 - Genuine hands-on shop skills — you've built physical things, not just modeled them

 - Basic electrical competence: harnessing, connectors, multimeter, reading a schematic

 - Willingness to work on and around heavy equipment in PPE


PREFERRED

 - Wiring harness design or manufacturing experience

 - Exposure to off-highway, automotive, or industrial equipment

 - Machining, welding, or 3D printing experience

Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodations

We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

 There’s nothing more fundamental to life on Earth than water.  At Culligan, we believe transforming water can transform the world. Additional Information

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Staff Outbound Product Manager to own and build a new AI tool suite that shows a customer exactly where agentic AI will pay off in their business: the highest ROI workflows to agentify, whether their data is ready and build AI tools to fix it, and demonstrate the projected return.

This is a single threaded owner role for a builder. You’ll collaborate with customers and internal teams such as forward deployment engineering, solutions consultants to release new product & capabilities, drive adoption at scale, and gather insights that shape the future of our products. This is a strategic, hands-on role with significant visibility and impact across the company.

What You'll Do:

• Own AI tooling from vision and roadmap to execution and launch. Set the standard for rigor and executive grade output on a fast moving, high visibility bet.
• Define and drive multi-quarter strategy for core platform components and align with engineering on sequencing and tradeoffs.
• Consolidate existing isolated toolsets, by deeply integrating them into one experience while adding new capabilities to build ServiceNow’s most comprehensive pre-sales AI tool suite. Tooling includes mining existing dataset to suggest high ROI agentic workflows, discover gaps in data readiness for AI, build features to automatically fix those gaps, and invest in quantitative ROI calculators for customer’s AI investments.
• Build for the field first. Your primary users are ServiceNow solution consultants, account owners, and forward deployment engineers who run the motion on the customer's behalf. Run discovery with them, ship what makes them faster and sharper, and turn their customer conversations into a repeatable way to show AI value.
• Develop future leaders. Mentor product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
• Synthesize complexity into clarity. Communicate platform strategy, architectural tradeoffs, and roadmap priorities to executive, technical, and customer audiences with precision.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• 10+ years of experience in product management with substantial time on AI products/generative AI tooling layers at a top-tier AI company; you’ve personally written detailed specs and pushed back on engineering architecture and demonstrated success bringing AI-powered products to market, including experience building AI tools for internal or external consumption.
• Experience with generative AI and agentic technologies (LLMs, AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP) with hands-on product ownership of LLM-based systems and real-world failure modes.
• Proven ability to collaborate across diverse, cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: VP of People
jobs.description:
VP of People

Pursuit

[New York City]

Overview

Pursuit’s mission is to create economic transformation at scale. Our comprehensive model combines rigorous training with strategic partnerships to connect and support high-quality tech talent from low-income backgrounds with leading companies. By training adults to launch and advance careers as software engineers, we help our Fellows increase their earnings from $18,000 to over $90,000 in starting salary on average, adding an estimated $2M in lifetime earnings. Since 2013, we have generated ~$1B in lifetime wage gains and partnered with top companies like Blackstone, USV, Citi, Peloton, and Uber.

As AI reshapes industries and the future of work, Pursuit is ensuring that economic mobility keeps pace. We are pioneering new approaches to AI workforce development, equipping talent from diverse backgrounds with the skills to thrive in an AI- driven economy. By working with employers, funders, and policymakers, we are shaping how the sector adapts to AI’s impact—ensuring that opportunity is expanded, not restricted, in the process.

Our vision of scaled impact is to reshape the skill training landscape and how governments, funders, and employers invest in workforce solutions. Through our innovative financial model, the Pursuit Bond, we are building the capital market to finance a sustainable model that other organizations can adopt, removing structural barriers and changing workforce development for good.

The Opportunity

Pursuit is looking for a hands-on HR leader to build and own our people function as we scale. Reporting directly to the COO, this is a true generalist role for someone who thrives working solo, moves fluidly between strategic and tactical work, and wants to shape culture and talent strategy at a growing company from the ground up. You'll partner directly with leadership on everything from recruiting and comp design to culture-building and performance management — with contingent recruiting support available to help you scale hiring volume. This is not a role for someone who wants to specialize in one lane. You'll move between a comp benchmarking exercise, a sensitive employee relations conversation, and a hiring strategy discussion in the same day — and do each one well.

Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

• Drive full-cycle recruiting for open roles, partnering with recruiters to scale sourcing and volume as needed

• Build and refine our interview process, hiring rubrics, and candidate experience

• Own employer branding and help position Pursuit.AI as a destination for top talent

Culture & Employee Experience

• Shape and protect company culture as we grow past initial team size

• Design onboarding, engagement, and retention programs that scale with headcount

• Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees on questions, concerns, and conflict resolution

Compensation & Incentive Design

• Build and maintain compensation bands, leveling frameworks, and market benchmarking

• Design incentive and equity programs aligned with company growth stage and goals

• Advise leadership on comp strategy for offers, promotions, and retention

HR Operations & Compliance

• Own core HR infrastructure: HRIS, benefits administration, payroll coordination, and policy documentation

• Ensure compliance with employment law across relevant jurisdictions (NY-specific and multi-state as needed), in partnership with external employment counsel as appropriate

• Manage leave administration, performance management cycles, and employee lifecycle processes end-to-end

Strategic Partnership

• Act as a thought partner to founders/leadership on org design, workforce planning, and scaling decisions

• Bring outside perspective and best practices from other growth-stage companies

• Build the people function's roadmap as the company scales past 100 employees

Experience and Competencies

• 10+ years in HR, with meaningful experience as a generalist or HR leader at a growth-stage company (startup or small company experience strongly preferred)

• Proven ability to operate as a "one-person department" — comfortable owning both strategic and operational work without a large team behind you

• Strong track record in compensation design, recruiting, and culture-building specifically (not just one of the three)

• Excellent judgment navigating ambiguous, sensitive situations with discretion

• Ability to context-switch quickly and prioritize across competing, high-stakes topics

• Experience managing or coordinating with contingent/contract recruiters a plus

• Able to lead through ambiguity, identify opportunities, and execute with urgency in complex organizations.

• Excited by the role of AI in the future of workforce development and its potential for driving innovation and systems transformation (experience with AI not required but a strong interest is essential).

Where you’ll work: Hybrid: 3 days a week in our HQ in Long Island City and 2 days wherever you work best.

Compensation: $175,000 - $200,000 with 20% bonus contingent on achieving goals

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Pursuit offers:

• Great culture where transparency, respect, teamwork, and kindness are valued

• Competitive compensation in base, plus bonus and a full benefits package

• 401k plus match

• Unlimited PTO and an all-Pursuit week-long holiday the last week of December

• An opportunity to work at the intersection of tech and social impact, and make a direct impact on the communities of those we serve.

How to Apply

Pursuit is partnering with PurposeFlow Talent on this search. Please submit your application using this link. Candidates who advance in the process will be contacted directly by PurposeFlow Talent.

Pursuit values diversity:

Our team has a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we value the richness that diversity brings to our organization. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuit is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About StackOne

StackOne is the integration infrastructure for AI agents. Backed by GV and Workday Ventures ($24M raised), we make it possible for any AI agent — whether our customers build it into their product or buy it off the shelf — to take real action across the enterprise stack. Our platform gives agents 430+ connectors and 26,000+ pre-built actions, an AI connector builder for everything not covered yet, and the production layer agents actually need: semantic tool discovery that cuts token use by up to 80%, managed authentication and per-action permissions, the most accurate prompt injection defense on the market, and end-to-end observability.

Join us on our fast trajectory to build the future of agentic integrations.


ROLE

Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation as a Sales Development Representative at StackOne, fueling US revenue growth in agentic integrations, one of the fastest-moving areas of B2B AI. You'll be one of our first SDRs in the US, working directly alongside our Founding AEs and CEO to build a repeatable outbound and inbound-qualification engine from the ground up.

Full ownership of pipeline creation across inbound and outbound, partnering closely with the CEO, Founding AEs, prospecting our three ICPs, running outbound sequences, and booking qualified meetings with flagship US accounts. Early motion, real traction.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own US pipeline generation targets tied directly to qualified meetings booked and pipeline created.

 - Generate and qualify leads across inbound (PLG-driven developer traction) and outbound motions.

 - Prospect three ICPs: AI-native startups building agents, enterprise teams embedding AI into existing products, and SaaS platforms embedding StackOne for their customers.

 - Build and iterate on the US outbound motion (account targeting, messaging, sequencing, experimentation).

 - Research accounts and personas deeply enough to speak credibly about APIs, MCP, and integration architecture in first conversations.

 - Qualify inbound leads from PLG-driven developer traction and route them cleanly to the AE with strong context.

 - Partner with the AE to hand off qualified opportunities and support smooth transitions into full-cycle sales conversations.

 - Collaborate closely with Founding Growth (Marketing) to refine outbound messaging and sequences for technical buyers.

 - Help build and test early US outbound playbooks, messaging frameworks, and account lists.

 - Track and report on outreach volume, response rates, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, and pipeline contribution.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of B2B SaaS SDR/BDR experience with clear evidence of overperformance and rapid progression.

 - Strong track record of owning and hitting pipeline generation targets, not just activity metrics.

 - Experience in early-stage or fast-growing startup environments.

 - Experience prospecting into iPaaS/integrations, dev tools, APIs, infrastructure, security or other highly technical products.

 - Comfortable researching and reaching out to engineers, CTOs, and technical founders.

 - Exposure to AI/LLM products, agentic platforms, or meaningful hands-on experience with AI tools.

 - High ownership mindset, bias for action, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

Dealbreaker: pure enterprise sales background with no exposure to startup environments.




BENEFITS

 - Join one of the best-funded, fastest-growing startups in the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

 - Work alongside an experienced team, with backgrounds from Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Coinbase, JP Morgan, and more.

 - Meaningful share options – share in the company's success as we grow.

 - Health insurance.

 - Remote-first, with regular in-person time in the Bay Area.

Ready to help us change the game for SaaS integrations? Get in touch and let's chat!

jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

About Re:Build Optimation

At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.

As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.

At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineering Team Lead to guide our roll-to-roll web conveyance team and deliver complex equipment projects from concept through completion. Reporting to the Director of Mechanical Machine Engineering and Design, you will combine technical leadership, project execution, team development, and client partnership.

You will lead work involving web handling, unwinding and rewinding, tension control, winding, slitting, splicing, and in-line inspection systems. This role requires an onsite presence in Rochester, New York, and up to 25% travel.

What you get to do

• Lead the day-to-day work, priorities, and resource planning of the roll-to-roll engineering team.

• Coach team members and support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and professional development.

• Plan and direct multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through installation and validation.

• Lead the design of rollers, nip systems, tension-control zones, web guides, splicing and slitting stations, and winding equipment.

• Troubleshoot web-handling issues such as wrinkles, surface damage, traction concerns, and tension instability.

• Direct testing, root-cause analysis, and validation to improve equipment safety, quality, and reliability.

• Create engineering calculations, design standards, technical documentation, and drawing packages.

• Develop project plans, schedules, proposals, cost estimates, and risk-mitigation strategies.

• Partner with clients and internal teams to understand needs, communicate recommendations, and identify new opportunities.

• Promote safe design and work practices throughout every project phase.

What you bring to the team

• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, or a related engineering discipline.

• Seven or more years of engineering experience with roll-to-roll web handling or conveyance systems.

• Experience designing or troubleshooting tension-control systems, unwind and rewind equipment, rollers and nip systems, web guiding, splicing, slitting, or in-line inspection systems.

• Five or more years of experience using SolidWorks or a comparable 3D CAD platform.

• Experience delivering complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through completion.

• The ability to analyze technical data, identify root causes, manage risk, and communicate with technical and nontechnical audiences.

• The ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred qualifications include experience leading technical teams; knowledge of servo-driven tension or torque control; and familiarity with FEA, CFD, ISO 9001, Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, or project-management software. A Professional Engineer license or eligibility for licensure is also preferred.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $106,000 – $159,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.  Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

jobs.title: Associate Director, Technical Accounting
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 


ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Finance & Corporate Development team at Airwallex drives the company’s financial strategy and growth. Our team focuses on financial planning, analysis, and corporate transactions to ensure Airwallex’s long-term success. We collaborate across departments to identify opportunities, manage risks, and execute strategic initiatives. Our goal is to support the company’s mission to empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime.



What you’ll do

We're looking for an Associate Director, Technical Finance to join our Financial Controllership team. You will be the primary authority and architect for our most complex accounting treatments. This is not a "maintenance" role; it is a strategic functional position designed for a US GAAP expert who thrives in a high-velocity, global environment. You will be responsible for navigating the technical complexities of a rapidly scaling business, ensuring our financial narrative is robust, compliant, and forward-looking.  You will lead the Global Technical Accounting function, translating complex business initiatives into sound accounting positions that stand up to the highest level of scrutiny.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York.



Responsibilities:

 - Oversee the technical integrity of the monthly reporting process by providing expert US GAAP oversight on regional submissions. You will ensure that high-risk accounting areas are treated with technical precision.

 - Partner with Product and Business teams. You will assess the accounting implications of new product launches (including gross vs. net revenue, embedded derivatives, cost of sales vs OPEX classification etc) before they go live.

 - Own the resolution of  technical accounting issues and judgmental estimates.

 - Lead the expansion and evolution of our global US GAAP reporting framework. You will author and maintain the Global Accounting Policy Manual to ensure consistency and compliance.

 - Architect and oversee the Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) for technical accounting areas. You will ensure that all complex accounting judgments are backed by robust, SOX-compliant documentation and that "Reviewer Controls" are designed with sufficient precision to meet public company standards.

 - Lead the preparation and defense of high-quality technical memos, ensuring all documentation meets PCAOB auditing standards regarding management’s estimates, assumptions, and data integrity.

 - Spearhead department-wide initiatives to mature the Controllership function, focusing on the automation of technical accounting workflows and the implementation of AI technology and new accounting standards.

 - Provide continuous technical guidance and training to regional finance teams, uplifting their capability to maintain high standards of financial control and reporting accuracy.



Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

 - 7+ years of professional experience in technical finance roles

 - Deep expertise in US GAAP standards with a proven ability to apply them to complex business transactions

 - Strong working knowledge of PCAOB Auditing Standards and SOX requirements

 - Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and thrive in a hyper-growth environment



Preferred qualifications:

 - Active CPA license or equivalent professional qualification

 - Prior experience at a Big Four accounting firm

 - Direct experience with the pre-IPO process and scaling finance functions for public market readiness

 - Strong "thought leadership" skills with a history of driving innovative solutions and influencing organizational change


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Investment Systems
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to help bring AI into the daily work of teams across the firm. This is a hands-on engineering role with a builder's mindset: you are an embedded extension of the engineering team that works directly with investment teams to understand how their work gets done, then design, build, and ship production AI systems that improve it.

Your “customers” are internal: colleagues across private equity, credit, infrastructure, real estate, insurance and capital markets. You will sit with these teams and observe their workflows firsthand. You will identify where fragmented data, repetitive tasks, and manual handoffs slow high-value work, and translate ambiguous business challenges into well-defined technical problems. You will then own the solution end to end, from architecture, code, data integration, to evaluation, deployment, and adoption, in close partnership with your direct engineering teammates, product, AI, data, security, and platform colleagues.

The best solutions you build will not stay one-off. You will convert successful implementations into reusable skills, tools, agents, and workflow components that scale across teams and strengthen the firm’s broader AI platform. If you are an engineer who wants your code to shape how a leading global investment firm works, this role offers rare scope and impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Engage teams across KKR’s businesses to observe how work is delivered, going beyond documented requirements to understand information flows, decision points, and day-to-day realities.

• Identify high-value opportunities where AI can remove bottlenecks, connect fragmented data, eliminate repetitive work, or improve the speed and quality of decisions.

• Translate loosely defined business challenges into clear technical problem statements, solution architectures, and delivery plans.

• Design, build, and ship production-grade AI applications, agents, integrations, and workflow automations using modern languages such as Python or TypeScript.

• Connect structured and unstructured data across enterprise systems and make it reliably usable by AI-enabled applications through pipelines, retrieval systems, and well-designed interfaces.

• Create, test, and maintain reusable AI skills, tools, prompts, connectors, evaluation frameworks, and workflow components that can be shared across teams and business units.

• Establish rigorous evaluations and success metrics that measure accuracy, reliability, adoption, time saved, decision quality, risk reduction, and business impact.

• Move rapidly from discovery to prototype to production while upholding high standards for security, data protection, privacy, compliance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Decompose organic, often undocumented workflows into modular capabilities — data, decisions, actions, and controls — and determine where AI, deterministic software, or human judgment is the right tool.

• Drive adoption through documentation, training, direct user feedback, and close, ongoing partnership with the teams you serve.

• Convert successful high-touch implementations into repeatable engineering patterns and scalable platform capabilities, feeding insights into the firm’s broader AI roadmap.

• Challenge conventional practices constructively, helping teams reimagine workflows rather than simply automating existing steps.

HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE BUSINESS AND TECHNOLOGY TEAMS

Forward Deployed Engineers and technology teams own the engineering side of AI enablement for business partners: architecture, integration, data pipelines, security implementation, and production operations.

Paired with a business-embedded AI Solutions counterpart, you will be in the room together from the first discovery conversation, and you will stay engaged together through deployment testing with users, measuring results, and iterating. Your job is to make sure what gets built solves the right problem, fits how people actually work, meets the firm's control requirements, and gets used. Along the way, you will also work with product owners, data teams, information security, and corporate functions such as legal and compliance, tailoring your communication to each audience.

QUALIFICATIONS

• A strong software engineering foundation, with hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production systems — at least or equivalent demonstrated capability.

• Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or comparable modern programming languages, with experience across APIs, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integrations.

• Practical experience building applications with large language models — including agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, and orchestration — and evaluating their behavior.

• Facility with data: pipelines, databases, retrieval systems, and unstructured content, and the judgment to make imperfect enterprise data usable.

• Genuine commercial curiosity and a strong desire to learn KKR’s businesses — how investments are evaluated, how decisions are made, and which outcomes matter.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity: the ability to take a vague problem, ask good questions, uncover needs users may not initially articulate, and converge on a concrete solution.

• The range to move fluidly between writing code, discussing architecture, observing workflows, and engaging senior business stakeholders.

• Act as a conductor across a diverse set of stakeholders — including business teams, business-aligned product and engineering, AI platform product and engineering, and data operations — to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and drive projects forward to successful delivery.

• A commitment to engineering quality — testing, observability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices — even when moving quickly.

• Clear communication and a collaborative, low-ego working style, with the ability to give and receive direct feedback.

• Experience deploying AI or data-intensive systems in large enterprises or regulated environments.

• Exposure to private markets, financial services, or other domains with complex, judgment-heavy workflows.

• Experience partnering directly with senior business stakeholders to shape and deliver technical solutions.

• A track record of turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms, frameworks, or internal products.

• Experience with evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, or governance practices for LLM applications.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• AI solutions you built are running in production and used every day by the teams they were designed for.

• Workflows you touched are measurably better — faster cycle times, higher-quality decisions, less manual effort, or lower operational risk.

• Capabilities you created — skills, tools, agents, connectors, and evaluation frameworks — are reused by other teams and business units.

• Business partners trust you as someone who understands their work and seek you out with their hardest problems.

• The systems you ship are secure, reliable, well-evaluated, and maintainable long after launch.

• Lessons from your deployments visibly shape the firm’s broader AI platform and roadmap.

This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Base Salary Range

$180,000—$200,000 USD

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol court facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment, courtrooms, judge chambers, and jury rooms.

Court attendance: Responsible for securing unattended courtrooms, an inspection of courtrooms prior to a proceeding, testing of security devices, and other duties concerning security of the court area.

• Generate, calculate, and compile laboratory testing reports and issue to clients and supervise others performing the same.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer, Autonomy
Company: Heven AeroTech
Location: Bingen, Washington or Sterling, Virginia
FLSA: Exempt

About Our Company:
At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary:
Reporting to the Head of Mission Systems and Software, the Machine Learning Engineer - Autonomy develops and deploys machine learning and autonomy capabilities for Heven AeroTech uncrewed aircraft systems. The role focuses on practical UAS autonomy, including perception, tracking, sensor fusion, mission-level decision making, planning, and integration with flight-control, mission-system, onboard-compute, and payload interfaces. This engineer works closely with other Machine Learning Engineers, Platform Engineers, Flight Test, and aircraft engineering teams to take autonomy capabilities from development through simulation, integration, ground test, and flight test.

Essential Responsibilities:

• Develop, integrate, and deploy machine learning and autonomy capabilities for uncrewed aircraft, with emphasis on reliable operation on real aircraft and onboard compute.

• Develop mission-level autonomous behaviors using appropriate combinations of state machines, behavior trees, planners, optimization methods, deterministic logic, and machine learning.

• Develop and integrate perception capabilities including object detection, classification, tracking, scene understanding, sensor fusion, and geospatial reasoning.

• Integrate autonomy software with autopilots, companion computers, mission computers, sensors, payloads, data links, and GCS/C2 systems while maintaining clear interfaces with flight-control functions.

• Develop production-quality C++ and Python software for real-time and near-real-time execution, including optimization for NVIDIA GPU and embedded edge-compute platforms.

• Develop and use simulation, SIL, HIL, bench-test, and automated test environments to evaluate autonomy behavior and reduce risk prior to flight.

• Support aircraft integration, ground test, and flight test of autonomy capabilities, including analysis of logs and test data to characterize performance and drive improvements.

• Collaborate across Heven AeroTech with Machine Learning Engineers, Platform Engineers, Flight Test, avionics, electrical, mechanical, and other engineering teams.

Qualifications & Experience:

Required:

• BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2-5 years of experience developing and deploying machine learning or autonomy software on robotic, autonomous, or UAS platforms.

• Strong C++ and Python development skills, including Linux-based development and modern machine learning frameworks.

• Working knowledge of perception, sensor integration, autonomous decision making or planning, and real-time system integration.

• Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required to perform the responsibilities of this role.

• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

• If this role requires access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR), applicants must also qualify as a "U.S. person" under 22 CFR §120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee).

Preferred:

• Direct experience with UAS autonomy, aircraft integration, or flight test.

• Experience with NVIDIA edge compute, CUDA/TensorRT, ROS 2, MAVLink, or comparable robotics and vehicle interfaces.

• Aerospace or defense experience and eligibility to obtain a DoD Secret clearance.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to work effectively in a standard office, engineering laboratory, aircraft integration, hangar, and outdoor flight-test environment.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, reach, and work around aircraft, ground-support equipment, test equipment, and computing hardware for extended periods as required.

• Ability to lift, carry, and position equipment and components weighing up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Ability to safely work in outdoor environments and varying weather conditions during ground and flight-test activities.

• Ability to work around aircraft systems, electrical equipment, rotating equipment, batteries, and other laboratory/flight-test hazards while following applicable safety procedures and PPE requirements.

• Ability to visually inspect equipment, read computer displays, instrumentation, schematics, logs, and test data, with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, or occasional weekends, when required to support aircraft integration, ground testing, or flight-test operations.

• Ability and willingness to travel to company facilities, customer sites, and/or designated flight-test locations as required by the position.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.



The challenge

Our Charlotte office is scaling fast, and fast growth without the right structure just creates bigger problems, faster. We need someone to take ownership of revenue across our Account Executive and BDR teams, build scalable processes, and become the senior voice that makes Wayflyer impossible to ignore in the region.



What you'll actually do

 - Own the revenue growth strategy for Charlotte and lead the team locally to execute on this

 - Run performance across our revenue teams, setting a high bar and exceeding it

 - Analyse revenue and attainment data closely enough to catch underperformance before it becomes a pattern

 - Build the sales processes and frameworks that will enable our next phase of growth

 - Help to build and elevate Wayflyer's profile in the region

 - Work closely with underwriting, product, partnerships, finance, and marketing, because revenue doesn't operate in a silo

 - You’ll have second line management responsibility, and you’ll build a culture where high performance is the norm, not the exception

 - Set the tone for the Charlotte office as our most senior leader on the ground
   
   

What this role could turn into

Our leaders who've built regional revenue engines from the ground up have gone on to take on broader revenue leadership remits, or helped shape our GTM strategy company-wide. Charlotte is early enough that this role will keep growing alongside the office - the ceiling here isn't fixed.



Who thrives here

Someone who wants to build, not maintain. You'll need to care as much about the people on your team as the numbers on your dashboard, because scaling an office means scaling humans, not just processes. You're confident making decisions independently and know when to loop in the wider business. If something's not working, you fix it before anyone asks you to.



We hire for range

We're less interested in a specific title history and more interested in trajectory: have you taken a revenue function from scrappy to scaled before? Ideally you've led across more than one function (BDR, AE, or CS), managed both ICs and other managers, and owned a P&L. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security Agents
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ROLE OVERVIEW


Ready to build AI agents that revolutionize enterprise security? The North Security team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to create autonomous systems that handle the complex, critical tasks security practitioners face every day.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include:

 - Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment

 - Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks

 - Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data

 - Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements

 - Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments

 - Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short

 - Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping user-facing security features

 - Strong Python development skills with significant production experience

 - Experience building or working with autonomous systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation

 - Solid understanding of security principles including session management, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices

 - Ability to think about security at multiple layers: application security, agent behavior security, and infrastructure security

 - Comfortable working across the full stack and diving into unfamiliar codebases to understand and fix issues

 - Thrive in fast-paced environments where you can adapt to evolving priorities

 - Excited about the intersection of AI/ML and security engineering.




WORKING LOCATION

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. • Gran capacidad de comunicación, colaboración y motivación, con habilidad para establecer relaciones profesionales con todos los líderes y el equipo de cocina.

• Proactivo, con espíritu de equipo, capaz de trabajar bien tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

• Capacidad para realizar múltiples tareas y trabajar en un entorno exigente y dinámico.

• Se valorará poseer un nivel de creatividad para crear recetas desde cero.

Requisitos físicos

• Debe ser capaz de agarrar, sujetar, girar y sostener objetos con las manos.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Pursuit

Pursuit is a social impact organization building the future of economic mobility in the age of AI. For over a decade, we've transformed lives through immersive training programs that propel adults from low-income backgrounds — often without college degrees — into high-growth tech careers. Our graduates, who we call Builders, have generated nearly $1 billion in lifetime wage gains.

As AI reshapes every industry, Pursuit is becoming an AI-native organization — training AI-native talent, embedding AI into our operations, and building scalable systems to extend our impact. From local partnerships to national policy, we're rethinking how opportunity works at scale.

The Role

Pursuit is hiring a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to join our External Affairs team at a pivotal moment of growth.

This role sits at the intersection of government and education/workforce partnerships, policy, and execution. You will be the day-to-day operating lead for a multi-year, state-funded initiative that brings Pursuit’s AI-native training to three New York regions in partnership with community colleges, workforce nonprofits, and regional economic development organizations. You'll take it from contract award through partner mobilization to launch, and then help us turn what we learn into a model other markets can run.

The ideal candidate is a strong operator and relationship-builder who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, brings rigor to systems and processes, and understands how partnerships power mission-driven scale. You are comfortable being the person who holds the timeline when multiple organizations each own a piece of it.

What You'll Do

Partner Management & Delivery

• Serve as the day-to-day owner of a portfolio of workforce, higher education, employer, and economic development partners

• Run the partnership operating rhythm: recurring check-ins, all-partner convenings, and a shared view of status, owners, and next steps that every party trusts

• Shepherd agreements from term sheet to execution in partnership with cross-functional internal stakeholders

• Negotiate and hold the line on deliverables, timelines, and shared definitions: who recruits, who teaches, who reports, what counts as success

• Surface partner risk early and drive it to resolution rather than reporting it

• Onboard new partners and build the templates, briefing materials, and playbooks that make the next partnership faster to stand up

Grant & Contract Stewardship

• Manage public grants and contracts from post-award through closeout: workplans, milestones, reporting calendars, and modifications

• Own reporting, compliance, documentation, and audit readiness, including subrecipient monitoring and pass-through requirements

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for government partners

• Partner with Finance on budgets, invoicing, reimbursement mechanics, disbursement schedules, and partner payments

Cross-Functional Execution

• Translate external commitments into internal project plans with defined scope, timelines, named owners, and deliverables — and hold the org to them

• Run the internal cadence that keeps delivery on track: workstream check-ins, milestone or gate reviews, and a single source of truth for status

jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Manager, Mechanical Design - NPD

Needham, MA

Our mission is to positively impact people's lives every day, in every home around the world. That means our employees get to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers — makers of things they love. As we grow, we're excited to add a Manager, Mechanical Design - NPD to our global team.

The Role

You'll lead part of our growing NPD team, building the next generation of innovative Ninja products. This is a front-end role: you'll own the technology and feasibility phase of product creation, bringing technical substance and inspiration to our creative efforts and shaping our Motorized product roadmap with credible, buildable solutions.

Think complete system innovations that sit between the physical (mechanical) and the system (sensors, software, batteries, connectivity).

What You'll Do

Own the front end of the Motorized roadmap. Use ideation and innovation techniques to unlock and drive the roadmap alongside engineering and cross-functional PD, ID, Brand, and Test Kitchen teams across the US, UK, and China.

Fail fast, learn faster. Drive ideas to a conclusion early via functional rigs before handing part or complete solution packages to the back-end implementation AD team.

Get hands-on. Tinker on both short- and long-term projects, building POC (Proof of Concept) rigs to prove out hypotheses. Manage the hands-on work of prototype building and lab testing, then develop and report findings with clear next steps.

Communicate ideas fast. Sketching, CAD layouts, 3D models, and working prototypes to evaluate potential solutions.

Run design and engineering studies — independently and in teams — to solve technical and consumer problems, with user experience front of mind at every stage.

Keep the consumer at the center. Collaborate seamlessly with our global AD and CI teams so front-end, consumer-focused sensibilities drive our direction and carry all the way through development to 5-star products.

Coach and grow the team. Actively support and encourage your colleagues — especially junior team members — and motivate them to identify, solve, implement, and verify technical solutions autonomously.

Juggle well. Balance, prioritize, and drive multiple workflows and additional responsibilities against fast-paced schedules and deadlines.

What You'll Bring

Experience & Education

• Degree-level technical qualification — ideally Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or Industrial Design with a focus on engineering principles

• Typically 6–10 years of proven experience in a Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Product Design, or Industrial Design environment

• Consumer goods / household appliance experience desirable

• Experience with plastic, casting, and sheet metal manufacturing processes

• Experience working with IP teams to track prior art and identify novel or inventive solutions within an AD/R&D team

Technical Skills

• Proficiency in SolidWorks or Creo

• Ability to identify, solve, implement, and verify technical solutions autonomously and as part of a team

• Comfortable operating in the lab (with training): building prototypes, testing products, and reporting results

• An all-rounder's appreciation for electrical engineering, software, and mechanical principles. UX design appreciation is helpful but not essential

How You Work

• Flexible, resilient, and persevering, with a positive attitude and entrepreneurial nature — these are key to success at SharkNinja

• A collaborator who isn't afraid to fail fast, learn, and pivot

• Positive and driving, with an inquisitive nature

• Strong judgment: knowing which problems to solve, how to make daily progress, and why iterating to prove out hypotheses matters

• A growth mindset — you proactively build your own skills and actively seek out coaching from others

• Keen to contribute to internal working groups beyond your core role to improve processes, working environment, and mindset

Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love. As we continue to grow, we are excited to add a Manager, Mechanical Design - NPD to our global team.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts (HSA) with company contribution, 401(k) retirement plan with matching, employee stock purchase program, life insurance, AD&D, short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, generous paid time off, company holidays, parental leave, identity theft protection, pet insurance, pre-paid legal insurance, back-up child and eldercare days, product discounts, referral bonus program, and more.

Pay Range

$105,000—$150,000 USD

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Life At SharkNinja
Outrageously Extraordinary

jobs.title: Staff Controls Operator
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to tens of gigawatts.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Run the building management and controls systems (BMS, SCADA, EPMS) that keep live gigawatt-scale data centers cooling and powered in real time.

 - Own real-time load and thermal control across sites coming online in pieces, keeping the live halls running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

 - Write the operating procedures, alarm response runbooks, and control sequences that become the standard for every site that follows.

 - Diagnose and resolve controls faults on the floor, from a misbehaving chiller sequence to a breaker mis-operation, before they touch a training run.

 - Tune control sequences and setpoints to hold PUE and reliability targets as load ramps and hardware generations change.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've operated the controls for live mission-critical facilities, data center, industrial, or power, and kept them running through faults, ramps, and construction next door.

 - You know BMS, SCADA, and EPMS platforms deep enough to diagnose a bad sequence or a misconfigured point, not just read the alarm.

 - You've written operating procedures and alarm response runbooks that other operators actually run.

 - You've resolved a real controls fault under pressure, on a live floor, with load on the line.

 - You tune control sequences and setpoints and can explain the tradeoff between reliability, efficiency, and cost.

 - You catch the drifting sensor or the wrong setpoint before it becomes an outage.

 - Bonus: Hyperscale or colocation data center operations. Liquid cooling controls. Electrical power monitoring systems. Behind-the-meter generation. Building the controls standards for a new fleet.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior Trial Attorney to try cases first chair in New York State and federal courts. This is not a settlement-desk role. You will own a docket of high-exposure matters from the moment they are trial-ready through verdict, and you will be measured on the results you obtain in front of juries.

The right candidate has already stood up and delivered openings, crossed defense experts, and taken verdicts. You will work alongside a case management team that handles intake, treatment coordination, and pre-suit negotiation so that your time is spent where it creates the most value: in depositions, in motion practice, and in the courtroom. You will also serve as a force multiplier, mentoring associates who are building toward their own first chairs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Try cases to verdict. Serve as first chair on jury and bench trials in New York Supreme Court and, where applicable, federal court — voir dire through verdict.
• Own a trial-ready docket. Manage a caseload of high-value matters, setting and executing the litigation strategy for each from trial assignment through resolution.
• Drive discovery and motion practice. Take and defend depositions of parties, treating physicians, and retained experts; draft and argue dispositive and in limine motions; handle preliminary conferences, compliance conferences, and appearances before the court.
• Build the trial record. Identify, retain, and prepare expert witnesses; develop damages models and demonstrative evidence; prepare witnesses and clients for testimony.

• Willingness to travel to courthouses throughout the New York metropolitan area and, as needed, upstate.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Plaintiff-side personal injury experience, including motor vehicle, premises liability, construction (Labor Law §§ 200, 240, 241), and catastrophic injury matters.
• Verdicts or settlements in excess of policy limits, or in the seven figures.
• Familiarity with New York No-Fault practice and lien resolution.
• Conversational or fluent Spanish, or experience serving a bilingual client base.
• Experience supervising or training junior litigators.
