jobs.title: PKI Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking a PKI Service Desk Technician to join our team in Sierra Vista, AZ.

• U.S. citizen with an active Secret clearance
• IAT Level II certification
• Mid-Shift (see details below)
• Non-remote (relocation incentive available)

The PKI Service Desk Technician will provide technical and system support for the U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM) at Fort Huachuca, AZ. You will work across multiple technical teams, mission partners, and senior leaders to maintain secure workforce access, support enterprise PKI operations, manage IT assets, and assist with the deployment and sustainment of critical network and cybersecurity services.

In this position, you will provide Common Access Card (CAC), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Registration Authority/Local Registration Authority (RA/LRA) support functions related to the issuance, renewal, revocation, suspension, recovery, and management of NIPRNet Alternate Smart Card Logon (ASCL), SIPRNet, and Deployed Forces network tokens. You will support PKI credentialing operations to ensure authorized users maintain secure access to Army networks, systems, applications, and mission-critical resources.

Become an integral part of a professionally diverse team while working at an industry-leading organization where work-life balance and employee development are prioritized. This opportunity offers exposure to innovative technologies, professional growth, and the ability to directly support Army cybersecurity operations and national defense missions.

Job Responsibilities:

• Provide Tier I and Tier II technical support for PKI-related incidents, service requests, and security access issues.
• Respond to and resolve daily Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and card-access support requests, including user permissions, certificate issues, account access, and application-related access problems.
• Process, issue, renew, revoke, and maintain digital certificates throughout the certificate lifecycle.
• Support SSL/TLS certificate requests, installations, renewals, and troubleshooting across servers, applications, and network devices.
• Manage privileged user accounts, including account creation, modification, renewal, reinstatement, and deactivation in accordance with security policies.
• Monitor PKI infrastructure and associated systems to ensure operational availability, performance, and compliance with security requirements.
• Troubleshoot certificate validation, authentication, encryption, and smart card-related issues for end users and system administrators.
• Evaluate certificate health and identify issues related to expiration, revocation, trust chains, configuration, and compliance requirements.
• Assist users with certificate enrollment, installation, renewal, and recovery procedures.
• Maintain accurate records of certificate inventories, system configurations, and support activities.
• Support and process PKI service requests, escalating complex technical issues to senior engineers or administrators as required.
• Assist with routine system maintenance, software patches, upgrades, and version updates for PKI and access-control systems.
• Participate in the deployment, testing, and implementation of new PKI applications, tools, and services.
• Implement approved changes to PKI infrastructure in accordance with established change management and security procedures.
• Review system logs, alerts, and audit records to identify and resolve potential security or operational issues.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, server, and application teams to troubleshoot and resolve PKI-related incidents.
• Support compliance, audit, and security initiatives by maintaining documentation and adhering to organizational policies and industry best practices.

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Shift Information:

• Initial training period: two weeks on the day shift
• Mid Shift (Sunday – Wednesday from 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM)

• U.S. citizen with an active Secret clearance.
• IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher per DoD 8570/DoD 8140 (CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP, etc.).
• Two (2+) years of experience supporting enterprise information technology systems, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
• Experience supporting Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including troubleshooting certificate, authentication, access, and encryption-related issues.
• Experience monitoring, maintaining, and assessing the performance, availability, and security of PKI systems and services.
• Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, identity and access management, and best practices for protecting sensitive data and PKI infrastructure.
• Current Computing Environment (CE) certification, or the ability to obtain the required certification within 90 days of hire.

Preferred:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
• Experience supporting information technology systems within a Department of Defense (DoD) or other regulated government environment.
• Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in mission-critical environments.
• Self-motivated professional with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
• Experience providing technical support and customer service for mission-critical systems, including support for senior leaders and VIP users.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing requirements in a fast-paced operational environment.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation incentive program, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V. We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Story Desk Editor
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

WATN/WLMT the ABC affiliate in Memphis, TN, is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we're looking for a Story Desk Editor to embrace our transition to the newsroom of the future. This role combines the skills of an assignment editor and a digital content producer to serve as the hub of the newsroom. The Story Desk Editor drives daily editorial execution, curates and produces impactful stories, and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences across streaming, digital, social and broadcast platforms.

Role Summary:

As a Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. You will lead coverage during breaking news, shape daily story planning, and curate content across platforms. This position requires decisive editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with MSJs, producers and photojournalists to deliver accurate, relevant and engaging stories that serve the community.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news, ensuring accuracy, urgency and balance

• Identify and plan stories that matter most to the community, using editorial judgment and social listening

• Create and edit engaging content for digital platforms: website, mobile app and streaming

• Guide newsroom logistics and provide editorial support for MSJs, producers, and photojournalists

• Edit reporter content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations

• Enhance storytelling with creative elements (graphics, video, audience-submitted content, etc.)

• Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach

• Support newsroom operations and coverage planning as needed

• Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms

Requirements:

• 1-3 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role

• Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure

• Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly

• Experience with newsroom systems

• Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• A collaborative, solutions-focused mindset that thrives in a team environment

• Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent experience

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. jobs.title: International Payroll Analyst
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Lead to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

• International Payroll Execution & Oversight:

• Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.

• Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

• Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.

• Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.

• Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.

• Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.

• Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).

• Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

What We’re Looking For:

• Experience: 5–7+ years of progressive payroll operations experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company with a global footprint.

• Education : Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in payroll, accounting, finance, human resources, or a related field.

• Systems Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Workday Payroll (reporting, configuration, integrations) and global payroll software platforms.

• Technical & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, index/match, pivot tables) for complex data analysis, reconciliation, and audit modeling.

• Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of global equity taxation, statutory compliance, international labor laws, and multi-currency payroll distribution.

• Execution & Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, high discretion handling confidential data, and exceptional communication skills to collaborate seamlessly across teams.

Bonus Points

• Responding to internal, external, statutory, and financial audit requests, including preparation of reconciliations, control evidence, and supporting documentation.

• Applying automation or AI tools to payroll operations, analytics, controls, case management, or knowledge documentation.

• Providing high-quality customer service to employees and business partners across regions, cultures, and time zones.

• Working in a publicly traded, technology, or high-growth company and supporting international expansion or payroll transformation.

How Success Will Be Measured

• Operational Excellence: Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across the international footprint.

• Audit & Governance: Strong controls, clean reconciliations, and audit-ready documentation.

• Vendor Management: Reliable vendor performance and effective resolution of payroll issues.

• Scalability: Scalable processes, improved automation, and clear country-level operating documentation.

• Stakeholder Satisfaction: Trusted partnerships and a responsive, employee-centered service experience.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

$105,400—$147,500 USD

jobs.title: Director, Payer Partnerships
jobs.description:
About this role

Boulder Care is looking for a Director of Payer Partnerships to lead our charge into the next generation of value-based behavioral health care. If you're a sales leader who thrives on closing complex deals, loves the strategy behind value-based care, and wants your work to directly expand access to addiction and behavioral health treatment, this is your seat at the table.

You'll own the full sales cycle for new payer partnerships and lead the transition of existing fee-for-service relationships into innovative, outcomes-based contracts. Your wins translate directly into expanded access to care — and into Boulder's growth across new markets.

About Boulder

Boulder Care is an award-winning digital clinic for addiction medicine, recognized for both innovation and high quality of patient care. Founded in 2017 by CEO Stephanie Strong, our mission is to improve the lives of people with substance use disorders through compassionate, evidence-based care.

We provide Boulder patients with a fully virtual, multidisciplinary care team—including medical providers and peer recovery specialists—who deliver personalized treatment, including medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and ongoing support. Our approach is grounded in clinical excellence, patient-centered care, and a commitment to reducing barriers to recovery. Boulder partners with leading health plans, employers, and community organizations to ensure that our services are accessible and covered for the people who need them most.

Named by Fortune as one of the Best Workplaces in Healthcare, we foster a culture of kindness, respect, and meaningful work that delivers outstanding patient outcomes and moves the addiction medicine industry forward.

What you'll do

Drive Payer Sales & Negotiate Contracts (60%)

• Own the end-to-end sales cycle for new payer partnerships — from first pitch to signed Value-Based Care (VBC) and pay-for-performance contracts

• Lead strategic renegotiations with existing fee-for-service partners, transitioning them into progressive risk-sharing and VBC frameworks built around Boulder's outcomes

• Be the primary negotiator on contract terms, rates, and performance metrics — crafting agreements that are financially sound and mutually beneficial.

• Build compelling, data-driven value propositions tailored to each health plan's population and strategic priorities

• Manage the full contracting lifecycle, from discovery through redlining, execution, and a smooth handover to our Partner Success team

Shape Strategy & Build Your Pipeline (25%)

• Build and manage a robust pipeline of payer prospects, using CRM tools to forecast revenue and report on key sales metrics

• Conduct market research on regional payer landscapes, competitor positioning, and regulatory shifts shaping VBC opportunities

• Identify and prioritize high-value targets, including Medicaid Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial health plans.

Collaborate & Share Market Insight (15%)

• Share market feedback with internal teams to help shape product development, pricing, and clinical program design

• Partner with Operations and Partner Success after signing to ensure smooth implementation and strong contract performance

• Represent Boulder Care at industry conferences, payer summits, and networking events as a thought leader in value-based behavioral health.

What you bring

• 5-7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare sales, payer contracting, network development, or managed care

• A track record of successfully negotiating and closing complex VBC, shared savings, or pay-for-performance contracts with health plans

• Deep knowledge of alternative payment models, population health strategies, and how Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial plans operate

• Sharp negotiation, financial, and analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting complex pricing and ROI models

• Executive presence and the ability to pitch and influence C-suite decision-makers at major health plans

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for turning clinical outcomes into compelling financial stories

• A self-starter mindset — you thrive with autonomy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and take real ownership of your work

• Integrity, strategic thinking, and professionalism that reflect Boulder Care's values

Nice to have but not required

• Experience selling to or negotiating with payers in behavioral health, substance use disorder (SUD), or digital health

• An active network of senior-level contacts at regional and national health plans

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance standards related to VBC and telehealth

Work environment

• Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

• Office requirements: Boulder teammates working with sensitive information must have a dedicated, private workspace with a lockable door and high-speed internet to maintain a secure, distraction-free environment, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and confidentiality standards.

• Boulder Care employees are free to use our riverfront HQ located in Portland, OR whenever they would like.

Expected hours of work

This is a full-time remote position expected to work 40 hours between Monday-Friday during standard business hours.

Compensation

Target OTE: $205,000–$235,000, with additional performance-based upside. The total compensation package also includes a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, including 401(k) eligibility and paid time off benefits such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave.

Perks and benefits

• Contribute to meaningful, life-saving work!

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and short-term disability benefits designed to take care of our employees and their families

• Mental Health Services via insurance coverage, including Talkspace and EAP for continuous care

• 4 weeks of vacation accrued per calendar year with a tenured increase to 5 weeks at 2 years of employment

• Sick leave accrued at 1 hr for every 30 hrs paid

• 9 Paid Holidays per year

• 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child (after 6 months of employment)

• 401(k) retirement savings

• Remote friendly with hardware provided to complete your work duties

Our values

• Patients always come first

• Our opportunity is also our duty

• Move the industry forward, follow the data

• Facts to change minds, empathy to change hearts

• Turn bold ideas into even bolder action

• Strong individuals, stronger together

• Boulder Care recognizes the value that lived experience can provide to our organization, community, and patients. Applicants with lived experience and/or training as a peer recovery specialist are encouraged to apply.

Boulder Care believes the people who manage our product and team should be representative of those who use the platform. This includes people from backgrounds that are historically underrepresented in the industry. We celebrate differences and are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. If you are a qualified person with a passion for what we do, please apply!

jobs.title: Human Resources Classification Specialist
jobs.description:
Coho Consulting Group is seeking a Human Resources Classification Specialist to support the Washington Headquarters Services (WHS) Human Resources Directorate (HRD), providing staff-level advice to customers in the development of solutions to a variety of complex problems in position management, organizational alignment, and desk audits.

Organizations serviced are complex, dynamic organizations primarily with large numbers of diverse, hard to fill, and one of a kind professional, technical, or administrative positions. Many positions are diverse high grade supervisory and managerial positions ranging from professional and scientific occupational positions to high level administrative and program management positions in both competitive and executive service.

This position is a hybrid role at the Mark Center in Alexandria, VA reporting to the Project Manager.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Provides authoritative advice and position classification/position management services on a continuing basis to all WHS serviced Components.

• Provides technical advice to managers in exercising their delegated classification authority.

• Provides position management and classification support to assigned organizations under various personnel systems.

• Applies a thorough understanding of classification principles, and concepts to interpret and adapt classification standards/guides to secure sound classification on positions.

• Advises managers on the position classification process and the use of various classification references and automated tools.

• Makes determinations in the proper crediting of factor levels, and ultimate allocation of grade levels to positions.

• Communicates grade distinctions to management with supporting criteria and justification.

• Provides recommendations to management on organizational design.

• Prepares and reviews positions and/or job descriptions.

• Writes reports of and prepares evaluation statements as required for internal activity use or in response to external requirements.

• Responsible for position classification determinations of competitive level, factor levels, FLSA applicability, supervisory/managerial codes; need for submission of financial statements; acquisition program documentation, etc.

• Locates, interprets, analyzes and applies OPM and Inter-Agency Classification Standards and Guides.

• Determines the correct classification by comparison to existing standards related to the work.

• Explains the standards, classification decisions, and impact of designated duties on classification.

• Conducts desk audits and position reviews and discusses the classification appeal procedures to employees, supervisors, and operating officials or managers.

• Inputs and extracts data from a wide variety of source materials, to include, but not limited to DCPDS, USA Staffing, and Defense Ready. Ensures the prompt processing of all personnel Classification actions and accurate position documentation in DCPDS. Builds and validates positions in DCPDS to prepare actions for processing. Maintains an accurate automated tracking system of all classification actions. Obtains data and reports from DCPDS and other HR automation systems, performs a variety of special projects, e.g. quality control of position data in DCPDS, positions builds, and merit pay reviews.

• Advises organizational leadership regarding classification, position management, organizational alignment and to address questions regarding aspects of classification strategies.

• Expected to independently carry out assignments and provide sound management advice to operating officials.

Requirements:

• Clearance: Secret Security Clearance

• Experience:

• At least five years of government Classification experience, preferably within the Department of Defense or Field Activities.

• Experience with DCPDS, USA Staffing, Defense Ready, and additional federal HR-related products.

• Knowledge of a wide range of HR classification principles, concepts, laws, policies, and procedures coupled with seasoned consultative skills to provide staff-level advice, develop solutions to complex issues, manage projects, prepare briefings and provide recommendations to improve internal operations.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
LogicGate® is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.

Excited about LogicGate but not familiar with GRC?

• GRC stands for Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• GRC professionals help their companies manage uncertainty, act with integrity, and stay on the right side of the law.

• The GRC market is rapidly expanding with continuous growth opportunities. The current market size was valued at $50.5 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031.

Senior Product Marketing Manager

Location: Bellevue, WA (Hybrid) or Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

About the Role

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own the strategic product marketing strategy for a core area of our Risk Cloud® portfolio. Unlike  execution-focused roles that operate within existing marketing frameworks, you will build strategy and  messaging from the ground up—shaping our positioning, driving high-impact go-to-market (GTM) launches, and elevating how LogicGate wins against the competition. This high-visibility role bridges Product, Sales, and Marketing, serving as a key market strategist who translates customer intelligence and AI-driven product capabilities into business growth.

What You’ll Do

• Define Strategic Positioning & Messaging: Develop and own messaging frameworks from the ground up for your product areas; validate positioning with customers, market research, and analyst feedback to ensure consistency across all external channels.

• Lead End-to-End GTM Strategy: Contribute to comprehensive GTM strategies for major product and feature launches, making high-level strategic decisions on timing, audience segmentation, channel mix, and narrative alignment while developing strategies for GTM “plays” that will drive sales for our products.

• Become a Product Expert: Develop deep technical expertise with our GRC applications and agents. You’ll serve as a valued contributor in product planning, a product expert for the GTM organization, developing and delivering demos to diverse audiences.

• Own Competitive & Market Intelligence: Establish systematic competitive tracking (win/loss analysis, pricing intelligence, analyst evaluations); translate insights into high-impact battlecards and actionable GTM strategies that directly boost win rates.

• Drive Sales Enablement Effectiveness: Design enablement strategies and produce compelling, enterprise-ready GTM assets—including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery frameworks, and demo guides—measuring impact through rep adoption, accelerated sales cycles, and win rate improvements.

• Champion Customer & Buyer Insights: Conduct direct buyer research, customer interviews, and advisory programs to uncover market pain points that inform both GTM strategy and Product roadmap direction.

• Elevate Analyst & Industry Positioning: Partner with Product and Marketing leadership on portfolio strategy; actively participate in analyst relations engagements (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave) to solidify LogicGate's market leadership.

• Leverage AI & Modern Tooling: Explore and integrate AI-powered workflows and intelligence tools to optimize competitive research, content creation, and buyer persona profiling.

What You Bring

Required

• 5–8 years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing experience, with proven ownership of strategic positioning and messaging frameworks for a dedicated product line or enterprise portfolio.

• Demonstrated Track Record: Proven history of creating GTM strategies and positioning that directly improved pipeline velocity, competitive win rates, and platform differentiation.

• Competitive Intelligence Depth: Experience building and running systematic competitive research and win/loss programs that influenced active deal strategies and company positioning.

• Sales Enablement Focus: Demonstrated ability to build sales tools (battlecards, pitch decks, buyer guides) that reps actually use and that deliver measurable business outcomes.

• Executive Presence: Strong communication and presentation skills with the confidence to influence senior sales leaders, product executives, and external stakeholders.

• Customer-Centric Mindset: Hands-on experience conducting qualitative and quantitative customer research to validate positioning and value propositions.

• AI Literacy & Curiosity: Enthusiastic about leveraging emerging AI technologies to streamline marketing execution or experience articulating the value of AI-driven SaaS features to enterprise buyers.

Nice to Have

• Domain Expertise: Familiarity with GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance), enterprise risk management, cybersecurity, or regulatory compliance software.

• Analyst Relations Experience: Prior participation in analyst evaluations, briefings, or report submissions with firms like Gartner or Forrester.

• Mentorship Background: Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior product marketers or cross-functional team members.

The anticipated base salary range for the role is $120,000 - $150,000 per year + variable + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

Office Location

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Viceroy
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the execution of REGENT's flagship Viceroy Seaglider program - the schedule, the budget, the risks, and the cross-functional machine that turns a vehicle design into reality. You are the single person accountable for how and when the program delivers.

You will partner directly with the Chief Engineer, who owns the vehicle-level technical baseline, in a deliberate split of authority: the CE defines what must be true technically at each milestone; you own delivering it. Together with the VP of Programs, you will drive Viceroy through its major design gates - PDR, CDR - and into build and test.

You'll build and run the program's operating rhythm: the integrated master schedule, the risk and issue process, gate readiness, resource and budget planning, and the reporting that gives leadership an honest picture of where the program stands. You'll also build the program team around you, developing PMO teammates into owners of their own scope.

Success means Viceroy runs on a credible, controlled baseline that every functional lead understands and leadership trusts - and that the program hits its gates without heroics. If you're energized by owning execution on a genuinely new class of vehicle, we'd love to meet you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Program Execution: Serve as PM of record for the Viceroy Seaglider program. Own the integrated master schedule, budget, and risk posture, and drive the program through PDR, CDR, and toward build and test.

 - Build and Run the Program Baseline: Develop a bottom-up, credible IMS with mapped cross-functional dependencies and an actively managed critical path. Control changes to the baseline deliberately and transparently.

 - Drive Risk and Issue Management: Run a living program risk process — owners, mitigations, decision dates — that forces decisions early instead of documenting problems late.

 - Partner with the Chief Engineer: Operate the CE/PM partnership that runs the program: technical authority with the CE, execution authority with you, and a shared definition of gate readiness.

 - Integrate the Cross-Functional Machine: Align Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Certification behind one plan — including long-lead procurement, test campaigns, and certification evidence flow.

 - Communicate the Truth: Deliver program statuses that leadership trusts: what's on track, what's at risk, and what decisions or resources are needed — early and without spin.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Program Leadership Through Design Gates: Deep expertise in managing complex hardware development programs, including serving as PM of record for a vehicle-level program or major integrated system through PDR/CDR or equivalent gates.

 - Schedule and Baseline Rigor: Demonstrated ability to build and maintain an integrated master schedule with a managed critical path, and to re-baseline credibly when reality changes.

 - Risk Management That Drives Decisions: Track record of running risk processes that changed program outcomes — funded mitigations, descoped content, moved dates — before problems became crises.

 - Matrix Leadership: Proven ability to drive functional teams that don't report to you, through credibility, crisp decision framing, and disciplined escalation.

 - Regulated Development Experience: Familiarity with how certification or qualification (FAA, EASA, USCG, class societies, military airworthiness, or comparable) shapes program plans, evidence, and test campaigns.

 - Technical Fluency: Enough engineering depth to interrogate estimates, dependencies, and test logic across structures, propulsion, and systems — you can't be snowed.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe great things happen when teams work together. You partner effectively across engineering, manufacturing, certification, and leadership — driving alignment without sacrificing speed.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on bringing structure to ambiguity. You don't just track problems — you develop recovery options and force timely decisions.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, evolving environment, you balance rigor with speed. You know when to add process and when to simplify.

 - Innovative Mindset: You're driven by building something that hasn't existed before — and by making the program machine around it better every month.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation including a robust equity incentive plan.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance - we cover 100% of your premiums.

 - 401(k) with company matching, so you can plan for the future.

 - Generous flexible time off, paid parental leave, and company-wide holiday breaks.

 - Relocation packages available for those moving to join our team.

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Ke spolupráci nepotřebuješ znát složité opravy motorů – stačí, když tě baví auta, rád/a komunikuješ s lidmi a chceš nechat svůj otisk na projektu, který budujeme úplně od nuly. Co tě u nás čeká?

Jak si tě představujeme?

 - Vztah k autům a ŘP sk. B: Auta tě zkrátka baví a jsi aktivní řidič/ka. Předchozí zkušenosti z oboru jsou výhodou, ale ne podmínkou.

 - Spolehlivost a zručnost: Jsi zodpovědný člověk, nebojíš se vzít za práci a nechybí ti manuální zručnost.

 - Práce s PC: Zvládneš běžnou administrativu a zápis dat do počítače.

Co ti za tvou skvělou práci nabídneme?

 - Možnost placeného volna – když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

 - Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma – přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce každý den.

 - Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu – máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

jobs.description:

We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble capital to allow them to take courageous leaps. Those big leaps in human health and sustainability exponentially accelerate scientific progress in areas ranging from cancer detection and treatment to nature-positive agriculture.

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our scientific founders, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and transform for the benefit of people and planet.

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

The Associate Director / Director, International Accounting & Government Compliance will own accounting, compliance, and financial close for Flagship Pioneering’s international subsidiaries, partnering closely with Flagship’s outsourced international service provider, Vistra, to ensure accurate and timely local and consolidated reporting. The role supports Flagship’s continued international expansion, coordinating with outsourced providers, Legal, and HR as new entities and jurisdictions come online, and serves as a key finance partner on international billing and allocations and UK-based equity and compensation matters. The role also has oversight of Flagship’s government contracting entity, acting as the primary financial bridge between Flagship, the portfolio companies performing work under the government contract, and the third-party partners that help facilitate and support that relationship with the government.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on accounting and compliance professional with experience managing multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction financial operations, coordinating outsourced service providers, and partnering cross-functionally across finance, legal, HR, and compensation teams.

Key Responsibilities

Operating Model, Governance & UK Playbook

• Establish the operating playbook for Flagship’s international operations, partnering cross-functionally with Legal, HR, Treasury, Tax, and Compensation on entity structure and setup

• Own accounting and administration for UK-based equity and compensation programs, partnering with the US Compensation team on program design, reporting, and compliance

• Define governance oversight at the Flagship level for international entities, effectively replicating Flagship’s operating and company-creation engine in the UK

International Accounting, Compliance & Financial Close

• Own accounting and compliance for Flagship Pioneering’s international subsidiaries, including financial close, review of local reporting packages, journal entries, and intercompany eliminations

• Ensure accurate and timely recording of transactions in local statutory books and in the parent company’s consolidated financial statements, including proper accounting for foreign currency translation and transactions (CTA, FX gains/losses)

• Own the annual compliance and financial audit process, serving as primary point of contact for external auditors, local statutory advisors, and tax authorities

• Coordinate local statutory audits and tax return filings, and monitor regulatory and compliance requirements across jurisdictions to ensure timely filings

• Maintain internal controls and compliance with Flagship’s accounting policies across international entities

• Own the day-to-day relationship with Vistra, Flagship’s international outsourced support provider, including evaluation and onboarding of new outsourced providers as the international footprint expands

• Partner with Legal and HR on entity setup, registrations, and compliance requirements as new international entities and jurisdictions come online

International Billing & Allocations

• Support international billing and cost allocation processes across Flagship entities

• Partner with Finance Operations team on international billing and allocations, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of intercompany charges

Government Contracting Financial Reporting

• Partner with heads of finance and operational teams at portfolio companies on matters related to Flagship’s government contracting entity

• Develop and maintain aggregated budget-to-actual reports for senior leadership

• Perform close activities for Flagship’s government contracting entity

• Partner with third-party advisors supporting the government contracting relationship, helping facilitate coordination between Flagship and the government

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Legal, HR, Treasury, Tax, and the US Compensation team to support international operations

• Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis to finance leadership on international entity performance and compliance status

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA preferred

• 8+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction accounting

• Experience supporting international expansion and new entity setup

• Experience managing outsourced service providers (e.g., Vistra or similar) across multiple countries

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, with working knowledge of IFRS and local statutory GAAP frameworks

• Experience managing statutory financial audits and tax compliance across international entities

• Experience with foreign currency accounting, consolidations, and intercompany transactions

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; ability to work with both scientists and management

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple entity obligations and deadlines across time zones

Preferred

• Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, venture capital, or a similarly fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

• Experience partnering with compensation teams on the design, reporting, and compliance of UK equity compensation programs (e.g., EMI option schemes)

• Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP system

• MBA and/or additional international tax or treasury experience a plus

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Cybersecurity Architect
jobs.description:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As our Staff Engineer - Cybersecurity Architect, you will translate Back Market Cyber and IT strategy into a global Cybersecurity architecture by connecting the business processes with the application, data and infrastructure layers. Your ultimate goal is to design an organisation-wide secure architectural plan. You will play a crucial role in the digital transformation within Back Market.

You will be the owner for the creation of architecture models that reflect the company's strategies and goals and take responsibility for securing the enterprise architecture within one or more domains.

You'll be part of the Platform Dept which covers several squads, including about thirty people working on IT, GRC, SecOps, and other areas.

You will be the owner for the creation of architecture models that reflect the company's strategies and goals and take responsibility for securing the enterprise architecture within one or more domains.

You’ll do this by:

 - Analyzing business needs from an architectural point of view to translate them into performant and coherent ICT solutions

 - Developing, implementing, monitoring, evaluating and adjusting the architecture in order to have a coherent framework within projects and developments

 - Presenting and developing recommendations and translating them into executable roadmaps

 - Creating secure architecture patterns for complex and large technology environments together with stakeholders

 - Identifying and specifying implementation modalities of both existing and new technologies
   

You play a crucial role as a point of contact for both business and IT when it comes to Back Market ICT architecture.

You’ll do this by:

 - Providing guidance on enterprise architecture and systems processing in the data, application, integration, security and technology areas.

 - Promoting continuous improvement and development of methodologies used, among others.

 - Proposing improvements to optimise the functionality of the IT department with a view to cost efficiency, among other things.

 - Building a bridge between IT and business by advising management on complex ICT issues, ensuring decision-making.
   

You identify challenges and opportunities in collaboration with stakeholders to ensure the success of your projects.

You do this by:

 - Reconciling conflicting requirements and functions by finding appropriate technological solutions.

 - Facilitating and leading the substantive decision-making process within the project team. You define and follow the validation mechanisms.

 - You ensure that decisions on the projects are made on the basis of solid governance.

 - You keep abreast of evolutions and developments in IT architecture and relevant technologies. You estimate their usability and possibilities within the context of Back mMarket. In this way, you contribute to defining the future-oriented prevailing principles and frameworks.

 - Conduct technical risk analyses to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across systems, applications, architectures, and technology initiatives, providing actionable recommendations aligned with security standards and business objectives.
   
   As a Staff Engineer - Cybersecurity Architect  at Back Market, you will have a critical responsibility to enhance the security posture of Backmarket's entire IT landscape. 
   
   You will be tasked with the following:
   
   
   
   - Collaborating closely with IT teams to integrate security best practices into both the design and implementation phases of IT projects.
   
   - Translate high-level security policies set by the GRC team into detailed technical solutions within project designs and IT changes.
   
   - Ensure that all new and existing IT projects are compliant with the latest security standards and practices.
   
   - Design and recommend security standards, security architecture principles and technical requirements.
   
   - Perform technical risk assessments and provide technical mitigations
     
     
   
   
   WHAT MAKES YOU THE RIGHT PROFILE FOR A STAFF ENGINEER - CYBERSECURITY ARCHITECT ?
   
   

 - You have at least 10 years of experience within security and tech & you have previous enterprise security architecture experience

 - You breathe security architecture and get your satisfaction from delivering architectural deliverables. As a result, you inspire colleagues and fuel their drive

 - Your analytical mind enables you to understand the complex business model and associated systems. By applying secure architectural patterns, you achieve successful translation into designs and system requirements, among other things

 - You bring simplicity and transparency to communication, subordinating the complexity of the technical solutions to the target architecture

 - You are always attentive to technological developments and know how to translate them into business opportunities. By taking your advisory role within this position, you know how to convince management of the necessary evolutions

 - You keep in touch with the technical implementation aspects, making you an understanding interlocutor for the technical teams

 - You see documentation and communication as essential, so that the architecture is supported by the entire Back Market organisation
   
   
   Requirements and qualifications

 - In-depth knowledge of GCP cloud

 - Security by design/Zero trust/Defense in depth

 - IA security (MCP, Claude, Opencode, etc)

 - Security of MAC endpoints

 - Expertise in IAM (Okta) systems and standards.

 - Familiarity with compliance requirements and industry standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST frameworks.




HIRING PROCESS 



 - Visio call to get to know you better by a TA - 45 min

 - Technical Interview - 60 min

 - Meet your team - 45 min

 - Stakeholder interview - 45 min

 - Meet the Staff community - 30 min

 - BM Values interview - 45 min
   
   
   
   
   
   
   
   


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Benefits Verification and Auth Specialist - Full-Time (Evenings/Overnight Shift, Flexible Schedule)

Company Overview:

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, their teams, and the patients they serve. As the fastest-growing company in the therapy EMR space, Prompt is setting a new standard in healthcare technology. We're tackling some of the healthcare industry’s most persistent problems with a team of exceptionally talented individuals passionate about creating a positive impact.

At Prompt, we don’t just digitize healthcare—we transform it. From improving patient care to reducing environmental waste, our work supports better outcomes at scale.

Why work for Prompt?

 - BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

 - Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

 - Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank, we work long hours when it's needed, but at Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

 - Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back everyday, but it does feel good :)

The Role:

The BVA Specialist – Evening/Overnight is responsible for providing after-hours benefit verification coverage for appointments scheduled or insurance information added late in the day for the following day.

This role serves as an extension of the daytime BVA team, ensuring newly added next-day visits are identified and worked before clinics open. The BVA Specialist will verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits, identify authorization requirements, document findings accurately, and ensure any items that cannot be completed overnight are clearly handed off for follow-up.

When next-day coverage is complete, this role will support additional BVA work and priorities as needed.  This role is essential to ensuring a smooth revenue cycle, preventing avoidable claim denials, and minimizing the impact of late scheduling activity on our customers and their patients.

Hours & Schedule

Your weekly schedule will consist of:

 - Sunday Nights (Fixed): 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM EST (includes a 1-hour lunch break) to provide critical support during our biweekly product releases.

 - Monday – Thursday: Flexible 8-hour evening/overnight shifts (plus a 1-hour lunch) with customizable start/end times (e.g., 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM, or 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM EST) to fit your lifestyle.

 - Fridays & Saturdays: Off

Position Summary:

The BV&A Specialist is responsible for verifying patient insurance eligibility and benefits, obtaining necessary authorizations, and communicating requirements to providers. This role is essential to ensuring a smooth revenue cycle, preventing claim denials, and enhancing the overall patient financial journey.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Monitor customer schedules for next-day appointments scheduled or insurance information added after standard daytime BVA coverage.

 - Verify patient insurance coverage, eligibility, and benefits prior to next-day services.

 - Determine patient responsibility for copays, deductibles, and coinsurance.

 - Prioritize work based on appointment timing, ensuring the earliest next-day appointments are addressed first.

 - Identify prior authorization requirements and complete appropriate next steps when possible.

 - Clearly document and hand off authorization needs or other items requiring payer or clinic follow-up during normal business hours.

 - Document benefit verification and authorization details accurately in the system.

 - Identify missing information or other barriers preventing verification and clearly document required next steps.

 - Provide a clear handoff to the daytime BVA team for outstanding items that cannot be completed overnight.

 - Collaborate with BVA, scheduling, billing, and AR teams to ensure accurate workflows.

 - Identify trends in late-added appointments, benefit issues, or authorization barriers and escalate as needed.

 - Support denial prevention efforts by ensuring payer requirements are identified and addressed upfront.

 - Support additional BVA work and operational priorities once next-day coverage is complete.

Minimum Requirements

 - 1–2 years of experience in benefit verification, medical insurance, or prior authorization.

 - Strong knowledge of commercial and government payers, insurance policies, and healthcare terminology.

 - Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

 - Strong communication skills with ability to work across patients, providers, and payers.

 - Familiarity with payer authorization portals and workflows.

 - Knowledge of denial management and insurance appeal processes.

 - Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and make sound decisions with limited real-time supervision.

 - High degree of reliability, integrity, and personal accountability, with a proven ability to be trusted with time-sensitive responsibilities and follow through on commitments.

Perks - What you can expect:

 - Competitive salaries

 - Remote/hybrid environment

 - Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

 - Flexible PTO

 - Company-wide sponsored lunches

 - Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

 - Company paid family and medical leave

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

 - Discounted pet insurance

 - FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

 - 401k

 - Complimentary subscription to digital fitness classes and wellness content

 - Recovery suite at HQ – includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower



Here at Prompt, we are committed to fostering a fair and respectful work environment. As part of this commitment, it is our policy not to hire individuals from Prompt Customers unless they have obtained their current employer's explicit consent. We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our People Department.

Prompt Therapy Solutions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, color, religion, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

It also involves coordinating with the EGX to resolve issues, working with other teams, along with identifying the root causes of issues.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Register users with EGX, end to end

• Write and edit SQL queries to pull and review data

• Prepare and run daily operational scripts (ID downloads, bookings, etc.)

• Review your own work and track each case.

• Coordinate with the EGX and other teams to resolve issues




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Strong data entry accuracy

• Good working knowledge of Google Sheets (functions, filters)

• High attention to detail, especially with documentation and data accuracy

• Strong sense of ownership — able to work with minimal supervision.

• Confident communication skills.

• Comfortable coordinating with other teams/departments

• Analytical mindset — able to trace an issue back to its root cause




NICE TO HAVE

WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.description:
About Sesame

Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike - with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sesame is building a complex & compact wearable machine perception system requiring custom electronics, sensors, mechanical parts, and test/assembly fixtures.  We need a patient, skilled, and proactive Electrical Engineering technician to assemble, debug, and maintain prototypes and evaluation systems, along with the vendors and equipment required to produce them.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Assembly, test, debug, and rework of compact electro-mechanical systems, including fine-pitched soldering, small-scale paste/reflow; custom cables and adapters, and sub-cm enclosures with plastic/metal/composite materials.

 - Order, use, and maintain electrical test equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, DMMs, spectrum analyzers, and standard-specific compliance testers.

 - Develop and maintain build & debug procedures for prototypes.

 - Operation and debugging of automated component test and data collection systems.

 - Engage and manage fabrication vendors to deliver components, PCB/PCBAs, and metal/plastic parts for prototypes.

 - Manage lab space, equipment, supplies, and inventory.





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in consumer electronics or a related field.

 - Mastery of soldering and reflow techniques for fine-pitch components (down to 01005/QFN/BGA 300 µm pitch.

 - Understanding of electrical schematics and mechanical drawings.

 - Comfort and skill in selecting, operating, and maintaining benchtop electrical test equipment.

 - Experience executing test plans for testing electrical systems.

 - Basic understanding of firmware or software test scripts.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

 - Proactive ability and interest in solving technical challenges outside your areas of expertise.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience with wearables or soft goods products.

 - Familiarity with ECAD (Electronic Computer-Aided Design) software.



Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance.

 - Unlimited PTO and sick time
