jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

Infillion is the first fully composable advertising platform, built to solve the complexity, waste, and opacity in the digital media ecosystem. Born from $750 million in investment and the unification of category-defining technologies including MediaMath, TrueX, Gimbal, Drawbridge, and Catalina, Infillion brings together powerful technologies to create a flexible, AI-ready advertising platform.

Headquartered in New York City, Infillion has employees across the US, Costa Rica, and Europe and powers the world's leading brands, agencies, and platforms. Learn more at www.infillion.com.

About the Job

Infillion is seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Engineer to join our Revenue Operations team and help ensure Salesforce is reliable, trusted, secure, and built to scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing and developing custom Salesforce solutions, integrating Salesforce with third-party systems, maintaining and modernizing the existing environment, providing production support, and troubleshooting complex technical issues. The successful candidate will partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, IT, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions, improve data integrity and financial transparency, and continuously enhance the Salesforce platform.

Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end Salesforce development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

• Develop and enhance custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Workflow, and Marketo.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and lead technical and usability reviews.

• Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce API and ETL integrations with third-party ERP, financial reporting, and business systems, including Workday, supporting bi-directional data flows for contracts, billing, revenue forecasting, financial reporting, and ad execution.

• Establish and maintain clear system-of-truth boundaries across Salesforce, ERP, and ELT platforms to ensure accurate, consistent, and trusted data.

• Develop and maintain Salesforce fields, objects, page layouts, SOQL, formulas, validations, Flows, approval processes, and other platform capabilities to optimize business processes.

• Design and maintain Salesforce security and access controls, including profiles, roles, sharing settings, field-level security, and permission sets.

• Evaluate and implement Salesforce AI and automation capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, predictive scoring, and other emerging technologies to improve productivity and intelligent automation.

• Maintain Salesforce DevOps and release processes, including continuous integration, testing, deployment, and change management using tools such as Targetprocess.

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, participate in peer code reviews, and promote strong engineering, development, and governance practices.

• Maintain and modernize existing Salesforce functionality, including addressing technical debt, retiring unused functionality, and migrating legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder automation to modern solutions such as Salesforce Flow.

• Provide Level 2/3 production support, troubleshooting, debugging, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex Salesforce and integration issues.

• Administer and support third-party applications integrated with Salesforce, including DocuSign, Cloudingo, Boomi, Salesforce CPQ, and Workflow Streams, and collaborate with vendors on system upgrades and enhancements.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation for system enhancements, application code, architecture, processes, and system/user flows.

• Mentor junior engineers, provide technical guidance, and lead technical design sessions.

• Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve productivity, efficiency, and business processes.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

• 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, including custom solutions using Apex, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning components.

• Strong proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC), with experience working with Visualforce.

• Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, Salesforce development best practices, data models, security models, and governance limits.

• Experience designing and supporting Salesforce integrations with third-party systems using APIs and ETL/iPaaS technologies.

• Proficiency with Dell Boomi or an equivalent enterprise iPaaS/ETL platform.

• Strong knowledge of Salesforce automation, including Flow, Process Builder, and Workflow Rules.

• Experience modernizing legacy Salesforce automation and migrating Process Builder and Workflow Rules to Salesforce Flow is preferred.

• Experience with Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, testing, and deployment processes.

• Experience working in Agile development environments and participating in peer code reviews.

• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across Salesforce and third-party integrations.

• Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud; knowledge of Service Cloud is a plus.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing requirements, and deliver high-quality solutions.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate and comprehensive technical documentation.

• Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical design and solution discussions.

• JavaScript Developer I, Application Architect, or System Architect experience is required.

• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II and CPQ Specialist certification, or equivalent experience, preferred.

• Ability to stay current with Salesforce innovations, including AI and automation capabilities, and identify opportunities to incorporate new functionality into the existing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Salesforce Platform Developer II certification and/or additional Salesforce certifications.

• CPQ Specialist certification or equivalent Salesforce CPQ experience.

• Experience with Application Architect or System Architect certifications.

• Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Service Cloud, Marketo, or other Salesforce ecosystem products.

• Experience with Dell Boomi or other enterprise iPaaS/integration platforms.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP and financial reporting systems such as Workday.

• Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein, predictive scoring, or intelligent automation.

• Experience modernizing legacy Salesforce automation and migrating Workflow Rules or Process Builder to Salesforce Flow.

• Experience with Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and deployment tools such as Targetprocess.

• Experience providing Level 2/3 production support in a complex Salesforce environment.

• Experience supporting third-party Salesforce applications such as DocuSign, Cloudingo, Boomi, Salesforce CPQ, and Workflow Streams.

• Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design sessions.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Team

LCSP is DoorDash’s entrepreneur-led fleet model: independent partners hire, train, and manage courier fleets that fulfill DoorDash orders. The program has proven product-market fit and is now scaling with a path toward a much larger network. This hire would stand up the Account Management function for LCSP and own the strategy for bringing partners in at scale.

About the Role

For this role the Manager would be the person who builds the Account Management  function — not just covering a book of partners, but designing how DoorDash sources, onboards, and manages LCSP entrepreneurs as volume grows. In the near term that includes overseeing entrepreneur onboarding and recruitment of business partners. In the longer-term the goal is to build those out as their own functions, with AM remaining the owner of the ongoing partner relationship.

The primary responsibilities include:

• Stand up Account Management for LCSP: cadences, partner health, performance incentives, and the playbook for a scaling

• Own the strategy for onboarding partners — how we find, launch, and ramp without the process breaking as we scale

• Oversee onboarding and sales in the near term, with the mandate to build that function out over time

• Be the primary DoorDash counterpart for LCSP entrepreneurs after launch

• Partner with operators on performance, business health and incentive outcomes

• Use DoorDash ecosystem knowledge to unblock partners, pulling in S&O, product, support, and legal as needed. You will report to the Senior Manager on our Local Commerce Service Provider (LCSP) team in our Dasher & Logistics organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Be responsible for your own book of work as well as designing how its managedBuild scalable solutions with our partners - we want to build with them and leverage their professional expertise and feedbackBe part of a flat structure and pave the way for LCSP expansion Learn how the logistics business within DoorDash works from being in the weeds to the high level objectives

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 5+ years of experience in high-growth environments (tech, fintech, strategy & ops, consulting, or banking).

• You know how to manage Business Partners, their performance, and can turn their insights into ways we can improve

• You can take a vague, undefined problem and structure it yourself — without waiting for a framework — and use data to decide what to do (comfortable with SQL/Excel).

• You are curious and entrepreneurial, and you channel that drive into smart bets and clear priorities in zero-to-one environments.

• You can flex between high-level strategy and ground-level execution, and you take true ownership of outcomes — you make the calls and are accountable for how they turn out, not just for supporting the work.

We expect this position to be filled by 11-14-2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$136,000—$200,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

jobs.title: On Holiday Support Agent
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.



About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.



The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.



Your day-to-day:

 - Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

 - Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

 - Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

 - Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

 - Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

 - Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

 - Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

 - Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

 - Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

 - Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

 - Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

 - Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments
   

Your skillset:

 - Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

 - A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

 - Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

 - Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

 - Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

 - Excellent organisation and attention to detail

 - Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

 - A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures
   

The interview journey:

 1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

 2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes
    

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

 - Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers



At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. jobs.title: Senior Deep Learning Scientist
jobs.description:
Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel 
Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique. 
Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0.  À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques.   
Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique.   

 


Votre équipe 
Rejoignez notre équipe d'ingénieurs IA et Computer Vision, au service de robots autonomes et des viseurs de pointe.
Au cœur de Safran.AI, vous concevrez et développerez des algorithmes d’IA avancés pour la perception visuelle, dans des environnements où fiabilité, précision et robustesse sont critiques. Vous intégrerez et optimiserez les dernières avancées technologiques en Vision ou modèles multimodaux (VLM, VLA) afin de repousser les limites de la perception autonome dans l’aérospatial et la défense.
 
Les enjeux du poste
Nous cherchons quelqu'un capable d'endosser le rôle de Tech lead sur certains projets et de proposer des solutions innovantes tout en restant pragmatique vis-à-vis des contraintes réelles. 
En tant que Senior Deep Learning Scientist, vos tâches seront organisées autour des missions suivantes. 

Conception des solutions IA :
→ Vous concevez les approches algorithmiques permettant de répondre aux besoins opérationnels des clients.
→ Vous êtes amené à travailler sur des problématiques telles que : détection d'objets, reconnaissance, classification, segmentation sémantique, suivi de cibles, fusion multi-capteurs, compréhension de scènes, IA multimodale, navigation autonome. 
→ Vous évaluez différentes approches et identifiez les plus pertinentes selon les contraintes de la mission.

Définition des architectures IA :
→ Vous êtes responsable des choix technologiques relatifs aux modèles d'IA.
→ Vous intervenez notamment sur les modèles IA classiques en Computer Vision, les Foundation Models, les VLM, les VLA, les architectures hybrides vision / géométrie, fusion multi-capteurs.
→ Vous devez être capable d'anticiper les limites et les risques associés à chaque approche.

Analyse et valorisation des données :
→ Vous définissez les stratégies permettant d'exploiter efficacement les données disponibles.
→ Vous travaillez sur la qualification des jeux de données, la stratégie d'annotation, la génération de données synthétiques, l'active learning, la détection des biais, l'analyse des cas d'échec, l'amélioration continue des performances. 
→ Vous êtes capable d'identifier rapidement lorsqu'un problème de performance provient davantage des données que de l'algorithme.

Collaboration avec les ingénieurs Performance IA :
→ Vous travaillez étroitement avec les ingénieurs Performance IA pour respecter les contraintes imposées par le système embarqué. L'objectif est de converger vers des solutions optimales à la fois du point de vue scientifique et du point de vue système. 
 
A propos de vous 
→ Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur avec une forte composante en IA et disposez d’une expertise en Computer Vision et Deep Learning.
→ Vous justifiez d’au moins 6 ans d’expérience en IA appliquée aux systèmes de perception, idéalement dans des environnements industrialisés.
→ Vous maîtrisez les approches Deep Learning, Transformers, Representation Learning, Self-Supervised Learning et Multimodal AI.
→ Vous maîtrisez les principales techniques de Computer Vision : détection et tracking d’objets, segmentation et, idéalement, vision 3D.
→ Vous êtes familier avec les approches Data-Centric AI, notamment la construction de datasets, l’analyse d’erreurs, l’Active Learning et la Domain Adaptation.
→ Vous maîtrisez Python et PyTorch ; des compétences en C++ sont appréciées.
→ Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’expérimentation reproductible, l’évaluation des modèles et leur industrialisation.

jobs.title: Release Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive, versatile, experienced C++ engineer to maintain and improve our build and bake pipelines, as well as automating recurring manual steps involved in the creation and delivery of releases.

Daily responsibilities

• Support and improve the toolset for continuous integration (of both code and data), automated testing and release management for all studio projects.
• Proactively collaborate with Engine and Game C++ teams in order to identify and reduce bottlenecks throughout the processes.
• Improve automatic reporting of issues in the build/bake pipelines.
• Develop and maintain guidelines and practices to facilitate branch-based development workflows, with CI.
• Maintain documentation on processes and tools involved.
• Establish best-practices and guidelines to sustain the solutions and actively advocate for them.
• Provide support and maintain implemented solutions, empowering client teams to meet their deadlines with the adequate quality guarantees.

• Good C++ knowledge.
• Experience working with automation servers for CI (Gitlab preferably).
• Experience with scripting languages (Python preferred).
• Experience working in cross-platform environments (Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, …)
• Experience working with different build systems (MSBuild, gcc/make, xcode, …)
• Strong familiarity with VCS systems such as svn or git.
• Excellent communication and organizational skills.
• Excellent English technical writing level.
• University Degree in relevant subject or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills:

• Good knowledge of Unix/Linux systems.
• Experience with docker/k8s.
• Excellent spoken English level.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year
• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
• Free language courses
• Learning bootcamps and platforms (such as O'Reilly and GDC Vault)
• Birthday day off + option to work a shortened schedule on three days.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model
• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career-development opportunities.
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

jobs.title: Talent Applications Specialist (Part-time)
jobs.description:
GR8_TECH builds B2B iGaming platforms for operators who play to lead.

We deliver full-cycle, high-impact tech designed to scale — from seamless integrations and expert consulting to long-term operational support. Our platform powers millions of active players and drives real business growth. Call it what it is: the iGaming Platform for Champions.

With 1000+ GR8 people across locations and time zones, we don’t just ship technology — we help operators build success stories across brands, markets, and geos.

Our ambition drives us. Our people make it real.

If you’re a challenger in spirit and a champion in action — join us.

Why this role exists:

The purpose of this role is to independently configure, maintain, and optimize Talent Applications to meet business needs and ensure HR data integrity and compliance. It drives the implementation, integration, and user support of HR Tech systems across the organization. The position bridges HR requirements with technical execution while managing application performance and vendor communications.

What you’ll drive:

Talent Applications management

• Independently configure and customize Talent Applications based on business needs.

• Maintain and improve workflows, roles, permissions, templates, and reports.

• Troubleshoot system issues and optimize application performance.

• Gather requirements and translate HR needs into clear technical specifications.

• Research, test, and support the implementation of new features and improvements.

Integrations & projects

• Support integrations between Talent Applications and other business systems.

• Contribute to HR and cross-functional projects involving Talent Applications.

• Coordinate owned parts of system implementation and improvement projects.

• Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to deliver effective solutions.

User support & enablement

• Provide first-line support to end-users and resolve application-related issues.

• Deliver user training and help stakeholders make effective use of Talent Applications.

• Create and maintain clear user guides and system documentation.

• Translate technical concepts into practical guidance for non-technical users.

Data & compliance

• Monitor HR data in Talent Applications and maintain its accuracy and integrity.

• Manage access rights and support appropriate permissions across systems.

• Ensure Talent Applications comply with internal IT security standards and applicable regulatory requirements, including GDPR.

• Identify and address data or access-related issues proactively.

Vendor management & continuous improvement

• Maintain regular communication with Talent Applications vendors.

• Evaluate vendor updates and coordinate their successful deployment.

• Stay up to date with emerging HR Tech tools, features, and best practices.

• Share knowledge and identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing solutions.

What makes you a GR8 fit:

Must-have

• Hands-on experience configuring and administering HR software applications such as HRIS, ATS, performance management, or learning management systems.

• Experience customizing workflows, roles, permissions, templates, and other system settings.

• Understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Experience troubleshooting HR systems and resolving configuration or user-related issues.

• Understanding of basic API and integration logic.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to finding solutions.

• Intermediate+ English for communication with vendors and internal stakeholders and preparation of documentation.

• Fluent Ukrainian or Russian for effective communication with local stakeholders and end-users.

Nice-to-have

• Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other business applications.

• Knowledge of GDPR, ISO, and other HR or IT compliance requirements.

• Experience working with Talent Applications vendors.

• Experience in HR Tech or a similar systems-focused role.

• Experience delivering user training and creating technical documentation.

Why you’ll love working here:

Benefits Cafeteria — annual budget you allocate to:

Sports • Medical • Mental health • Home office • Languages.

Work-life & support

• Paid maternity/paternity leave + monthly childcare allowance.

• 20+ vacation days, unlimited sick leave, emergency time off.

• Remote-first + tech support + coworking compensation.

• Team events (online/offline/offsite).

• Learning culture with internal courses + growth programs.

Our culture & core values:

GR8_TECH culture is how we win — through trust, ownership, and a growth mindset. We move fast, stay curious, and keep it real, with open feedback, room to experiment, and a team that’s got your back.

FUELLED BY TRUST: we’re open, honest, and have each other’s backs.

OWN YOUR GAME: we take initiative and own what we do.

ACCELER8: we move fast, focus smart, and keep it simple.

CHALLENGE ACCEPTED: we grow through challenges and stay curious.

BULLETPROOF: we’re resilient, ready, and always have a plan.

jobs.title: Shared Living Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is currently seeking a motivated and dedicated Shared Living Coordinator (SLC) who plays a vital role in the support and oversight of Home Care Providers to ensure the overall health and safety of the individuals supported in Shared Living arrangements.  The SLC collaborates with the Aspire management team, coworkers, state agencies, family members, guardians, medical/mental health providers and others in the community to make sure individuals are safe, their needs are met, and their lives are as rich and fulfilling as possible

Our ideal candidate:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience

• Excellent interpersonal skills, organizational, administrative and communication skills

• Knowledge of funding agency regulations/requirements

• 18 years of age or older

• Ability to provide on-call support

• Must have satisfactory background checks

• Valid driver’s license and safe driving record

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance - Choose from multiple medical plans, with vision coverage included at no extra cost.

As Senior Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

• Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.

• Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.

BONUS POINTS

• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
• Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
• Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
• Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Free language courses

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. Position Overview:

Support freight cost planning, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and inventory valuation activities by providing accurate data analysis and reporting while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Transportation Finance

• Prepare and maintain inventory, freight, and duty cost data for inbound and outbound logistics.

• Coordinate with Logistics and SCM teams to collect and validate freight-related cost information.

• Monitor freight costs trends and highlight significant variances.

• Support cost analysis activities and provide data for decision-making.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Support the preparation of annual budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning activities.

• Gather and analyze inputs from Logistics and SCM teams for cost projections.

• Track actual costs against budgets and report variances.

• Assist in maintaining cost-related KPIs and reporting dashboards.

Cost Variance Analysis

• Analyze inventory, inbound freight, outbound freight cost variances.

• Support root-cause analysis for significant cost deviations.

• Prepare monthly reports on logistics and transportation cost performance.

• Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities through data analysis.

New Product Costing Support

• Support landed cost estimations for new products in collaboration with PD and Logistics teams.

• Assist in preparing costing analyses and business case evaluations.

• Monitor cost changes throughout product development phases.

• Support benchmarking activities and market cost comparisons.

Cost Reporting & Management Information

• Prepare periodic freight and logistics cost reports.

• Develop and maintain cost tracking dashboards and performance reports.

• Analyze cost trends, savings initiatives, and localization benefits.

• Provide support for budgeting and forecasting activities related to logistics costs.

Inventory Management

• Assist in monthly inventory valuation and reconciliation processes.

• Analyze inventory movements, aging, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory and highlight risks.

• Support physical inventory counts and cycle count activities by validating inventory records and investigating discrepancies.

• Prepare inventory-related reports and KPIs to support management decision-making.

• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Warehouse, and Operations teams to improve inventory accuracy and turnover.

• Assist in identifying inventory cost reduction opportunities and working capital improvement initiatives.

• Support system master data maintenance related to inventory valuation and material costing.

Data Integrity & ERP Costing Support

• Maintain the accuracy of costing data within SAP and related systems.

• Support master data maintenance for costing structures, routings, and logistics-related parameters.

• Perform periodic data validation and reconciliation activities.

• Assist in identifying and resolving data quality issues impacting cost reporting.

Minimum Qualifications & Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or related field

• Master’s degree in business administration (MBA) – preferred

• At least 10 years’ relevant experience

• Proven technical, quantitative and critical-thinking skills, high level of independent judgment, initiative and creativity to identify and clearly communicate key performance drivers to senior management

• Ability to manage multiple projects and assignments with a high degree of autonomy and accountability for results

• Demonstrated effective written, interpersonal and oral communication skills

• Established ability using Microsoft Office software with a high proficiency with Excel

• Finance analyst experience at an Automotive OEM or Tier 1 Supplier – a huge plus!

• Strong understanding of inventory, Inbound and Outbound principles and cost drivers.

• Analytical mindset with ability to translate complex data into actionable insights

• Proven business partnering and stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams

• High attention to detail with focus on data accuracy, integrity and internal controls

• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

• Strong communication and presentation skills

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Školitel/Trainer
jobs.description:
V Opatovicích nad Labem otevíráme zcela nové distribuční centrum. To vytváří jedinečnou příležitost být u všeho od samého začátku, nastavit standardy a přímo ovlivnit novou firemní kulturu i fungování celého skladu.

Jako Warehouse Trainer/Školitel budeš klíčovou postavou celého provozu. Budeš to ty, kdo v Opatovicích přivítá nové tváře, pomůže jim hladce zvládnout onboarding a naučí je všechny procesy i vychytávky správného fungování skladu. Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře – hledáme parťáka přímo do provozu, který má trpělivost, umí lidi motivovat a pomůže jim růst.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

 - Stavba od základu: Budeš u launche nového skladu a pomůžeš vybudovat tým i tréninkové prostředí od prvního dne.

 - Přímý dopad na provoz: Správně zaškolený tým má přímý vliv na efektivitu skladu i na spokojenost koncového zákazníka.

 - Viditelnost a rozvoj: Nejde jen o rutinní školení – budeš úzce spolupracovat s team leadery i manažery a upravovat tréninkové materiály.

 - Práce přímo v centru dění: Budeš v denním kontaktu s lidmi na směně, ne zavřený/á u stolu.

Co tě u nás čeká

 - Kompletní onboarding: Přebereš plnou odpovědnost za proces zaškolování a adaptace nových kolegů ve skladu.

 - Vedení tréninků: Budeš připravovat a vést školení napříč různými odděleními skladu tak, aby všichni dokonale rozuměli svým úkolům a standardům.

 - Partnerství s vedením: Úzká spolupráce s manažery a team leadery při identifikaci tréninkových potřeb a rozvojových priorit.

 - Feedback a podpora: Poskytování pravidelné zpětné vazby, tvorba individuálních adaptačních plánů a motivace lidí na směně.

 - Zlepšování materiálů: Úprava a optimalizace tréninkových podkladů s cílem neustále zefektivňovat procesy.

 - Vyhodnocování úspěšnosti: Sledování výsledků nováčků v provozu a měření reálného dopadu školení.

Co od tebe očekáváme

 - Praxe se školením: 1+ rok zkušeností s trénováním lidí v dynamickém prostředí (logistika, retail, výroba nebo potravinářství).

 - Komunikační schopnosti: Umění zaujmout různorodé skupiny lidí, vysvětlit věci lidsky a jednat férově i v nejasných situacích.

 - Odolnost a pružnost: Schopnost udržet si chladnou hlavu v rušném provozu a rychle najít funkční řešení, když standardní postupy nestačí.

 - Provozní přístup: Pochopení logistických procesů a toho, jak kvalitní zaškolení ovlivňuje finální doručení zákazníkovi.

 - Zkušenost z logistiky: Znalost skladového prostředí a tvorby vlastní tréninkové metodiky je velkou výhodou.

Co ti nabízíme

 - Fair reward & odměna na ošatné: Příspěvek 86 Kč ke každé směně navíc na oblečení.

 - Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma: 10% cashback v podobě kreditů na tvé další nákupy.

 - Jídlo a káva na pracovišti: Dotované obědy, čerstvé ovoce a skvělá káva každý den přímo ve skladu.

 - Odměny mezi kolegy: Vnitrofiremní systém pochval s možností proměnit získané hvězdičky za vouchery do e-shopů (Alza, Notino atd.).

 - Sport & relax: Multisport karta pro tvůj volný čas.

 - Volno na regeneraci: Možnost placeného volna, když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočinout.

 - Tým a akce: Skvělá parta lidi a firemní akce, kde společně oslavujeme úspěchy.

• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations to translate strategy into actionable design, identifying high-impact problems and driving alignment on priorities.

• Simplify complex, ambiguous systems with a client-first, systems-thinking approach, balancing client needs, business goals and technical constraints.

• Craft elegant, intuitive solutions with strong interaction design and visual craft, ensuring consistency and quality across experiences.

• Prototype, test and iterate quickly using research and data, partnering with Product and Data to define success metrics and learning loops.

• Use the most effective tools available to explore and solve problems. This may include tools such as Claude, Codex, Figma Make or other AI-assisted prototyping and coding tools to test assumptions, create working prototypes and improve your own workflow.

• Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than accepting them at face value, using your product judgement to decide what to keep, change or discard.

• Contribute to and extend our design system, improving reusable patterns that help teams ship faster with consistency.

• Partner closely with Engineering through implementation to ensure quality and polish at launch.

• Contribute to design culture through critiques, workshops and reviews - raising the bar through craft and collaboration.

What you’ll need

• Relevant professional experience within UX or Product Design, with scope and expectations assessed according to Level 3 or Level 4.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong craft and product intuition, with expertise in layout, typography, hierarchy and interaction design.

• Demonstrated experience shipping digital products, ideally across responsive web and multiple surfaces.

• Experience designing responsive and adaptive layouts, component-based systems and platform-aware interaction patterns.

• Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance client needs, business goals and technical realities and make deliberate, data-informed trade-offs.

• A strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity about new ways of working. We care less about proficiency in a specific AI tool and more about your ability to break down problems, question assumptions, experiment quickly and find creative ways to move from an idea to something tangible.

• Comfort working beyond the traditional boundaries of Product Design - exploring prototypes, code, data or new tools when they help you understand or solve a problem better.

• Proven collaboration skills across Design, Product and Engineering disciplines.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.

• Ability to balance and prioritise multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Fintech experience, or experience within similarly complex, data-heavy or regulated products, is strongly preferred.

Why Ebury?

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

jobs.title: Account Executive - US Market
jobs.description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values 

 - Care
   We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

 - Bias for Action
   We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

 - Ownership
   We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

This is a unique opportunity to join Prelude as our second AE in the United States and help build our presence in a key market. This Account Executive role at Prelude is built for a high-energy, outbound-first seller who thrives prospecting and knows how to move fast. You'll be hunting and closing SMB deals at volume - owning the full cycle through to signed contract. If you love the grind of building pipeline from scratch, have a knack for quick discovery, and get a buzz from a fast close, this is the role for you.

This is a fully remote role based in the United States. 

What will you be doing? 

 - Running a high-volume outbound motion - cold calling, cold emailing, and LinkedIn prospecting daily to build pipeline from the ground up, as well as working closely with our high performing BDRs

 - Owning the full sales cycle end-to-end, through to closed-won, typically within a short sales cycle

 - Quickly qualifying SMB prospects through sharp, conversational discovery to identify pain and move deals forward fast

 - Delivering concise, punchy demos tailored to SMB buyers 

 - Hitting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for pipeline generation, activities, and closed revenue

 - Keeping HubSpot clean and up to date for accurate forecasting 

What are we looking for? 

 - At least 2 years of proven experience running a full outbound sales cycle, with a track record of closing high-volume SMB deals fast

 - A cold calling native - you're comfortable picking up the phone 50+ times a day and know how to hook a prospect in the first 30 seconds

 - SaaS sales experience is a must  - you'll know what an API is and can hold your own in a conversation with a technical buyer

 - Consistent quota attainment and overachievement - we want to see the numbers, not just the narrative

 - Sharp, instinctive discovery skills - you can uncover pain quickly

 - Natural curiosity and hunger to become a product expert, so every conversation is relevant and consultative

 - Fluency in English

 - Familiarity with HubSpot is a nice to have

 - Genuine excitement for what Prelude is building

Interview process

 - Meet a member of the Talent team

 - Interview with Sales

 - Roleplay session with Sales

 - Final meeting with the CEO

We care more about your potential and motivation than your resume. If you're excited about the role and want to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Infrastructure Operations and Compliance
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin

Position Overview

Cloudflare is looking for a Senior Manager to lead a unified Infrastructure Operations function spanning physical network reliability, operational security, and global regulatory compliance across 750+ data center sites in 125+ countries. The leader in this role ensures 24x7 operational availability of Cloudflare's network infrastructure through incident response, hardware break-fix, circuit management, and physical hardware lifecycle operations. This leader also owns  physical access control policy and administration, periodic access reviews, and evidence-based compliance delivery across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP.

You will lead two teams, setting organizational direction, building talent, and being accountable for outcomes across the full lifecycle of Cloudflare's physical infrastructure: from how hardware is deployed and maintained, to how access is controlled and reviewed, to how assets are securely retired and evidenced for audit. The breadth of this scope demands a leader who can hold the org-level tensions, speed versus rigor, global scale versus precise detail, partner dependency versus uncompromising standards, without losing either end.

You will bring credibility across both dimensions of this role. On the infrastructure side, a strong grasp of data center colocation environments, network architecture, and hardware operations as well as the judgment to lead managers and teams who live in that world every day. On the compliance side, the organizational instinct to maintain audit readiness continuously, not just at cycle time, and the stakeholder fluency to navigate relationships with GRC, government auditors, and strategic global partners. Above all, you will bring a bias toward building smarter processes, better tooling, and AI-assisted operations that multiply your team's capacity as Cloudflare's footprint continues to grow.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership

• Lead two teams, the Operations team and the Security and Compliance team.

• Set goals, develop talent, and build a culture of operational excellence and compliance-consciousness across both functions

• Hold both teams to shared SLAs and quality standards, balancing the urgency of 24x7 incident response with the rigor of compliance audit cycles

• Serve as the escalation point for cross-team issues, complex vendor negotiations, and decisions that touch both operational and regulatory domains

Unified Decommissioning Lifecycle

• Own the end-to-end DECOM process as a single, governed workflow: physical collections and unracking, secure asset destruction with CoD issuance (ITAD vendor management), serial number verification, compliance evidence filing, and records closure

• Eliminate the current handoff gap between Maintain's physical operations and DCSC's compliance oversight building a single, auditable pipeline from "decom triggered" to "evidence archived”.

• Drive ITAD vendor relationships, escalation paths, and contractual SLAs for asset destruction across all regions (APAC, EMEA, NASA, South America)

• Maintain audit-readiness of decommissioning records for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and FedRAMP control requirements

Maintain Team Operational Accountability

• Accountable for 24x7 incident response coverage across all Cloudflare locations: carrier outages, DC facility issues, hardware degradation, and power/temperature events.

• Oversee hardware break-fix operations including coordination with Metro Technicians, third-party repair vendors and remote contractors.

• Drive maturity in circuit decommissioning, RMA management, and physical collections processes

• Ensure on-call schedules, handover protocols, and incident SLAs are consistently met across APAC, EMEA, and NASA shifts.

DCSC Compliance & Access Control Accountability

• Accountable for quarterly and monthly access review cycles (QAR/MAR) across 750+ global data center sites covering SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP Moderate/High, ISMAP, and IRAP frameworks

• Own the physical access provisioning and deprovisioning function, including SLA adherence and ACL integrity

• Serve as the senior owner of the team’s automation initiatives

• Maintain executive-level relationships with GRC leads across all active compliance frameworks; be the accountable voice for DCSC's control obligations in audit conversations

• Represent DCSC at Monthly Business Reviews and executive infrastructure health checks

Automation & Operational Efficiency

• Drive a meaningful reduction in manual operational burden across both teams identifying and prioritizing automation opportunities in access reviews, decommissioning evidence collection, portal data extraction, and incident triage

• Sponsor and guide the development of internal tooling (DCSC Portal, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows) that multiplies team capacity without proportional headcount growth

• Evaluate and adopt AI tooling for repetitive operational tasks, documentation acceleration, root-cause analysis, and compliance evidence generation.

Who You Are

An experienced infrastructure operations leader. You have managed engineering teams responsible for large-scale, globally distributed physical or network infrastructure. You know how to hold a team accountable to 24x7 operational standards while also driving longer-horizon strategic work. You don't lose sight of the incident queue while building the roadmap.

Comfortable at the compliance/operations intersection. You don't need to be a GRC expert, but you understand why physical access controls matter for SOC 2 and FedRAMP, why the decommissioning chain of custody is an audit control, and why a missed quarterly access review has real consequences. You approach compliance not as overhead but as a non-negotiable quality dimension of operational work.

You ensure the teams you're inheriting are operationally capable but structurally manual. You see automation as a force multiplier and have a track record of reducing operational toil through process design, tooling investment, and thoughtful prioritization, not just through headcount.

A strong people leader with a coaching instinct. You manage managers. You know how to develop them, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and create the conditions for high-performing teams. You build trust across functions and are comfortable representing your organization at the executive level.

Energized by global complexity. Your teams operate across APAC, EMEA, and NASA time zones, spanning hundreds of vendors, data center providers, and regulatory jurisdictions. You thrive in this environment rather than being overwhelmed by it.

Required Experience

• 7+ years in infrastructure operations, data center operations, network operations, or a closely related field, with at least 3 years in a people management role

• Demonstrated experience managing managers and holding multiple teams accountable to operational SLAs simultaneously

• Direct experience with physical data center operations including hardware lifecycle management, decommissioning, colocation vendor management, or break-fix operations

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to physical infrastructure: SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or equivalent — at an operational (not auditor) level

• Strong program management instincts: comfortable running complex, multi-workstream initiatives with dependencies across teams, vendors, and time zones

• Proven track record of driving operational efficiency through process redesign or automation adoption

• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical operational details into executive-level reporting and vice versa

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations teams, including PagerDuty or equivalent tooling and incident escalation frameworks

• Familiarity with network infrastructure concepts (circuit management, cross-connect decommissioning, network operations)

• Experience with physical access control systems, access control list management, or vendor portal administration at scale

• Knowledge of ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) vendor management and compliance requirements for secure destruction

• Background in a rapidly scaling, global infrastructure environment (hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN, or similar)

• Experience driving SSO or identity federation projects across large third-party vendor ecosystems

• Familiarity with Jira-based operational workflows, Netbox or similar DCIM tools, and Confluence-based documentation practices

Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Director, Infrastructure Operations (AMER) and is part of the broader Infrastructure Operations leadership team.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. jobs.title: Senior Platform Core DevOps Engineer - Infra
jobs.description:
Are you an ambitious Senior DevOps Engineer eager to jump in a world of complex challenges to modernise web and globally distributed applications? We are hiring!

A taster of what you will be involved with

• Working with cutting edge technology enabling our Cloud Journey

• The Platform Core team is responsible for managing Infrastructure as Code for parts of our Core Platform Layer (Kubernetes Clusters, Message Broker backends, Infrastructure tooling), providing a distributed runtime platform that ensures optimal performance of our business web applications, APIs and backend services

• Building our Infrastructure Platforms as self-service to our developers and providing guidance and tooling for developers to self-manage their applications cross environments

• Continuously improve and develop our platforms based on business needs. Analyse, diagnose and solve issues of efficiency performance and scale collaborating cross functional with colleagues from different teams

Right now, we are looking to strengthen further the management of our Container Platform and Kafka Messaging Platform and looking for a DevOps engineer with strong knowledge and experience in Kubernetes administration and managing Kafka infrastructure.

What we're looking for

• Strong knowledge and experience in setting up and administering Kubernetes clusters, preferably with experience with AWS EKS and Rancher RKE.

• Strong knowledge and experience of managing Kafka infrastructure in a geo-distributed setup, administration, and configuration of such service.

• Managing Cloud Infrastructure via Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, with a good understanding of terraform modules and workflows.

• Experience working with cloud providers, with AWS as preference, and strong knowledge with Cloud provider services such as EC2, ALBs, VPC, and EKS

• Experience in building scalable and distributed infrastructure

• Experience in using versioned source control to manage code changes

• Familiarity with the open-source monitoring stack of Prometheus/Grafana.

• Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, Powershell or similar

• Experience in using and managing Linux distributions

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner.

• Knowledge of best practices in IT operations, such as ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) and DevOps principles.

• Ability to adapt to changing technologies and work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

• Required to be on an On-call support schedule.

Who We Are

Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta.

We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands.

You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers!

Product Development at Betsson Group

Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With over 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together.

We offer numerous challenges where your skills will be put to good use! We encourage innovation, independence and celebrate success where you will be part of multi-cultural and diverse company, with people from all over the world.

Challenge accepted?

By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy
