jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Payments
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 


ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Product team at Airwallex is a group of passionate builders and problem-solvers who are obsessed with crafting customer-centric solutions that empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime.

As the payments landscape undergoes its biggest paradigm shift in decades, our Payments Platform Team is expanding beyond legacy card rails to build the next-generation infrastructure for global commerce. We combine deep technical expertise with first-principles product thinking to design intuitive, highly scalable rails that bridge traditional fiat processing, autonomous AI execution, and stablecoin settlement.




THE ROLE

As a Staff Product Manager, Agentic Payments, based in our San Francisco office, you will lead the core strategic bets driving Airwallex's future processing engine. You will work across several key initiatives, such as our one-click-checkout tool Airi) and build out our Stablecoin Acceptance and Agentic Commerce products

In this role, you won't just optimize authorization rates—you will design how AI agents buy, sell, and settle globally, seamlessly bridging fiat card networks with instant stablecoin liquidity.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will lead high-impact, zero-to-one and scale initiatives across three core payment vectors:

1. Agentic Commerce & Autonomous Payments Architecture

 - Define Machine-to-Machine Payment Protocols: Build standard API/SDK primitives and execution layers enabling AI agents to programmatically initiate, authorize, and verify payment transactions without manual human friction.

 - Integrate Airi into Core Payments: Partner with our AI/ML engineering teams to deploy Airi across the checkout lifecycle—utilizing LLMs and predictive models for real-time routing, intent detection, dynamic risk scoring, and automated fraud defense.

 - Programmable Spending & Identity: Architect fine-grained authentication, spend controls, and identity verification mechanisms specifically tailored for autonomous software agents acting on behalf of businesses and consumers.

2. Stablecoin Acceptance & Hybrid Settlement

 - On-Ramp / Off-Ramp Orchestration: Architect robust stablecoin (USDC, USDT, etc.) payment acceptance rails, enabling merchants to accept digital dollars globally with instant, low-cost clearing and automated conversion into local fiat currencies.

 - Unified Checkout Infrastructure: Embed stablecoin payment flows natively alongside traditional payment methods (Card Schemes, Local Payment Methods) within our single API integration, giving merchants zero-friction access to Web3 liquidity.

 - Capital Efficiency & Treasury Integration: Collaborate with Treasury and Liquidity Risk teams to leverage stablecoins for instant cross-border merchant payouts and balance-sheet optimization.

3. Scalability, Resilience & Industry Leadership

 - Build Next-Gen Foundations: Ensure our underlying payment engines scale to handle massive transaction volumes with 99.999% uptime, strict fault tolerance, and near-zero latency.

 - Drive Ecosystem Standards: Represent Airwallex in global standards bodies, scheme working groups, and developer communities defining protocol specs for agentic commerce and crypto-fiat settlement.




WHO YOU ARE


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of professional experience in Product Management, with significant exposure to high-growth, fast-paced fintech or tech environments.

 - Proven track record building and scaling core payment infrastructure, acquiring products, card scheme integrations, or blockchain/stablecoin payment systems.

 - Strong technical background with a Bachelor's degree or higher (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Deep Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience with payment authorization flows, ISO 8583/20022 messaging, card scheme rules, or blockchain-based token standards (ERC-20, Solana SPL) and stablecoin architecture.

 - AI & Agentic Systems Native: Demonstrated understanding of LLMs, tool-use agents, multi-agent workflows, and how software agents interact with APIs to execute real-world economic actions. Familiarity and interest in agentic commerce and payment standards and protocols, like x402, A2A, AP2, and UCP.

 - Technical Mastery: Exceptional capability to engage in deep architectural discussions with principal engineers, review API contracts, and evaluate transaction protocols.

 - First-Principles Thinking: Ability to decompose highly complex, unstructured problems (like autonomous machine payments) into clear, execution-focused product roadmaps.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Plant Manager
jobs.location: Al Obour City, Al-Qalyubia Governorate, Egypt
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational excellence of the plant. The role ensures that production, maintenance, quality, warehousing, and HSE activities are managed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Sika standards, legal requirements, customer expectations, and agreed business objectives.

The Plant Manager has overall accountability for achieving the plant’s targets relating to safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, people development, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective coordination with all relevant functions.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations and Performance

• Lead and manage the overall plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality control, warehousing, and HSE activities.
• Translate business requirements and demand plans into effective plant production and resource plans.
• Ensure achievement of agreed targets for production output, product quality, cost, productivity, service level, and on-time delivery.
• Monitor plant performance through established KPIs, identify performance gaps, and implement timely corrective and preventive actions.
• Ensure the effective use of plant capacity, equipment, materials, labor, and other operational resources.
• Maintain effective coordination between all plant departments to ensure operational continuity and efficient workflow.

Health, Safety, and Environment

• Demonstrate visible leadership and accountability for health, safety, and environmental performance across the plant.
• Ensure compliance with Sika HSE standards, local legal requirements, permits, and applicable environmental regulations.
• Promote a proactive safety culture in which risks, unsafe conditions, and incidents are identified, reported, investigated, and effectively addressed.
• Ensure that appropriate risk assessments, emergency response arrangements, safety training, and preventive controls are implemented and regularly reviewed.
• Support the achievement of plant HSE objectives and continuous improvement of safety performance.

Quality and Customer Satisfaction

• Ensure that all products manufactured at the plant meet Sika quality standards, approved specifications, and customer requirements.
• Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems, procedures, and internal controls.
• Work closely with Quality, Technical, Sales, and Supply Chain teams to address quality concerns and customer complaints.
• Ensure effective root-cause analysis and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions for quality and operational issues.
• Maintain the plant’s readiness for internal, corporate, customer, certification, and regulatory audits.

Financial and Cost Management

• Prepare, manage, and control the plant’s operating budget in coordination with Finance and senior management.
• Monitor production costs, material consumption, labor utilization, energy consumption, maintenance expenses, and operational losses.
• Identify and implement opportunities to improve cost efficiency, productivity, and resource utilization without compromising safety, quality, or service.
• Lead initiatives to reduce waste, process losses, downtime, and non-value-adding activities.
• Provide accurate forecasts and regular updates regarding plant costs, operational risks, and expected performance.

People Leadership and Development

• Lead, coach, and develop the plant’s department heads, supervisors, and employees to build a capable, accountable, and performance-oriented team.
• Establish clear objectives and performance expectations in line with Sika’s performance management process.
• Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support individual development plans.
• Promote teamwork, employee engagement, operational discipline, and effective communication across the plant.
• Work closely with HR on workforce planning, recruitment requirements, succession planning, employee development, attendance, disciplinary matters, and employee relations.
• Ensure that employees receive the required technical, quality, safety, and compliance training.

Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence

• Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives to enhance plant safety, productivity, quality, reliability, and cost effectiveness.
• Promote the effective implementation of 5S, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and other applicable continuous improvement methodologies.
• Encourage employees at all levels to identify improvement opportunities and participate in operational improvement activities.
• Benchmark plant performance and share good practices with other Sika operations, where applicable.

Maintenance and Asset Management

• Ensure the implementation of effective preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
• Monitor equipment reliability, breakdowns, downtime, and maintenance performance.
• Ensure that plant assets, utilities, machinery, and infrastructure are maintained in safe and efficient operating condition.
• Review critical spare-parts requirements and ensure appropriate controls are in place to support operational continuity.

Capital Investment and Plant Development

• Identify and evaluate requirements for equipment, capacity expansion, plant upgrades, automation, and infrastructure improvements.
• Prepare and support capital expenditure proposals, including operational justification, expected benefits, costs, risks, and implementation requirements.
• Coordinate approved investment projects with Engineering, Procurement, Finance, HSE, and other relevant stakeholders.
• Ensure that projects are implemented safely, within approved budgets and timelines, and in accordance with Sika requirements.

Compliance, Governance, and Reporting

• Ensure full compliance with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, Sika policies, internal procedures, and management systems.
• Maintain the plant’s readiness for governmental inspections, certification audits, internal audits, and corporate assessments.
• Ensure that required licenses, permits, records, and operational documentation are valid, complete, and properly maintained.
• Report plant performance, major risks, operational challenges, incidents, and improvement actions to senior management in an accurate and timely manner.
• Escalate significant HSE, quality, operational, financial, or people-related risks through the appropriate management channels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, HR, Quality, Technical, and other functions to align plant activities with business and customer requirements.
• Participate in demand, capacity, inventory, and production-planning discussions.
• Support new product introduction, product transfers, process changes, and business growth initiatives.
• Build effective working relationships with suppliers, contractors, service providers, authorities, and other relevant external stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be measured against the following indicators:

• HSE performance and incident reduction
• Production output and schedule adherence
• On-time and in-full delivery
• Product quality and customer complaints
• Overall equipment effectiveness and plant utilization
• Equipment downtime and maintenance performance
• Production cost and budget adherence
• Material yield, waste, and process losses
• Inventory accuracy and stock control
• Productivity and labor efficiency
• Audit findings and closure of corrective actions
• Employee engagement, development, and turnover
• Continuous improvement and cost-saving achievements

Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or another relevant Engineering discipline.
• Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field is an advantage.
• Typically, 8–12 years of progressive manufacturing experience, including at least 3–5 years in a plant management, production management, or comparable operational leadership role.
• Demonstrated experience managing a manufacturing plant or a large and complex production operation.
• Experience in chemicals, construction materials, cementitious products, admixtures, coatings, or a comparable process-manufacturing industry is highly preferred.
• Proven record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, cost, and operational performance.
• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, and HSE functions.
• Practical experience with budgeting, cost control, capital expenditure, workforce planning, and plant performance management.
• Experience with continuous improvement methodologies, including 5S, Lean Manufacturing, or structured problem-solving techniques, is preferred.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, production planning, process control, and capacity management.
• Sound understanding of quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems.
• Good knowledge of preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, utilities, and asset management.
• Understanding of applicable legal and regulatory requirements governing manufacturing operations.
• Ability to interpret and manage plant budgets, operational costs, forecasts, and performance indicators.
• Working knowledge of ERP and production management systems, preferably SAP or an equivalent system.
• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
• Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 requirements is preferred.

Leadership Competencies

• Strong and visible leadership with the ability to build trust, accountability, and collaboration.
• Sound judgment and the ability to make timely, fact-based decisions under pressure.
• Strategic and operational thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into practical plant actions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Effective planning, prioritization, and resource-management skills.
• Ability to lead change and engage employees in continuous improvement.
• Strong coaching, delegation, performance management, and people-development skills.
• High level of integrity, ownership, discipline, and personal accountability.
• Strong commitment to health, safety, quality, compliance, and sustainability.
• Effective communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Fluent Arabic and strong written and spoken English.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training.  We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Department Manager - Karrinyup
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO​

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

• Lead your team to deliver an outstanding customer experience by ensuring excellent operational and visual standards, while actively promoting and selling our products.

• Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.

• Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.

• Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.

• Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.

• Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

​

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with…​

• Experience in retail management and operations.

• Strong leadership skills, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.

• Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up, using customer-centric tools and reporting.

And people who are…​

• Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.

• Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution-focused mindset.

• Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.

• A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.

• Effective communicators, creative, and curious.

• Flexible, analytical, and achievement-oriented, with the ability to manage statistics and work with numbers.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

• Receive 25% off H&M Group brands; H&M, COS, Monki, Weekdays, Arket, & Other Stories across the globe.

• Your career can take you anywhere with opportunities to grow across a global business. We proudly support internal progression, with a commitment to identifying and developing internal talent. When you grow, we grow.

• Up to 26 weeks of company paid parental leave for eligible team members.

• Access to our online learning platform, wellbeing support through our EAP and a Flare membership with exclusive discounts.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

​

​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Recruiter at Mercor, you’ll own full-cycle hiring for critical roles across a variety of organizations, with a particular focus on our Operations org. You will partner directly with General Managers to find high performing operators that will partner directly with the leading AI Labs in the world, playing an instrumental role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. This is a true 0→1 motion, with an opportunity to lay the foundation for the future of recruiting at Mercor.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting (sourcing → close) across a variety of organizations (such as marketing, finance, people ops, with a prominent focus on operations)

 - Partner with b to map out needs and implement continual process improvements

 - Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor’s own product (structured screens, automated work samples, and calibrated rubrics)

 - Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene

 - Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize key funnel metrics (pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield)

 - Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for same-day debriefs, fast offers, and strong candidate experience

 - Build brand: campaigns, referrals, and events that attract top engineers and operators

 - Represent Mercor externally, you’ll be a face of the brand for an exceptionally competitive talent market

 - Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Ashby and other recruiting systems

 - Refinement of technical recruiting motion as the Ops org shifts to hire more frequently from technical backgrounds
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience with full-cycle recruiting across IC and leadership roles

 - Proven ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

 - High motor, outcome-oriented approach; Mercor is in hypergrowth, and hiring is viewed as a key strategic driver of that growth

 - Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with General Managers, Account Leads, and internal leadership

 - Familiarity with a range of roles, emphasis on GTM, Strategy, Operations, ideally with some mastery of technical roles such as SWEs or FDEs

 - Confident representing the Mercor brand to top candidates

 - Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

 - Interest in the human data / AGI space

 - Technical recruiting expertise - Mercor's business is trending in an increasingly technical perspective over time, and we are hiring a greater percentage of technical professionals into client facing operator roles
   
   


IDEAL QUALITIES

 - Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

 - Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

 - Growth Mindset - You don’t need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

 - Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

 - Love for the Craft - we are building a zero to one motion; this hire will bring a low ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition motion
   
   


BENEFITS

 - $15K relocation bonus (for moving to the Bay Area)

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAD AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie https://www.radai.com/news/auntminnie-recognizes-rad-ai-omni-reporting-as-2023s-best-new-radiology-software, and ranked by Deloitte https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 https://www.cnbc.com/2025/06/10/2025-cnbc-disruptor-50-see-the-full-list-of-companies.html list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!



Why Join Us:

The Platform Engineering organization at Rad AI builds the foundations that power all of our products—Reporting, Impressions, and Continuity—and enables product teams to ship reliably, safely, and at scale. Within Platform, the Infrastructure team owns our core cloud infrastructure, platforms, and reliability practices. We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help us design and operate robust, scalable systems. In this role, you’ll contribute to infrastructure architecture, reliability practices, and thoughtful improvements to our workflows. If you’re passionate about building resilient platforms and enjoy collaborating across functions, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing:

 - Architect and evolve our cloud infrastructure (primarily on AWS) across container orchestration (Kubernetes, Elastic Container Service), serverless (e.g., Lambda), virtual machines (e.g., EC2), and data stores to support current and future products.

 - Collaborate with engineering leadership, machine learning, data science, and product partners to help shape our platform vision.

 - Develop and maintain tooling that improves engineering productivity and developer experience.

 - Promote sustainable incident response and lead blameless post-incident reviews.

 - Manage network and systems monitoring, design alert strategies, and participate in an equitable on‑call rotation.

Who We're Looking For:

 - A data‑informed approach and a track record of effective problem solving.

 - Bring 6+ years of hands-on infrastructure / platform development experience (or equivalent practical experience) in modern, cloud-native environments, with a track record of owning critical systems in production.

 - Extensive experience operating Kubernetes in production, including familiarity with cluster lifecycle management, scaling, and container security.

 - Proficiency in one or more languages—Python (preferred) and/or Bash—and familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CDK, Terraform or Pulumi.

 - Strong familiarity with AWS and/or GCP services.

 - Networking fundamentals and comfort working in command‑line Linux environments.

 - Clear, respectful communication and collaboration skills, including organizing work, delegating when appropriate, and giving/receiving feedback.

 - Experience designing complex systems and mentoring others in technical design.

 - Ability to scope project-level work, execute independently, and bring projects to completion while collaborating with teammates.

Nice to Haves:

 - Proficiency in deep Linux troubleshooting, including debugging kernel and driver issues.

 - Experience in regulated environments (e.g., HIPAA) or at early‑stage startups.

 - Background in healthcare, security, or machine learning.

 - Familiarity with HL7 or radiology workflows.

 - Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar tracing services.

 - Familiarity with Grafana or similar logging services.

 - Experience with Spark (e.g., EMR, Dataproc, HDInsight) and Hadoop‑related technologies.

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission,  we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you're passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it's like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/radai/?utm_campaign=Recruiting_2026&utm_content=recruiting-job-posting-website&utm_source=recru%5B%E2%80%A6%5Db-posting-website to stay up to date!


Location Details:

For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite:

 - This role will be based in our San Francisco office and we expect employees to work onsite four days per week. The remaining time may be worked remotely or onsite, depending on team and business needs.

For roles listed as United States - Remote:

 - This role is open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.

For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite + United States - Remote:

 - We will prioritize candidates who can work onsite four days per week in San Francisco, while also considering remote candidates located anywhere in the United States.


For US-Based Full-Time Roles, Rad AI offers a variety of benefits, including:

 - Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision & Life insurance

jobs.title: Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT ACTAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Ashby and other sourcing or recruiting tools.

jobs.title: Transport Manager

jobs.title: AI Tutor - Video (Weekend)
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Video Specialist, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok's ability to interpret and generate video content with precision and technical depth. Key to this role is expertise in video editing, motion graphics, or VFX, a track record of producing high quality video work, and a strong understanding of how moving images are constructed in post-production. This is a weekend-focused role with set working hours on Saturday and Sunday. Full-time positions typically follow a Saturday through Wednesday or Thursday through Monday schedule.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, and inputs on projects involving video and multimedia elements.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is hiring a Senior Motion Designer to define how motion shows up across Harvey’s brand, product storytelling, launch moments, web experiences, customer education, and executive-facing creative work. The role will sit within Brand and Design, reporting into our Head of Motion. This is a new senior IC role intended to raise the motion craft bar while still operating with the low-ego, hands-on generalist posture expected of Harvey’s senior brand hires. The role should build on existing motion and brand hiring standards, including deep portfolio review, visible process, cross-functional collaboration with PMM and Marketing, and practical assessment of prioritization under ambiguity. The person in this role will help Harvey turn complex AI product ideas into clear, memorable, and reusable motion systems that can scale across product launches, web surfaces, campaign assets, Academy or education assets, events, and internal/external storytelling.

Support the motion design language for Harvey’s brand across launch videos, product explainers, web and campaign moments, event assets, social cuts, sales enablement, and other high-leverage creative surfaces.

Create motion concepts, storyboards, style-frames, animatics, and final motion assets that make complex AI workflows feel clear, premium, and unmistakably Harvey.

Partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Product Design, Creative Operations, and other GTM stakeholders to translate positioning, product context, and user needs into motion narratives that can ship quickly.

Develop reusable motion systems, templates, animation principles, and production workflows so Harvey can scale motion output without reinventing the wheel on every request.

Use judgment to scope work appropriately across polished hero moments, scrappy launch needs, quick-turnaround edits, and longer-term brand-system investments.

Raise the craft bar for motion while remaining willing to do the unglamorous but important production work required in a fast-moving creative team.




WHAT YOU HAVE

Deep fluency in motion design tools and workflows such as After Effects, Figma, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, code-adjacent motion, or comparable production tools.

Experience building motion for brand, product, marketing, launch, or education contexts, ideally in a product-led technology company or high-growth SaaS environment.

Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to clarify a brief, align with PMM or Marketing goals, handle competing feedback, and prioritize multiple stakeholder requests.

jobs.title: Nuclear Operations & Licensing Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.



About the Summer Internship Program

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.



We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10



All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters or Idaho Falls, ID office and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package.



About the Role

As a Nuclear Operations & Licensing Engineering Intern, you will help define how Antares reactor systems are operated, maintained, and deployed. You will work directly with responsible engineers (REs) to translate system designs into practical operating and maintenance requirements and use simulators and other test systems to validate and improve operator training activities.

You will also contribute to Antares’ international deployment efforts by evaluating licensing frameworks across different countries, identifying areas of alignment, and assessing approaches for demonstrating compliance across domestic and international deployments. This role provides exposure to the intersection of reactor engineering, operations, training, and nuclear licensing.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Interface with responsible engineers (REs) to establish operating requirements for reactor systems

 - Develop and document maintenance requirements based on system designs and operating needs

 - Use reactor simulators and other test systems to validate training activities

 - Identify opportunities to improve training activities based on simulator and test system results

 - Evaluate international nuclear licensing frameworks relevant to reactor deployment

 - Identify synergies and differences between domestic and international licensing requirements

 - Assess approaches for demonstrating compliance across domestic and international deployments



Basic Qualifications:

 - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies

 - Must have prior internship experience, or significant (>1yr) project team, laboratory, or research experience



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - GPA of 3.5 or above

 - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred

 - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

 - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams

 - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

 - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively



Location

 - We are located in Idaho Falls, ID at 545 Shoup Ave in the Rogers Building. The Rogers Building (formerly the Rogers Hotel) has its own nuclear history. In the 1940s, it became base of operations for the Atomic Energy Commission during the Manhattan Project. Today, the Idaho Falls office drives local operations and supports Idaho National Lab collaboration.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Program Manager, Generosity University
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Overflow is a Silicon Valley technology company with a bold mission: to inspire the world to give. We are a B2B SaaS philanthropy platform that enables modern giving across cash, stock, and crypto for nonprofits, churches, and mission-driven organizations.

Backed by leading investors including Uncork Capital, Craft Ventures, and Village Global, Overflow builds secure, beautifully designed infrastructure that powers generosity at scale.




OUR FOUNDING PRINCIPLES

Overflow was founded on the belief that generosity transforms people and communities. Inspired by Proverbs 11:24 — "The world of the generous gets larger and larger" — we operate with integrity, stewardship, service, and excellence.




HOW WE WORK

Overflow operates with a flexible work model. While there is no company-wide in-office requirement, some teams may establish in-person collaboration rhythms based on their function, goals, and team needs.

We maintain offices in Los Gatos, CA and Birmingham, AL for team collaboration, coworking, meetings, and intentional in-person connection.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Less than 5% of Christians tithe. Generosity University (Gen U) exists to change that - an eight-module course that turns generosity from a Sunday afterthought into a lasting habit. It works: one church saw nine first-time givers and $6K/month in new recurring giving after a single cohort, and every student who completes the course raises their giving band by 20% or more. Gen U has built a loyal base of ~100 paying churches almost entirely on the conviction and hustle of one person.



That's the opportunity here. You're not inheriting a product that needs to find its market - you're inheriting one that already has it, with plenty of room still to grow: a subscription model to design, a sales motion to scale past a single closer, a content experience overdue for a refresh, and over 765 pastors already waiting to hear from you.



As Program Manager, reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you'll partner closely with engineering, sales, and church customers to push Gen U toward its boldest goal yet - $1M in annualized sales - while building the infrastructure that lets it keep growing well past it. It's a stretch goal for the whole program, not something any one hire is expected to single-handedly deliver in their first few months.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead Gen U's roadmap and execution, working alongside a dedicated product manager and software engineer plus AM and engineering support pulled in as needed

 - Help drive Gen U toward its 2026 stretch goal of $1M in annualized subscription sales, with activation rate as your leading indicator of long-term health

 - Turn the backlog of 765+ inbound pastor leads into activated, engaged churches

 - Design the pricing and packaging model Gen U has been missing - moving from mixed one-time and tiered fees to a clear subscription structure that unlocks predictable growth

 - Create the playbooks, training, and prospect-facing materials that let Gen U's new-logo sales motion scale beyond a single closer

 - Partner with engineering and product to modernize the curriculum and delivery experience for the first real refresh in two years

 - Build the reporting infrastructure to finally make Gen U activation visible, connecting Kajabi and offline-cohort data into Overflow's core dashboard

 - Be the connective tissue between Gen U's content partners, its founding champions, engineering, and sales/AM - the person who makes this feel like one coherent product, not a side project

 - Report progress and wins directly to executive leadership
   
   


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - 5+ years in program or product management, with experience owning a revenue-linked KPI in a cross-functional, resource-constrained environment

 - A track record of taking a founder-led product or program and turning it into something systematized and scalable

 - Comfort working directly with engineers on scope and delivery tradeoffs; you don't need to write code, but you need to be credible in the room

 - You're energized by building structure from ambiguity - this is a role where you get to define the playbook, not inherit one

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent Gen U credibly to sales leadership, pastors, and church customers

 - Genuine alignment with Overflow's mission, values, and culture, including comfort operating in a faith-based, church-facing context
   
   


IT'D BE NICE IF YOU HAD

 - Familiarity with church, ministry, or other faith-based organizational contexts

 - Experience with e-learning platforms (e.g. Kajabi) or cohort-based education products
